jp: ビッグモスキートの頭や足が変異した特殊個体。人家を訪問し、うっかり招き入れてしまうと大繁殖してアグレッシブに住人を襲う。家に帰れなくなり街にたむろし続ける市民が誕生する原因でもある。招かれないと家に入れないのが弱点。
jp_grezzo: "ビッグモスキートの頭や足が変異した特殊個体。人家を訪問し、うっかり招き入れてしまうと大繁殖してアグレッシブに住人を襲う。家に帰れなくなり街にたむろし続ける市民が誕生する原因でもある。招かれないと家に入れないのが弱点。"
en: Big Mosquito Mutant: A special variant with enlarged head and limbs. If accidentally invited into homes, they breed rapidly and aggressively attack inhabitants. These incidents cause citizens to be unable to return home, congregating in the streets.
en_grezzo: "Big Mosquito Mutant: A special variant with enlarged head and limbs. If accidentally invited into homes, they breed rapidly and aggressively attack inhabitants. These incidents cause citizens to be unable to return home, congregating in the streets."
it: Esemplare speciale della zanzara gigante, con testa e zampe mutate. Visita le case, e se per distrazione la si invita a entrare si moltiplica senza freni e aggredisce gli abitanti. È anche la ragione per cui certi cittadini non tornano più a casa e restano a bighellonare per le strade. Il punto debole: senza invito, in casa non entra.

jp: 現代イルヴァにおける人間ぶっ殺しナンバーワン生物。目立たないだけで死因の7～8割が蚊。ほぼビッグモスキートに自宅で襲われて死ぬ。インド象とかマンモスとか関係なく鉄拳で叩きのめし、性別とか産卵時期とか関係なく吸血する。
jp_grezzo: "現代イルヴァにおける人間ぶっ殺しナンバーワン生物。目立たないだけで死因の7～8割が蚊。ほぼビッグモスキートに自宅で襲われて死ぬ。インド象とかマンモスとか関係なく鉄拳で叩きのめし、性別とか産卵時期とか関係なく吸血する。"
en: Mosquito: The number one human killer in modern Irva. Most deaths occur at home, crushed by these unassuming insects. Even an Indian Elephant or mammoth is no match, as mosquitoes don't discriminate by gender or breeding season.
en_grezzo: "Mosquito: The number one human killer in modern Irva. Most deaths occur at home, crushed by these unassuming insects. Even an Indian Elephant or mammoth is no match, as mosquitoes don't discriminate by gender or breeding season."
it: Il primo ammazzauomini dell'Irva di oggi. Non dà nell'occhio, ma il settanta-ottanta per cento delle morti porta la sua firma: quasi tutti muoiono in casa propria, sotto la zanzara gigante. Elefante indiano o mammut per lei è lo stesso, li stende a pugni; e succhia il sangue senza badare al sesso né alla stagione della deposizione.

jp_grezzo: "ポート・カプールへの処女航海中にエーテル風で沈没したはずの帆船。一度は船体が引き裂かれて海の藻屑と化したがその時不思議なことが起こり、なんか人型になって目的の港へたどり着いた。女王様気どりだが元が商船なのでカネにうるさく、戦闘力も低い。"
en: Queen Sedona: A sailing ship that sank during its maiden voyage to Port Kapul due to an Etherwind. Though its hull was torn apart, it inexplicably transformed into a humanoid form and reached its destination. It acts haughty like a queen, but being originally a merchant vessel, it's quite money-oriented and lacks combat strength.
en_grezzo: "Queen Sedona: A sailing ship that sank during its maiden voyage to Port Kapul due to an Etherwind. Though its hull was torn apart, it inexplicably transformed into a humanoid form and reached its destination. It acts haughty like a queen, but being originally a merchant vessel, it's quite money-oriented and lacks combat strength."
it: Un veliero che sarebbe dovuto affondare per il vento d'etere durante il viaggio inaugurale verso Porto Kapul. Lo scafo si squarciò e finì in pasto al mare, ma in quel momento accadde qualcosa di strano: prese una forma umana e arrivò lo stesso al porto di destinazione. Si dà arie da regina, ma era una nave mercantile: tiene ai soldi e in battaglia vale poco.

jp_grezzo: "イェルス軍の公式広報キャラクター。余った広報予算を使い切るため開発主任にPR用の実機を作らせたところ、決戦兵器の規格落ち部品や不採用部品を流用。宣伝目的なのにやたら強力な機体へと仕上がった。"

Per esaurire il budget pubblicitario avanzato fecero costruire al capo progettista un esemplare vero da esposizione, e quello riciclò gli scarti di lavorazione e i pezzi bocciati delle armi decisive. Ne è uscita una macchina assurdamente potente, e solo per farsi pubblicità.

jp: ハクビシン。その名の通り、鼻筋の白いラインが特徴。雷神の欠片を宿しており、雷に乗って高速移動することから雷獣の異名を持つ。狸に間違われることも多いが、どちらかというと猫の親戚であり木登りが得意。
jp_grezzo: "ハクビシン。その名の通り、鼻筋の白いラインが特徴。雷神の欠片を宿しており、雷に乗って高速移動することから雷獣の異名を持つ。狸に間違われることも多いが、どちらかというと猫の親戚であり木登りが得意。"
en: Also known as the Hakubishin. As its name suggests, it is characterized by a white stripe on its nose. Said to harbor a shard of the Lightning God within, enabling it to move at high speeds by riding lightning currents, earning it the moniker of the 'Thunder Beast'. While often mistaken for a raccoon, it is more closely related to cats and is adept at climbing trees.
en_grezzo: "Also known as the Hakubishin. As its name suggests, it is characterized by a white stripe on its nose. it: Lo zibetto delle palme mascherato. Come dice il nome, lo si riconosce dalla riga bianca sul dorso del naso. Porta in sé una scheggia del dio del fulmine e cavalca la folgore per spostarsi velocissimo: per questo lo chiamano anche la bestia del tuono. Lo scambiano spesso per un cane procione, ma è piuttosto parente del gatto ed è bravissimo ad arrampicarsi sugli alberi.

jp: 白鼻神
jp_grezzo: "白鼻神"

jp_grezzo: "別名ムジナ。味方を囲んで防御力の高い密集陣形を作る。狸とは親戚ではないのだが見た目が似ており、穴熊が掘った巣穴に狸が勝手に住み着くことがあるので本当に紛らわしい。同じ穴のムジナと言われて混同されがち。"
en: Also known as the Badger (Mujina). It forms a dense, defensive formation by surrounding allies. Despite their similar appearance, they are not related to raccoons. Sometimes, they occupy holes dug by raccoons, causing confusion within them.
en_grezzo: "Also known as the Badger (Mujina). It forms a dense, defensive formation by surrounding allies. Despite their similar appearance, they are not related to raccoons. Sometimes, they occupy holes dug by raccoons, causing confusion within them."
it: Detto anche mujina. Circonda i compagni e forma uno schieramento serrato dall'ottima difesa. Non è parente del cane procione, ma gli somiglia, e capita che il cane procione si installi senza permesso nella tana che il tasso ha scavato: una confusione continua. Il modo di dire su quei due che stanno nella stessa buca non aiuta.

jp: 馬の隣に並べてはいけない生物。食欲がすごく、こいつが山に数匹いるだけでマジで山がハゲ山に変わるほど。寄生虫が身体にめちゃくちゃついており、植物を食い漁った地域に寄生虫を残していく。
jp_grezzo: "馬の隣に並べてはいけない生物。食欲がすごく、こいつが山に数匹いるだけでマジで山がハゲ山に変わるほど。寄生虫が身体にめちゃくちゃついており、植物を食い漁った地域に寄生虫を残していく。"
en: A creature that should never be placed next to a horse. It has an enormous appetite - having just a few of these in a mountain can strip it bare, turning it into a barren, bald mountain. It is covered in parasites and leaves a trail of these parasites in the areas it has ravaged by feeding on plants.

it: Una creatura che non va messa accanto a un cavallo. Ha una fame smisurata: bastano pochi esemplari su un monte perché il monte diventi davvero pelato. È coperto di parassiti fino all'inverosimile, e li lascia dietro di sé in ogni zona che ha spogliato delle piante.

jp: マジカ
jp_grezzo: "マジカ"

en_grezzo: "Ginat ticks that usually lives attached to a Magic. It subsists by drawing a minimal amount of blood and magical power from its host. When the host dies, it drinks as much as it can and detaches in a bloated state. Be careful not to poke it, as it may burst."
it: Una zecca di taglia grossa. Di solito vive attaccata al magicervo e ne succhia il minimo indispensabile di sangue e di potere magico. Quando si accorge che l'ospite è morto, succhia tutto quello che può e si stacca gonfia da scoppiare. E attenzione a stuzzicarla male, perché scoppia davvero.

jp: 魔ダニ

jp_grezzo: "畑を荒らす害獣。見た目が可愛いからといって飼育する無知な人間も多いが、気性が荒いので飼うのがだんだんツラくなってくるのだ。これは本来住んでいなかった地域にわざと捨てられることで、生息範囲を拡大していくという戦略なのだ。見た目が似ているのでタヌキに畑荒らしの罪をなすりつけることが多いのだ。"
en: Crop destroying pests. Many people naively try to keep it as a pet because of its cute appearance, but its wild temperament eventually makes it unbearable to keep. This is part of its strategy to expand its habitat - careless owners intentionally release them in new areas. It often gets blamed for the crop destruction and has the raccoon dog (tanuki) taking the fall because of their similar appearance.

It often gets blamed for the crop destruction and has the raccoon dog (tanuki) taking the fall because of their similar appearance."
it: Un animale nocivo che devasta i campi. Molti ignoranti lo prendono in casa perché ha l'aria carina, ma ha un pessimo carattere e tenerlo diventa via via più duro. E questa è la sua strategia: farsi abbandonare apposta dove non viveva, e allargare così il proprio territorio. Somigliandogli, il cane procione si prende spesso la colpa delle sue razzie.

jp: 気性あらいぐま
jp_grezzo: "気性あらいぐま"
en: vicious raccoon
en_grezzo: "vicious raccoon"

jp_grezzo: "拉致や身売りによって悪の手先に堕ちた軽トラック。収穫前のやや未熟な作物を根こそぎ盗んでいき、カスみてぇな値段で路上販売する。捕まえてもわざと軽トラ語しか喋らないので何を言っているのか分からず最悪。"
en: A light truck that has derailed into evil paths due to abduction and trafficking. It steals and unroots entire crops before they're fully ripe, then sells them for a paltry sum on the streets. Even if caught, it deliberately only speaks in truck language, making it impossible to understand what it's saying, which is utterly frustrating.
en_grezzo: "A light truck that has derailed into evil paths due to abduction and trafficking. It steals and unroots entire crops before they're fully ripe, then sells them for a paltry sum on the streets. Even if caught, it deliberately only speaks in truck language, making it impossible to understand what it's saying, which is utterly frustrating."
it: Un furgoncino finito al servizio del male fra rapimenti e compravendite. Ruba fino all'ultima radice i raccolti ancora acerbi e li rivende per strada a prezzi da fame. Anche quando lo si prende parla apposta soltanto la lingua dei furgoncini, e non si capisce niente di quello che dice: il peggio.

jp: 泥棒軽トラ
jp_grezzo: "泥棒軽トラ"
en: thief light truck
en_grezzo: "thief light truck"
it: il furgoncino ladro

jp: 臓物を食べてその味のトリコになってしまい、もう元の食生活には戻れなくなった。獲物がまだ死んでいなくても我慢できずに腹を裂いて食い漁る。同じ熊の他モンスターと比較してもフィジカルが段違いであり、非常に危険。
jp_grezzo: "臓物を食べてその味のトリコになってしまい、もう元の食生活には戻れなくなった。獲物がまだ死んでいなくても我慢できずに腹を裂いて食い漁る。同じ熊の他モンスターと比較してもフィジカルが段違いであり、非常に危険。"
en: Motuhegui (Organ-Mauler), having become addicted to the taste of organs, they can no longer revert to their previous diet. Even if prey is still alive, they cannot resist the urge to tear open its belly and feed. Compared to other bears and monsters, their physical prowess is in a completely different league, making them extremely dangerous.
en_grezzo: "Motuhegui (Organ-Mauler), having become addicted to the taste of organs, they can no longer revert to their previous diet. it: Ha assaggiato le interiora, ne è rimasto schiavo e non è più tornato alla dieta di prima. Non aspetta nemmeno che la preda sia morta: le apre il ventre e divora. Anche fra gli altri mostri della famiglia degli orsi la sua stazza è di un altro ordine, ed è pericolosissimo.

it: È il cucciolo dello sbudellatore, e già così vanta una forza e una resistenza notevoli. Un uomo comune può tirargli in faccia un pugno con tutta la disperazione che ha, e quello non si sposta; una sua zampata, invece, la faccia la porta via. Insieme alla mamma tira fuori le interiora dei bambini e se le gusta.

it: Uno spirito che abita nelle carte. Sincronizzandosi con chi la usa attraverso la carta cresce di potenza e cambia aspetto. È una strega che semina sorrisi con gesti graziosi e confonde il cuore della gente. Fuori squadra, questo mostro ha una probabilità di rango x 5% di non coinvolgere gli alleati, oltre alla normale prova di controllo del potere magico.

jp: ハート・ウィッチ
jp_grezzo: "ハート・ウィッチ"

jp: 巨大な青い狼の神様。骨をバリバリかみ砕いて骨髄をすするのが好き。神々の大戦時に結構な数の神をかみ殺した結果、危険視されて封印されてしまった。人狼たちはその封印を解くため、暗躍しているのだ。
jp_grezzo: "巨大な青い狼の神様。骨をバリバリかみ砕いて骨髄をすするのが好き。神々の大戦時に結構な数の神をかみ殺した結果、危険視されて封印されてしまった。人狼たちはその封印を解くため、暗躍しているのだ。"

en_grezzo: "Giant blue wolf god. Likes to crunch bones and sip marrow. As a result of chewing up quite a few gods during the War of the Gods, he was regarded as dangerous and sealed away. The werewolves are working in the dark to break the seal."
it: Il dio lupo, azzurro e immenso. Gli piace stritolare le ossa a morsi e succhiarne il midollo. Nella grande guerra delle divinità ne sbranò un buon numero, e per questo lo giudicarono pericoloso e lo sigillarono. I licantropi tramano nell'ombra per spezzare quel sigillo.

jp: 『神狼』
en: <Godwolf>
en_grezzo: "<Godwolf>"
it: <Lupo Divino>

jp: もふもふの九本の尻尾を持つ、妖狐の神様。それぞれの尻尾を別々に動かすのは難しいらしい。力を失って石になっていたが、人狼の儀式を乗っ取って復活できることが判明。子分の妖狐たちによって今日も人と狼を相手に騙しあいが行われている。
jp_grezzo: "もふもふの九本の尻尾を持つ、妖狐の神様。それぞれの尻尾を別々に動かすのは難しいらしい。力を失って石になっていたが、人狼の儀式を乗っ取って復活できることが判明。子分の妖狐たちによって今日も人と狼を相手に騙しあいが行われている。"
en: Fox god with nine fluffy tails. It is apparently difficult to move each tail separately. It lost its power and turned to stone, but was found to be able to revive itself by taking over the rituals of the werewolves. Today, the foxes, continue to deceive people and wolves alike.
en_grezzo: "Fox god with nine fluffy tails. It is apparently difficult to move each tail separately. It lost its power and turned to stone, but was found to be able to revive itself by taking over the rituals of the werewolves. Today, the foxes, continue to deceive people and wolves alike."
it: La divinità delle volpi magiche, con nove code morbidissime. Muoverle una per una, dicono, non è affatto semplice. Aveva perso il potere ed era diventata pietra, finché non si scoprì che poteva risorgere impadronendosi del rito dei licantropi. Anche oggi le volpi al suo servizio giocano d'inganno con uomini e lupi.

jp_grezzo: "『金毛九尾』"

jp_grezzo: "サイキョウという地方出身の妖怪ネズミ。特技は催眠や予言。頻繁に最強だと誤解されて面倒くさいトラブルに巻き込まれ、誤解を解いたら解いたでそのたびに勝手に失望されてきた。積年の屈辱から、実際に最強になってやろうと決意し努力を続けている。"
en: Yokai rats hail from a region called Saikyo. Its specialities are hypnosis and foretelling. They are frequently misunderstood due to Saikyo means the strongest and get into trouble, and each time they have been let down when their misunderstandings are cleared up. After years of humiliation, he has decided to actually become the strongest and is continuing his efforts.
en_grezzo: "Yokai rats hail from a region called Saikyo. Its specialities are hypnosis and foretelling. They are frequently misunderstood due to Saikyo means the strongest and get into trouble, and each time they have been let down when their misunderstandings are cleared up. After years of humiliation, he has decided to actually become the strongest and is continuing his efforts."
it: Un ratto stregato originario della regione di Saikyo. È bravo nell'ipnosi e nella profezia. Siccome Saikyo suona come il più forte, lo scambiano di continuo per tale e finisce in guai noiosissimi; e ogni volta che chiarisce l'equivoco qualcuno resta deluso, come se fosse colpa sua. Umiliato per anni, ha deciso di diventare davvero il più forte, e continua ad allenarsi.

jp: 生化学文明でも動物実験にはモルモットが使われていた。究極強化実験の素体にしたところ、想定以上のパワーアップを遂げて研究所を脱走した、という記録が残っている。どうやら野外で繁殖したらしく、現代でもその子孫がプイプイ言わせている。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明でも動物実験にはモルモットが使われていた。究極強化実験の素体にしたところ、想定以上のパワーアップを遂げて研究所を脱走した、という記録が残っている。どうやら野外で繁殖したらしく、現代でもその子孫がプイプイ言わせている。"
en: In biochemical civilisation, guinea pigs were also used for animal experiments. There is a record of a guinea pig that escaped from a research institute after becoming more powerful than expected when used as an baseline specimen for ultimate enhancement experiments. Apparently, they were bred in the field, and their offspring are still making pui-pui sounds even today.
en_grezzo: "In biochemical civilisation, guinea pigs were also used for animal experiments. There is a record of a guinea pig that escaped from a research institute after becoming more powerful than expected when used as an baseline specimen for ultimate enhancement experiments. Apparently, they were bred in the field, and their offspring are still making pui-pui sounds even today."
it: Anche nella civiltà biochimica le cavie servivano per gli esperimenti sugli animali. Resta agli atti che una di esse, usata come base per l'esperimento di potenziamento supremo, crebbe di forza oltre ogni previsione e fuggì dal laboratorio. A quanto pare si è riprodotta all'aperto, e ancora oggi i suoi discendenti vanno in giro a fare pui pui.

it: Ha le zampe sviluppate fuori da ogni misura, e un suo calcio dato sul serio scuote la montagna. Se la montagna rimbomba e trema e poi ne esce questo topo, invece di restare delusi conviene prenderla sul serio: può darsi che dalla tana lo abbia cacciato un mostro che nemmeno i suoi calci abbattono.

jp: 大山鳴動鼠
jp_grezzo: "大山鳴動鼠"
en: mountain shaker
en_grezzo: "mountain shaker"
it: il topolino della montagna

jp: エウダーナでポーション開発に用いられていた実験動物。度重なる実験の中で変異し、投与された薬物を貯蔵・合成する臓器…通称、ポーションぶくろが形成されている。体内合成した麻痺薬をまき散らして研究員たちを無力化し、脱走した。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナでポーション開発に用いられていた実験動物。度重なる実験の中で変異し、投与された薬物を貯蔵・合成する臓器…通称、ポーションぶくろが形成されている。体内合成した麻痺薬をまき散らして研究員たちを無力化し、脱走した。"
en: Experimental animals used for potion development in Eulderna. They mutated during repeated experiments and formed organs that store and synthesise the administered drugs... commonly known as a potion bag. They disperse the paralysing drugs synthesised in their bodies, incapacitating the researchers, and then escaped.
en_grezzo: "Experimental animals used for potion development in Eulderna. They mutated during repeated experiments and formed organs that store and synthesise the administered drugs... commonly known as a potion bag. They disperse the paralysing drugs synthesised in their bodies, incapacitating the researchers, and then escaped."
it: Un animale da laboratorio usato a Eulderna per mettere a punto le pozioni. A furia di esperimenti è mutata e le si è formato un organo che immagazzina e sintetizza i farmaci somministrati: la cosiddetta sacca delle pozioni. Ha sparso attorno il paralizzante prodotto dentro il proprio corpo, ha messo fuori gioco i ricercatori ed è fuggita.

jp: ドーピングモルモット
jp_grezzo: "ドーピングモルモット"

en_grezzo: "doping guinea pig"

en: They have particularly good eyes and ears among rats, and perform mercenary work as scouts. They are also highly sociable and often get together with their friends for strategy meetings.
en_grezzo: "They have particularly good eyes and ears among rats, and perform mercenary work as scouts. They are also highly sociable and often get together with their friends for strategy meetings."
it: Fra i roditori è quello con la vista e l'udito migliori, e si vende come mercenario nel ruolo di esploratore. È anche molto socievole, e spesso si raduna con i compagni per fare consiglio di guerra.

en_grezzo: "gundegu"

en: Humanoid giant gerbils. There are no humans inside. They are not very good at direct combat, and will approach and attack at full speed when their prey is fighting other creatures. The large rats are classified as rats and the small ones as mice, although this is not important.
en_grezzo: "Humanoid giant gerbils. There are no humans inside. They are not very good at direct combat, and will approach and attack at full speed when their prey is fighting other creatures. The large rats are classified as rats and the small ones as mice, although this is not important."
it: Un enorme ratto di fogna dalla forma umana. Dentro non c'è nessuno. Nello scontro diretto non è granché: aspetta che la preda sia impegnata contro un'altra creatura, poi le piomba addosso a tutta velocità. Nota inutile: i roditori grossi si chiamano ratti, quelli piccoli topi.

jp: ラッシュラット
jp_grezzo: "ラッシュラット"
en: rush rat
en_grezzo: "rush rat"
it: il ratto impetuoso

en_grezzo: "Rats that stand up on their long hind legs and move around by hopping around. it: Un topo che si rizza sulle lunghe zampe posteriori e si sposta a balzi. Quando fa sul serio salta in verticale a un'altezza notevole, e siccome è anche piccolo lo si perde di vista di sicuro. Con un calcio di tallone caricato dalla caduta sfonda il cranio del nemico.

en: A type of rat that is damn large in size. When attacked by enemies, they resist by spraying smelly liquid. Because of their large size and athleticism, if you want to keep one, you will need damn big furnitures and a damn big house.
en_grezzo: "A type of rat that is damn large in size. When attacked by enemies, they resist by spraying smelly liquid. Because of their large size and athleticism, if you want to keep one, you will need damn big furnitures and a damn big house."

Che sia lui a spargere il polline forte non si sa granché, e lui ne approfitta per dare la colpa ai cedri e si diverte a soffiare sulla lite fra i cedri e gli uomini.

en: A demon with a very bad personality. He is the culprit behind the creation of the Underworld Palace, tricking and dragging in souls that should be going elsewhere. He harasses those who can't resist and smirks at them to no end.
en_grezzo: "A demon with a very bad personality. He is the culprit behind the creation of the Underworld Palace, tricking and dragging in souls that should be going elsewhere. He harasses those who can't resist and smirks at them to no end."
it: Un demone dal carattere pessimo. È lui il colpevole: ha creato il Palazzo Infero e ci trascina dentro con l'inganno le anime che dovrebbero andare altrove. Perseguita fino in fondo chi non può opporsi, e intanto ghigna.

jp: 冥宮の悪鬼
jp_grezzo: "冥宮の悪鬼"
en: hellabyrinth ruler
en_grezzo: "hellabyrinth ruler"
it: il demone del palazzo infero

jp: 死者の霧散した魔力から発生した、霧状の化け物。じめじめした場所が好きだが、風に吹き飛ばされてしまうので居場所は選べない。
jp_grezzo: "死者の霧散した魔力から発生した、霧状の化け物。じめじめした場所が好きだが、風に吹き飛ばされてしまうので居場所は選べない。"
en: A fog-like monster that arises from the foggy magic of the dead. It likes damp places, but cannot choose where to stay because it is blown away by the wind.
en_grezzo: "A fog-like monster that arises from the foggy magic of the dead. It likes damp places, but cannot choose where to stay because it is blown away by the wind."
it: Un mostro fatto di nebbia, nato dal potere magico disperso dei morti. Predilige i luoghi umidi, ma il vento se lo porta via e il posto dove stare non può sceglierlo.

jp: 魔霧阿
jp_grezzo: "魔霧阿"
en: death fog
en_grezzo: "death fog"
it: la nebbia della morte

jp: 生者に追い縋る巨大な霊。恐るべき執念と力で害をなす存在だが、本当は誰かに救ってほしくて必死に縋りついているだけなのだ。
jp_grezzo: "生者に追い縋る巨大な霊。恐るべき執念と力で害をなす存在だが、本当は誰かに救ってほしくて必死に縋りついているだけなのだ。"
en: A giant spirit that clings to the living. They are harmful with their terrifying obsession and power, but in reality they are just desperately clinging to people because they want someone to save them.
en_grezzo: "A giant spirit that clings to the living. They are harmful with their terrifying obsession and power, but in reality they are just desperately clinging to people because they want someone to save them."
it: Uno spirito enorme che si aggrappa ai vivi. Fa danno con un'ostinazione e una forza spaventose, ma in verità sta solo aggrappandosi con tutte le forze perché vorrebbe che qualcuno lo salvasse.

jp: 縋り死霊
jp_grezzo: "縋り死霊"
en: clinghost
en_grezzo: "clinghost"
it: lo spirito che si aggrappa

jp: 特に何もない普通の家庭の子供だった。無知で無垢で無邪気。それゆえに邪悪な魔物に騙されて冥宮に迷い込んでしまう。
jp_grezzo: "特に何もない普通の家庭の子供だった。無知で無垢で無邪気。それゆえに邪悪な魔物に騙されて冥宮に迷い込んでしまう。"
en: He was a child of a normal family, where nothing particularly went wrong. He is ignorant, pure, and innocent. That's why he's an easy target for deception by demons and often gets lost in the underworld.
en_grezzo: "He was a child of a normal family, where nothing particularly went wrong. He is ignorant, pure, and innocent. That's why he's an easy target for deception by demons and often gets lost in the underworld."
it: Era il bambino di una famiglia normale, senza niente di particolare. Ignorante, puro, innocente. E proprio per questo i mostri malvagi lo ingannano e lo fanno smarrire nel Palazzo Infero.

jp: 迷い子
jp_grezzo: "迷い子"
en: stray soul
en_grezzo: "stray soul"
it: l'anima smarrita

jp: 亜竜最強の座に君臨しているモンスター。凄まじいブレスを吐き、星をも砕くと形容されるほどにパワフルだが、仲間を次々に呼ぶ。最強であろうと己の力に慢心しないことが大事だと、理解しているのだ。
jp_grezzo: "亜竜最強の座に君臨しているモンスター。凄まじいブレスを吐き、星をも砕くと形容されるほどにパワフルだが、仲間を次々に呼ぶ。最強であろうと己の力に慢心しないことが大事だと、理解しているのだ。"
en: A monster that reigns as the strongest of the sub-dragons. He spits out a tremendous breath and is so powerful that he is said to shatter stars, but he also calls upon each one of his allies. He understands that it is important not to be too proud of his power, even if he is the strongest.
en_grezzo: "A monster that reigns as the strongest of the sub-dragons. He spits out a tremendous breath and is so powerful that he is said to shatter stars, but he also calls upon each one of his allies. He understands that it is important not to be too proud of his power, even if he is the strongest."
it: Il mostro che siede sul trono di draco più forte. Sputa un soffio tremendo ed è potente al punto che lo si dice capace di frantumare le stelle, eppure chiama i compagni uno dopo l'altro: ha capito che, per quanto si sia i più forti, non bisogna montarsi la testa.

jp: パワフルワイアーム
jp_grezzo: "パワフルワイアーム"
en: powerful great wyrm
en_grezzo: "powerful great wyrm"
it: il wyrm possente

jp: 電撃を操る翼竜。自力で発電することはできないので、定期的に雷雲の中で充電している。充電しすぎると身体が焦げたり爆発したりするので命懸けらしい。
jp_grezzo: "電撃を操る翼竜。自力で発電することはできないので、定期的に雷雲の中で充電している。充電しすぎると身体が焦げたり爆発したりするので命懸けらしい。"
en: A pterosaur that can control electricity. It can't generate electricity on its own, so it periodically recharges itself by flying through thunderclouds. It is said that it risks his life because his body will be burnt or explode if it overcharges.
en_grezzo: "A pterosaur that can control electricity. It can't generate electricity on its own, so it periodically recharges itself by flying through thunderclouds. It is said that it risks his life because his body will be burnt or explode if it overcharges."
it: Uno pterosauro che manovra le scariche elettriche. Da solo non produce corrente, e allora si ricarica periodicamente dentro le nubi temporalesche. Se si carica troppo il corpo gli si brucia o gli esplode: pare che ci rischi la vita.

jp: プテライウン
jp_grezzo: "プテライウン"
en: pteraiun
en_grezzo: "pteraiun"
it: lo pteraiun

jp: 蛇のような体、竜の頭、蝙蝠の翼を持つ亜竜。性格は凶暴で好戦的。細長いので狭い場所にも入り込んでくる。ただし一度絡まってしまうと自力ではどうにもならず、死を待つばかりとなる。
jp_grezzo: "蛇のような体、竜の頭、蝙蝠の翼を持つ亜竜。性格は凶暴で好戦的。細長いので狭い場所にも入り込んでくる。ただし一度絡まってしまうと自力ではどうにもならず、死を待つばかりとなる。"
en: A sub-dragon with the body of a snake, the head of a dragon, and the wings of a bat. It has a ferocious and belligerent personality. It is long and slender, so it can get into narrow spaces. However, once it gets entangled, it becomes unable to help itself and has no choice but to await death.
en_grezzo: "A sub-dragon with the body of a snake, the head of a dragon, and the wings of a bat. It has a ferocious and belligerent personality. It is long and slender, so it can get into narrow spaces. However, once it gets entangled, it becomes unable to help itself and has no choice but to await death."
it: Un draco con il corpo di serpente, la testa di drago e le ali di pipistrello. Ha un carattere feroce e attaccabrighe. È lungo e sottile, quindi si infila anche negli spazi stretti; ma una volta che si aggroviglia non se ne cava più da solo, e non gli resta che aspettare la morte.

jp: ワイルドワイアーム
jp_grezzo: "ワイルドワイアーム"
en: wild wyrm
en_grezzo: "wild wyrm"
it: il wyrm selvatico

jp: ネズミと共生している珍しい翼竜。運搬能力には自信があるが、気が弱く戦闘が苦手。上空からこいつが獲物を探し、大量のネズミを投下。食べ残しをありがたく頂く。
jp_grezzo: "ネズミと共生している珍しい翼竜。運搬能力には自信があるが、気が弱く戦闘が苦手。上空からこいつが獲物を探し、大量のネズミを投下。食べ残しをありがたく頂く。"
en: A rare pterosaur that coexists with rats. It is confident in its carrying ability, but is weak and not good at fighting. It searches for its prey from above and drops a large number of rats, then gratefully consumes what's left over.
en_grezzo: "A rare pterosaur that coexists with rats. It is confident in its carrying ability, but is weak and not good at fighting. It searches for its prey from above and drops a large number of rats, then gratefully consumes what's left over."
it: Un raro pterosauro che vive in simbiosi con i ratti. Ha fiducia nella propria capacità di trasporto, ma è di animo debole e combattere non fa per lui. Cerca la preda dall'alto e le lascia cadere addosso una valanga di ratti; poi ringrazia e si prende gli avanzi.

jp: ラッツブリンガー
jp_grezzo: "ラッツブリンガー"
en: rats bringer
en_grezzo: "rats bringer"
it: il portaratti

jp: 三つの手からなる邪悪な怪物。こいつと格闘家の攻防を見た吟遊詩人が、その様子を再現して各地で伝えた。後にそれが遊戯となり、この怪物の名前からジャンケンと命名されたという説がある。
jp_grezzo: "三つの手からなる邪悪な怪物。こいつと格闘家の攻防を見た吟遊詩人が、その様子を再現して各地で伝えた。後にそれが遊戯となり、この怪物の名前からジャンケンと命名されたという説がある。"
en: An evil monster with three hands. A bard who saw a fight between this monster and a fighter recreated the scene and passed it around from place to place. Some have said that it later became a game, and was named rock-paper-scissors after the monster.
en_grezzo: "An evil monster with three hands. A bard who saw a fight between this monster and a fighter recreated the scene and passed it around from place to place. Some have said that it later became a game, and was named rock-paper-scissors after the monster."
it: Un mostro malvagio fatto di tre mani. Un menestrello che vide lo scontro fra lui e un lottatore ne rifece la scena e la portò in giro di paese in paese. C'è chi dice che più tardi sia diventata un gioco, e che la morra abbia preso il nome da questo mostro.

jp: 邪拳王
jp_grezzo: "邪拳王"
en: janken king
en_grezzo: "janken king"
it: il re della morra

jp: 力を求めすぎた者の成れの果て。タチの悪い悪魔によって呪いの力を掴まされ、モンスターと成り果てたらしい。手だけになってしまったが本人は割と満足している。
jp_grezzo: "力を求めすぎた者の成れの果て。タチの悪い悪魔によって呪いの力を掴まされ、モンスターと成り果てたらしい。手だけになってしまったが本人は割と満足している。"
en: An incarnation of fateful end of those who seek too much power. It seems that he was given the power of the curse by a demon and became a monster. He has only his hands, but he's rather happy with them.
en_grezzo: "An incarnation of fateful end of those who seek too much power. It seems that he was given the power of the curse by a demon and became a monster. He has only his hands, but he's rather happy with them."
it: Quel che resta di chi ha cercato troppo la forza. Pare che un demone di pessima specie gli abbia messo in mano il potere della maledizione, e che così sia diventato un mostro. Gli sono rimaste soltanto le mani, ma lui è abbastanza soddisfatto.

jp: カースグラップラー
jp_grezzo: "カースグラップラー"
en: curse grappler
en_grezzo: "curse grappler"
it: il lottatore maledetto

jp: あまりに悪さをし過ぎた猫の神が手を切り取られ、そこから生まれた。別名ゴッド猫パンチ。でかい肉球は触り心地抜群。いくら忙しくてもこの手を借りてくるのは大変である。
jp_grezzo: "あまりに悪さをし過ぎた猫の神が手を切り取られ、そこから生まれた。別名ゴッド猫パンチ。でかい肉球は触り心地抜群。いくら忙しくてもこの手を借りてくるのは大変である。"
en: A cat god who misbehaved too much had his hand cut off, and this what became of it. Also known as the God Cat Punch. The big paw is very soft to the touch. No matter how busy you are, it's going to be tricky having this hand on deck.
en_grezzo: "A cat god who misbehaved too much had his hand cut off, and this what became of it. Also known as the God Cat Punch. The big paw is very soft to the touch. No matter how busy you are, it's going to be tricky having this hand on deck."
it: Un dio gatto che aveva fatto troppe malefatte si vide tagliare la zampa, e da lì è nato. Detto anche il Divino Pugno di Gatto. I polpastrelli enormi sono meravigliosi da toccare. Ma per quanto si abbia da fare, farsi prestare questa zampa è un'impresa.

jp: 神猫の手
jp_grezzo: "神猫の手"
en: catgod hand
en_grezzo: "catgod hand"
it: la zampa del gatto divino

jp: 巨大な手の妖怪が人間に憧れて擬態した姿。普段はお洒落して気分よく散歩しているが、獲物を見つけると食欲のほうが勝ってしまう。下半身で鷲掴みにして手のひらにある巨大な口で捕食する。
jp_grezzo: "巨大な手の妖怪が人間に憧れて擬態した姿。普段はお洒落して気分よく散歩しているが、獲物を見つけると食欲のほうが勝ってしまう。下半身で鷲掴みにして手のひらにある巨大な口で捕食する。"
en: A giant hand demon that mimics humans out of admiration for them. It is usually dressed up and goes for a walk when in a good mood, but when it finds prey, its appetite wins out. It grabs the prey with its lower body and preys on it with the huge mouth in the palm of its hand.
en_grezzo: "A giant hand demon that mimics humans out of admiration for them. It is usually dressed up and goes for a walk when in a good mood, but when it finds prey, its appetite wins out. It grabs the prey with its lower body and preys on it with the huge mouth in the palm of its hand."
it: Un demone dalla mano gigantesca che, per ammirazione verso gli uomini, ne ha preso le sembianze. Di solito si fa bella e passeggia di buon umore, ma quando trova una preda l'appetito ha la meglio: la ghermisce con la parte inferiore del corpo e la divora con la bocca enorme che ha nel palmo.

jp: 女郎オオテグチ
jp_grezzo: "女郎オオテグチ"
en: ooteguchi
en_grezzo: "ooteguchi"
it: la cortigiana dalla bocca in mano

jp: 不気味な白い手の集合体。その魔力のこもった手招きに抗うのは難しい。生きる者を恐ろしい力で掴んで根本へ引きずり込もうとする。なんでも根元が地獄に繋がっているのだとか。
jp_grezzo: "不気味な白い手の集合体。その魔力のこもった手招きに抗うのは難しい。生きる者を恐ろしい力で掴んで根本へ引きずり込もうとする。なんでも根元が地獄に繋がっているのだとか。"
en: A collection of eerie white hands. It is difficult to resist their magical beckoning. It grabs the living with its terrifying power and tries to drag them to the root. It is said that its root is connected to hell.
en_grezzo: "A collection of eerie white hands. It is difficult to resist their magical beckoning. It grabs the living with its terrifying power and tries to drag them to the root. It is said that its root is connected to hell."
it: Un ammasso di mani bianche inquietanti. Al loro cenno, carico di potere magico, è difficile resistere. Afferrano i vivi con una forza spaventosa e cercano di trascinarli giù verso la radice. Pare che quella radice arrivi fino all'inferno.

jp: シロマネキ
jp_grezzo: "シロマネキ"
en: pale inviter
en_grezzo: "pale inviter"
it: la mano bianca che chiama

jp: 謎の語り手。本を通して可能性の世界をつなげる能力を持つ。ロストイルヴァ出身だと自称しているが、誰も彼女のことを知らない。おそらく彼女自身も他の世界から来たのだろう。
jp_grezzo: "謎の語り手。本を通して可能性の世界をつなげる能力を持つ。ロストイルヴァ出身だと自称しているが、誰も彼女のことを知らない。おそらく彼女自身も他の世界から来たのだろう。"
en: A mysterious storyteller. She has the ability to connect the world of possibilities through books. She claims to be from Lost Irva, but no one knows who she is. Perhaps she herself is from another world.
en_grezzo: "A mysterious storyteller. She has the ability to connect the world of possibilities through books. She claims to be from Lost Irva, but no one knows who she is. Perhaps she herself is from another world."
it: Una narratrice misteriosa. Ha il potere di collegare fra loro i mondi possibili attraverso i libri. Dice di venire da Irva Perduta, ma nessuno la conosce. Con ogni probabilità viene anche lei da un altro mondo.

jp: ストーリーテラーの『アイメ』
jp_grezzo: "ストーリーテラーの『アイメ』"
en: <Aime> the story teller
en_grezzo: "<Aime> the story teller"
it: <Aime> la narratrice

jp: 神のシステム。人類を監視しカルマを記録する。ただし神視点の基準は割と謎。悪事を見つけても、自分が襲われない限りは基本見ているだけで止めない。「神様はみておるぞ！」と悪事をたしなめる表現があるが、こいつが見ているということである。
jp_grezzo: "神のシステム。人類を監視しカルマを記録する。ただし神視点の基準は割と謎。悪事を見つけても、自分が襲われない限りは基本見ているだけで止めない。「神様はみておるぞ！」と悪事をたしなめる表現があるが、こいつが見ているということである。"
en: Gods' system. They monitor humanity and record their karma. However the standard of Gods' morality is a mystery. Even if they find something wrong they basically just watch and won't stop it unless they are attacked themselves.
en_grezzo: "Gods' system. They monitor humanity and record their karma. However the standard of Gods' morality is a mystery. Even if they find something wrong they basically just watch and won't stop it unless they are attacked themselves."
it: Il sistema delle divinità. Sorveglia il genere umano e ne registra il karma. Il criterio con cui le divinità giudicano, però, è piuttosto oscuro: anche quando scopre una malefatta, di regola si limita a guardare e non interviene, salvo che sia lui a essere aggredito. Quando si rimprovera un cattivo dicendo che le divinità guardano, è proprio lui che guarda.

jp: 監視者の目
jp_grezzo: "監視者の目"
en: seeing god eye
en_grezzo: "seeing god eye"
it: l'occhio del sorvegliante

jp: 全てを見通す知恵や、癒し・修復・再生のシンボル。ホルス神は神々の大戦で敗れており、再生できないよう左目もろとも念入りに粉みじんにされた。しかし左目の無数の欠片が個別に再生し、この魔物が生まれたという。
jp_grezzo: "全てを見通す知恵や、癒し・修復・再生のシンボル。ホルス神は神々の大戦で敗れており、再生できないよう左目もろとも念入りに粉みじんにされた。しかし左目の無数の欠片が個別に再生し、この魔物が生まれたという。"
en: It is a symbol of all-seeing wisdom and healing restoration and renewal. The god Horus was defeated in the Great War of the Gods and his left eye was carefully pulverized so that he could not regenerate. However countless pieces of his left eye regenerated individually and this demon was born.
en_grezzo: "It is a symbol of all-seeing wisdom and healing restoration and renewal. The god Horus was defeated in the Great War of the Gods and his left eye was carefully pulverized so that he could not regenerate. However countless pieces of his left eye regenerated individually and this demon was born."
it: È il simbolo della sapienza che vede ogni cosa, e insieme della guarigione, della riparazione e della rinascita. Il dio Horus fu sconfitto nella grande guerra delle divinità, e perché non potesse rinascere lo ridussero in polvere con cura, l'occhio sinistro compreso. Ma gli innumerevoli frammenti dell'occhio sinistro rinacquero ognuno per conto suo, e così nacque questo mostro.

jp: ホルスアイ
jp_grezzo: "ホルスアイ"
en: horus eye
en_grezzo: "horus eye"
it: l'occhio di Horus

jp: 不気味な目を大量に持つ怪物。目が多いのでこの名前がつけられたが、実際に調べてみると目の個数は百ではないし、個体差もある。全身に急所がついているようなものなので図体の割に打たれ弱い。
jp_grezzo: "不気味な目を大量に持つ怪物。目が多いのでこの名前がつけられたが、実際に調べてみると目の個数は百ではないし、個体差もある。全身に急所がついているようなものなので図体の割に打たれ弱い。"
en: A monster with a large amount of creepy eyes. It was given this name because it has many eyes but it was found that the number of eyes is not a hundred and there are individual differences. It seems like they have sharp points all over their body so their is not easy to be hit considering his size.
en_grezzo: "A monster with a large amount of creepy eyes. It was given this name because it has many eyes but it was found that the number of eyes is not a hundred and there are individual differences. It seems like they have sharp points all over their body so their is not easy to be hit considering his size."
it: Un mostro con una gran quantità di occhi inquietanti. Il nome gli viene dal numero di occhi, ma a contarli davvero non sono cento, e per giunta variano da individuo a individuo. È come se avesse punti deboli su tutto il corpo, e per la mole che ha incassa poco.

jp: 百目の怪
jp_grezzo: "百目の怪"
en: hundred eyes
en_grezzo: "hundred eyes"
it: il mostro dai cento occhi

jp: 生化学文明紀に、神の監視システムを真似て作られた。当時でもタブーな技術だったらしい。空間認識能力は高いが不完全な失敗作。自分を産み出した身勝手な人類に対して激しい憎悪を抱いている。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明紀に、神の監視システムを真似て作られた。当時でもタブーな技術だったらしい。空間認識能力は高いが不完全な失敗作。自分を産み出した身勝手な人類に対して激しい憎悪を抱いている。"
en: It was created in the Biochemical Civilization to imitate God's surveillance system. Apparently it was a taboo technique even back then. It's a flop with high but incomplete spatial awareness. It has a fierce hatred for the selfish humanity that gave birth to him.
en_grezzo: "It was created in the Biochemical Civilization to imitate God's surveillance system. Apparently it was a taboo technique even back then. It's a flop with high but incomplete spatial awareness. It has a fierce hatred for the selfish humanity that gave birth to him."
it: Fu costruito nell'era della civiltà biochimica, imitando il sistema di sorveglianza delle divinità. Pare che già allora fosse una tecnica proibita. Ha una buona percezione dello spazio, ma è un fallimento lasciato a metà. Verso il genere umano che l'ha messo al mondo per capriccio prova un odio feroce.

Amichevole non lo è affatto; però, se le si dice che ha un occhione carino, si ammorbidisce parecchio.

en: A god who calls himself the son of chaos. The arrogant one who wants to destroy all the other gods and reign as the only god in name and reality. His ultimate goal is to reshape the world into a world full of perfect evil.
en_grezzo: "A god who calls himself the son of chaos. The arrogant one who wants to destroy all the other gods and reign as the only god in name and reality. His ultimate goal is to reshape the world into a world full of perfect evil."
it: Un dio che si proclama figlio del caos. Un arrogante che vuole annientare tutte le altre divinità e regnare come dio unico di nome e di fatto. Il suo scopo ultimo è rifare il mondo perché sia colmo di male perfetto.

jp: 混沌の意志から解放されたオルフェ。かつて混沌に挑み、一人だけ生き残らされた英雄。守るべきものも愛するものも亡くしたが、誇りは失っていない。肉体が変質し、不老になっている。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の意志から解放されたオルフェ。かつて混沌に挑み、一人だけ生き残らされた英雄。守るべきものも愛するものも亡くしたが、誇りは失っていない。肉体が変質し、不老になっている。"
en: Orphe is freed from the will of chaos. A hero who once defied chaos and the only one left alive. He has lost everything he had to protect and everything he loved but he has not lost his pride. His body has been transformed and he has become ageless.
en_grezzo: "Orphe is freed from the will of chaos. A hero who once defied chaos and the only one left alive. He has lost everything he had to protect and everything he loved but he has not lost his pride. His body has been transformed and he has become ageless."
it: Orphe liberato dalla volontà del caos. È l'eroe che un tempo sfidò il caos e che, solo fra tutti, fu lasciato in vita. Ha perduto ciò che doveva proteggere e ciò che amava, ma non l'orgoglio. Il suo corpo si è trasformato e non invecchia più.

jp_grezzo: "今まではあくまで歪められたオルフェの意志がベースとなっていたが、本来の肉体に近づいたことで混沌の意志と力が極限にまで強まった。ねじ伏せた黒の剣を手に、目的を果たそうと暗躍する。"
en: Up until now it was based on Orphe's distorted will but as he approached his original body his will and power of chaos was strengthened to the extreme. With a twisted black sword in his hand he strives to achieve his goal.
en_grezzo: "Up until now it was based on Orphe's distorted will but as he approached his original body his will and power of chaos was strengthened to the extreme. With a twisted black sword in his hand he strives to achieve his goal."
it: Finora la base era stata la volontà di Orphe, per quanto piegata; ma via via che si avvicinava al corpo di un tempo, la volontà e la forza del caos si sono rafforzate all'estremo. Con in pugno la spada nera che ha domato, trama nell'ombra per arrivare al suo scopo.

jp_grezzo: "ソピアーの兄姉たちの集合体。深淵より流出したアイオンという神族。超永遠世界から、イルヴァおよびガイアス・ヴィスに移住してきた。超永遠世界の理を使って時間のありように干渉し、止まった時の中でも行動可能。そのため時間神としても扱われる。"
en: A collection of Sophia's brothers and sisters. Aion a race of gods who have flowed out of the abyss. They migrated to Irva and Gaius Vis from the Trans-Eternal World. They can interfere with the existence of time using the logic of the Trans-Eternal World and can act even when it is stopped. Therefore they are also treated as time gods.
en_grezzo: "A collection of Sophia's brothers and sisters. Aion a race of gods who have flowed out of the abyss. They migrated to Irva and Gaius Vis from the Trans-Eternal World. They can interfere with the existence of time using the logic of the Trans-Eternal World and can act even when it is stopped. Therefore they are also treated as time gods."
it: L'insieme dei fratelli e delle sorelle maggiori di Sophia. Sono gli Aion, la stirpe divina defluita dall'abisso. Dal mondo oltre l'eterno sono emigrati a Irva e a Gaius Vis. Con le leggi di quel mondo interferiscono sul modo d'essere del tempo, e possono agire anche dentro il tempo fermo: per questo li si considera anche divinità del tempo.

jp_grezzo: "強力な神々の中の帝王を自称する。戦争に負けることもたまにあったが、それでも雷を象徴する強力無比な英雄神として信仰されていた。大戦時にはゼウスやトール相手に激しい電撃合戦を繰り広げたという。"

Prima della grande guerra delle divinità la sfruttò a fondo per muovere guerra a Vishnu e a Indra, e se la cavò piuttosto bene. Nella grande guerra fu sconfitto da un demone che non era né divinità né spirito, e si trasformò in mostro.

it: Il figlio di Shiva, il dio della distruzione. Era stato dato a balia, e quando si ritrovarono chiese in sposa, senza saperlo, la moglie di Shiva: ne venne una guerra. Nella grande guerra delle divinità si riconciliarono e combatterono insieme, ma a metà scontro suo padre si trasformò in cane; sconvolto da quell'imprevisto, si scoprì e fu battuto.

They are produced in countless numbers but because they are small and weak they tend to be used as bait for fish and as a snack for fishermen. It is said that an individual that miraculously survives and grows up will become a being with high intelligence and magical powers.

it: Una schiera che, si dice, genera il dio addormentato negli abissi marini. Ne nascono a migliaia, ma sono piccole e deboli, e finiscono spesso come esca per i pesci o stuzzichino per i pescatori. L'esemplare che per miracolo sopravvive e cresce diventa, dicono, un essere di grande intelligenza e grande potere magico.

Il punto debole è il calore forte. Sul cadavere non restano né veleno né capacità di parassitare, quindi si può stare tranquilli.

en: This mushroom is particularly fond of places with high moisture content. They protect themselves from external enemies by spraying water or disorient them with fog. It is especially dangerous if it is growing in clusters. As it is it's watery and not very tasty.
en_grezzo: "This mushroom is particularly fond of places with high moisture content. They protect themselves from external enemies by spraying water or disorient them with fog. It is especially dangerous if it is growing in clusters. As it is it's watery and not very tasty."
it: Un fungo che predilige i posti pieni d'acqua. Si difende dai nemici spruzzando getti d'acqua o confondendoli con la nebbia. Quando cresce in colonie è particolarmente pericoloso: attenzione. Così com'è sa d'acqua e non è granché buono.

jp_grezzo: "様々なきのこの集合体。その正体はきのこの菌糸に操られた、別の生物の死体である。栄養を求め、鋭い牙で生きとし生けるものに食らいつくケダモノ。"

en_grezzo: "A collection of various mushrooms. It is the corpse of another creature controlled by mushroom mycelium. A beast that seeks nourishment and devours all living things with its sharp fangs."
it: Un insieme di funghi di ogni sorta. In verità è il cadavere di un'altra creatura, manovrato dal micelio dei funghi. Una belva che cerca nutrimento e azzanna con le zanne aguzze tutto ciò che vive.

Evolvendosi si è adattato al combattimento aereo e si è dotato di una grande unità di volo a forma d'ala.

en_grezzo: "A girl who loves flowers. It was her daily routine to eat freshly baked bread from a general store in Raskilis and then go flower picking. She seems to be quite familiar with flowers and even knows their medicinal and poisonous properties."
it: Una ragazza che ama i fiori. Mangiare il pane appena sfornato della merceria di Raskilis e poi darsi alla raccolta dei fiori era la sua giornata di sempre. Di fiori se ne intende parecchio: conosce anche le proprietà curative e quelle velenose.

jp: これまで様々な冒険を繰り広げて来た。好奇心に駆られて突っ走るので、痛い目にあうことも多い。しかし何度失敗しても冒険への意欲を全く失わない。一応、相棒のマンソンの忠告は素直に聞く。

en: He has had a lot of adventures so far. He is often hurt because he is driven by curiosity and rushes through. But no matter how many times he fails he never loses his appetite for adventure. For the record he takes the advice of his partner Manson very seriously.
en_grezzo: "He has had a lot of adventures so far. He is often hurt because he is driven by curiosity and rushes through. But no matter how many times he fails he never loses his appetite for adventure. For the record he takes the advice of his partner Manson very seriously."

it: Una specie di orco potenziata e migliorata, creata dagli stregoni. Ha un corpo grande e tenace. Di testa non è granché, e c'è ancora parecchio da migliorare.

it: Un orco dall'anima completamente corrotta. Ha la pelle scura e lo sguardo feroce. Si vede a occhio che è malvagio, e per questo perfino gli orchi comuni lo tengono a distanza.

en: Unlike the porc that grew up in the wild these elites grew up in a well-groomed environment. They look down on the average porc. The meat clearly tasted fancy.
en_grezzo: "Unlike the porc that grew up in the wild these elites grew up in a well-groomed environment. They look down on the average porc. The meat clearly tasted fancy."
it: A differenza dei porc cresciuti alla buona da qualche parte, questo è un esemplare scelto, allevato in un ambiente curato. Guarda dall'alto in basso i porc comuni. La carne ha chiaramente un sapore da prodotto di pregio.

en: They were born to an orc and a boar. They have a strong libido and are always naked. In addition when in heat they have a habit of attacking orcs. For this reason it is said to be treated as a beast by orcs. The meat is refreshing and delicious.
en_grezzo: "They were born to an orc and a boar. They have a strong libido and are always naked. In addition when in heat they have a habit of attacking orcs. For this reason it is said to be treated as a beast by orcs. The meat is refreshing and delicious."
it: È nato da un orco e un cinghiale. Ha un forte appetito sessuale ed è sempre nudo. Per giunta, quando va in calore, ha l'abitudine di assalire gli orchi. Per questo, pare, gli orchi lo trattano da bestia. La carne è leggera e buona.

jp: 釣りだけが人生の楽しみだと語る男。その背中はどこか哀愁を感じさせるが、彼の詳しい過去を知る者はいない。世界が終わるその日まで、釣りをして過ごすのだろう。
jp_grezzo: "釣りだけが人生の楽しみだと語る男。その背中はどこか哀愁を感じさせるが、彼の詳しい過去を知る者はいない。世界が終わるその日まで、釣りをして過ごすのだろう。"
en: The man says that fishing is the only thing he enjoys about life. His past is not known in detail though his background is somehow melancholy. He''ll spend the rest of his days fishing until the day the world ends.
en_grezzo: "The man says that fishing is the only thing he enjoys about life. His past is not known in detail though his background is somehow melancholy. He''ll spend the rest of his days fishing until the day the world ends."
it: Un uomo che dice che la pesca è l'unico piacere della sua vita. La sua schiena ha un che di malinconico, ma nessuno conosce il suo passato nei dettagli. Passerà a pescare anche l'ultimo giorno del mondo.

en: A woman who was unable to stay in her hometown due to the devastation of Etherwind and moved to Zaile after drifting from place to place. But when Zaile also ceased to be functional as a city she gave up on it and now moved to a campground.
en_grezzo: "A woman who was unable to stay in her hometown due to the devastation of Etherwind and moved to Zaile after drifting from place to place. But when Zaile also ceased to be functional as a city she gave up on it and now moved to a campground."

en: Kobold Saber with even more shooting power. Its sword-like spine is further developed yet it is characterized by an even longer tail. It may be that it's still in its infancy but it's too long and can be out of balance.

en: In the pursuit of power kobold surrenders to evil. It has black armor and a respectable horn. They're usually powerful yet they can still move fast and use brainwashing sound waves.
en_grezzo: "In the pursuit of power kobold surrenders to evil. It has black armor and a respectable horn. They're usually powerful yet they can still move fast and use brainwashing sound waves."

jp_grezzo: "デュークコボルト"

en: The awesome kobold is powered up with lightning bolts. His physical abilities have increased dramatically and he is feared by ordinary kobolds as the incarnation of lightning.
en_grezzo: "The awesome kobold is powered up with lightning bolts. His physical abilities have increased dramatically and he is feared by ordinary kobolds as the incarnation of lightning."
it: Uno straordinario coboldo potenziato da una scarica di fulmini. Le sue capacità fisiche sono cresciute di colpo, e i coboldi comuni lo temono come l'incarnazione del fulmine.

jp_grezzo: "ライトニングコボルト"

en_grezzo: "lightning kobold"
it: il coboldo fulmineo

en: Kobold Saber stands out with their large sword-like horn. However this horn is used as a sensor not a weapon. What is truly remarkable is the special three claws. Apparently it has evolved into a shape suitable for using a gun.
en_grezzo: "Kobold Saber stands out with their large sword-like horn. However this horn is used as a sensor not a weapon. What is truly remarkable is the special three claws. Apparently it has evolved into a shape suitable for using a gun."

jp: コボルトセイバー
jp_grezzo: "コボルトセイバー"

en_grezzo: "kobold saber"
it: il coboldo sciabolatore

jp_grezzo: "コボルトの中でも特に強い毒を持つ種類。真っ青な体は見てるぶんには綺麗。全身から毒素を噴出して狩りに利用する習性がある。"
en: The most poisonous kind of kobolds. The blue body is beautiful enough to see. It has a habit of exuding toxins from its body to be used for hunting.
en_grezzo: "The most poisonous kind of kobolds. The blue body is beautiful enough to see. It has a habit of exuding toxins from its body to be used for hunting."
it: La specie di coboldo con il veleno più forte di tutte. Il corpo azzurro intenso, a guardarlo, è bello. Ha l'abitudine di far uscire tossine da tutto il corpo e di servirsene per cacciare.

jp: コボルトブルー
jp_grezzo: "コボルトブルー"
en: kobold blue
en_grezzo: "kobold blue"
it: il coboldo blu

jp_grezzo: "コボルトの変種。人間の遺伝子が一部入っているせいか、特有のいかつさがない。コボルト族からは気持ち悪がられ、人間からは人狼と間違えられて駆除される。周りを敵だらけと思い込み常に怯えている。"
en: A variant of kobold. Maybe it's because it has some human genes in it but it doesn't have a peculiar ugliness. The kobolds hate it and the humans mistake it for a werewolf and exterminate it. They are always frightened because they think they are surrounded by enemies.
en_grezzo: "A variant of kobold. Maybe it's because it has some human genes in it but it doesn't have a peculiar ugliness. The kobolds hate it and the humans mistake it for a werewolf and exterminate it. They are always frightened because they think they are surrounded by enemies."
it: Una variante del coboldo. Forse perché ha dentro qualche gene umano, le manca la durezza tipica della specie. I coboldi la trovano disgustosa; gli uomini la scambiano per una licantropa e la sterminano. Convinta di essere circondata da nemici, vive in un terrore continuo.

jp: コボリナ

en: Bacterial life forms are roaming the universe in search of energy. It will eat both organic and inorganic substances and try to take them in. Be careful as they approach you with a large army.
en_grezzo: "Bacterial life forms are roaming the universe in search of energy. It will eat both organic and inorganic substances and try to take them in. Be careful as they approach you with a large army."
it: Una forma di vita batterica che vaga per l'universo in cerca di energia. Divora e assorbe senza problemi tanto la materia organica quanto quella inorganica. Attenzione, perché avanza a passo lento e in grandi eserciti.

jp_grezzo: "宇宙の侵略者"

en_grezzo: "universe invader"
it: l'invasore dell'universo

jp_grezzo: "ゴーレムの技術を応用した人形。人形の意思でパーツを魔力変形させることができ、この機構がシームレスな表情変化を実現している。漏れた魔力が作用して髪の毛が少しずつ伸びることもあるが、不気味がらないように。"
en: This is a doll based on the technology of a golem. The doll's parts can be magically transformed at will and this mechanism allows for seamless facial changes. The leaked magic may act on your hair and cause it to grow a little bit but don't be scared.
en_grezzo: "This is a doll based on the technology of a golem. The doll's parts can be magically transformed at will and this mechanism allows for seamless facial changes. The leaked magic may act on your hair and cause it to grow a little bit but don't be scared."
it: Una bambola costruita applicando la tecnica dei golem. Con la propria volontà può deformare magicamente i pezzi di cui è fatta, e questo meccanismo le permette di cambiare espressione senza stacchi. Può capitare che il potere magico che sfugge le faccia crescere i capelli a poco a poco, ma non c'è da spaventarsi.

jp: ビスクドール
jp_grezzo: "ビスクドール"
en: bisque doll
en_grezzo: "bisque doll"

jp_grezzo: "鳩の姿をした調停者。長きに渡る争いの歴史に疲れ果て、全ての生命を根絶することでしか真の平和は実現できないという結論に達した。平和のためなら核弾頭も使うタカ派。"
en: A mediator in the form of a pigeon. Exhausted by a long history of strife they have come to the conclusion that true peace can only be achieved through the eradication of all life. They are hawks who will use nuclear warheads for the sake of peace.
en_grezzo: "A mediator in the form of a pigeon. Exhausted by a long history of strife they have come to the conclusion that true peace can only be achieved through the eradication of all life. They are hawks who will use nuclear warheads for the sake of peace."
it: Un mediatore in forma di colomba. Sfinito da una storia di lotte lunghissima, è arrivato alla conclusione che la vera pace si ottiene solo estirpando ogni forma di vita. È un falco: per la pace userebbe anche le testate nucleari.

jp: ピースメーカー
jp_grezzo: "ピースメーカー"

en_grezzo: "peace maker"

jp_grezzo: "大きな体と発達した筋肉を持つ飛べない鳥。遥か昔その力を恐れた神によって飛べなくされたと本気で主張している。ペンギンやキウイの仲間扱いされると怒るので注意。"
en: A flightless bird with a large body and well-developed muscles. They seriously believe that long ago they were made unable to fly by a god who feared their power. Be careful not to offend them by treating them like penguins or kiwis.
en_grezzo: "A flightless bird with a large body and well-developed muscles. They seriously believe that long ago they were made unable to fly by a god who feared their power. Be careful not to offend them by treating them like penguins or kiwis."
it: Un uccello che non vola, con un corpo grande e muscoli ben sviluppati. Sostiene sul serio che in un tempo lontanissimo una divinità, temendo la sua forza, gli tolse il volo. Attenzione a non farlo arrabbiare trattandolo da parente del pinguino o del kiwi.

jp: 堕鳥
jp_grezzo: "堕鳥"

en_grezzo: "fallen bird"

jp_grezzo: "森に棲むフクロウの魔物。ただでさえ目と耳が良いのに、首を270度回して多方向をカバーする。その探知力と知能の高さから狙われると非常に危険。"
en: An owl demon that lives in the forest. Even though he has good eyes and ears he still turns his neck 270 degrees to cover multiple directions. It is very dangerous when targeting from up high with its detection power and intelligence.
en_grezzo: "An owl demon that lives in the forest. Even though he has good eyes and ears he still turns his neck 270 degrees to cover multiple directions. It is very dangerous when targeting from up high with its detection power and intelligence."
it: Un mostro-gufo che vive nel bosco. Ha già occhi e orecchie eccellenti, e per giunta gira il collo di duecentosettanta gradi e copre più direzioni insieme. Per quella capacità di individuare e per l'intelligenza che ha, esserne presi di mira è pericolosissimo.

jp: 森の暗殺者
jp_grezzo: "森の暗殺者"
en: forest assassin

The mission is to rewind the distortions by force termination before they are recorded. One who appears in every space time dimension everywhere and finally takes to the skies.
en_grezzo: "The guardian angel of the Akashic Records. Apparently when distortions accumulate in the world one releases one's true power. it: L'angelo che fa la guardia alla rete akashica. Pare che, quando nel mondo si accumulano le distorsioni, liberi la sua vera potenza. La sua missione è riavvolgere le distorsioni con un arresto forzato prima che vengano registrate. Compare in ogni spazio, in ogni tempo, in ogni dimensione... ed è colui che alla fine danza nel cielo.

en: Triceratops has been slightly exposed to the pollution waves unleashed by quantum biological weapons. The limbs and horns are beginning to degenerate slightly and parts of the body are fusing with the machine. Just thinking about what would have happened if I had been immersed in the waves is terrifying.

Zampe e corna hanno cominciato a regredire un poco alla volta, e una parte del corpo si è fusa con la macchina. A pensare che cosa sarebbe successo se si fosse immerso del tutto in quell'onda, viene paura.

jp: 生化学文明に滅亡が迫る中、遺伝子調整で作られた。エーテルを好む性質と再生能力が強化されており、エーテル源の守護者となるはずだった存在。エーテルが好きすぎて独占しようと他生物を殺し始めたり、好きすぎて森を食べようとしたりしたので、失敗作として封印された。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明に滅亡が迫る中、遺伝子調整で作られた。エーテルを好む性質と再生能力が強化されており、エーテル源の守護者となるはずだった存在。エーテルが好きすぎて独占しようと他生物を殺し始めたり、好きすぎて森を食べようとしたりしたので、失敗作として封印された。"
en: It was created by genetic adjustments in the midst of the impending doom of a biochemical civilization. A being with enhanced ether-loving qualities and regenerative abilities and who was supposed to be the guardian of the etheric source. They liked the ether so much that they started killing other creatures to monopolize it and they liked it so much that they tried to eat the entire world so it was sealed as a failure.
en_grezzo: "It was created by genetic adjustments in the midst of the impending doom of a biochemical civilization. A being with enhanced ether-loving qualities and regenerative abilities and who was supposed to be the guardian of the etheric source. it: Fu creata per aggiustamento genetico mentre sulla civiltà biochimica incombeva la fine. Le avevano rafforzato l'attrazione per l'etere e la capacità di rigenerarsi, e sarebbe dovuta diventare la guardiana della sorgente d'etere. Ma l'etere le piaceva talmente che si mise a uccidere le altre creature per averlo tutto, e talmente che provò a mangiarsi la foresta: così la sigillarono come esemplare mal riuscito.

Quando i saccheggiatori di rovine lo svegliarono per curiosità, li polverizzò con la coda maestosa e scappò. Sa emettere onde gravitazionali, ma le controlla male, e si trova in imbarazzo perché schiaccia quello che ha attorno.

en: Normally they live in the ocean as adults but sometimes they ascend from the sea to the sky at sunrise. It is said that in ancient times there were individuals so huge that when they lay in the sea their bodies would protrude from the surface.
en_grezzo: "Normally they live in the ocean as adults but sometimes they ascend from the sea to the sky at sunrise. It is said that in ancient times there were individuals so huge that when they lay in the sea their bodies would protrude from the surface."

Un tempo si scatenava solo per il gusto di battersi con i forti; adesso è consapevole delle sue colpe nella grande guerra e lavora sul serio dietro le quinte. Se Ehekatl tratta da gatto il giaguaro che ha ai suoi ordini, gli si guasta subito l'umore.

He has a history of devouring people to fill his empty self and destroying two small villages. He was defeated by the founder of the seminar and was made a mascot forcibly but now he seems to be living a pretty fulfilling life.

Per riempire il proprio vuoto andò avanti a divorare gente, e ha alle spalle due piccoli villaggi rasi al suolo. Sconfitto dalla fondatrice del Seminario, fu fatto mascotte a forza, ma pare che oggi passi giornate abbastanza appagate.

jp_grezzo: "冒険者生活が面白いと聞き自分もなってみたのはいいが、色々と複雑で混乱している。注意力が散漫で、体調の悪さに気が付かなかったり説明を読み飛ばしたり注釈を見落としたり固有名詞を間違えて覚えたりする。"

Ha l'attenzione che gli va dove vuole: non si accorge di stare male, salta le spiegazioni, si lascia sfuggire le note e i nomi propri se li impara sbagliati.

en_grezzo: "Even while on active duty he was concerned about the declining quality of warriors. When his daughter became a full-fledged member of the family he let her take over his family's dojo and I became a seminar instructor to teach her from a fundamental point of view."

È una maniaca di oggetti, e si dice che in casa abbia collezioni d'ogni genere. Capita spesso che quella che doveva essere una passeggiata e basta finisca in una raccolta di oggetti.

Il soprannome che gli hanno messo, a dire il vero, gli piace.

Quello che proprio non sopporta sono gli unicorni.

An eccentric who gets excited about the fact that something from his own mine has been processed to such an extent that it no longer resembles its original form and is now in the hands of people he doesn't know well. it: Il padrone della più grande miniera di platino del mondo. Un tipo strambo che si entusiasma all'idea che quel che esce dalla sua miniera venga lavorato fino a non somigliare più a niente, passi in mano a gente che lui non conosce e finisca in uso da qualche parte. In casa alleva per passatempo una quantità di oche.

Se abbracciandola le senti la schiena ruvida in modo sospetto, o se ti capita una sedicente ragazza dei boschi a cui spuntano rami dalla schiena, quella nove volte su dieci è lei.

en: After losing his wife in the war he fled his hometown in search of a way to end the conflict. While wandering around the country with his daughter he met Vallius and sympathized with his ideas. I'm a little glad I'm walking with my daughter and being mistaken for a brother.

jp_grezzo: "機械文明の最終戦争で使われた戦車。猫を思わせる程に運動性が高く、戦闘機や人型兵器を震え上がらせた。後継機は更なる超運動性を目指したが、敵への印象操作のためあえてマンモスと名付けられた。"
en: A tank used in the final war of a mechanical civilization. It was so agile that it reminded me of a cat and it made fighters and humanoid weapons tremble. Its successor aimed to be even more mobile but was purposely named Mammoth in order to fool the enemy.
en_grezzo: "A tank used in the final war of a mechanical civilization. It was so agile that it reminded me of a cat and it made fighters and humanoid weapons tremble. Its successor aimed to be even more mobile but was purposely named Mammoth in order to fool the enemy."
it: Un carro armato usato nella guerra finale della civiltà meccanica. Aveva una mobilità così alta da far pensare a un gatto, e faceva tremare i caccia e le armi dalla forma umana. Il modello che venne dopo puntava a una mobilità ancora più spinta, ma lo chiamarono apposta Mammut per far credere al nemico il contrario.

Resta agli atti che sconfisse a viso aperto i veicoli da combattimento dell'epoca. Ha una funzione di adattamento all'ambiente, e anche nel peggiore dei cantieri non si scompone.

en: A mass-produced walking machine in the heights of a mechanical civilization. A person can get in the head. It was used for propaganda to spread the splendor of the machine but it also boasted the sturdiness and limb strength of a military-grade aircraft.

jp_grezzo: "機械文明初期に使われていた主力兵器。装甲は薄いが軽量で小回りが利き、悪路にも強い。他の戦闘兵器が発達した後でも、かなりの数が自律回路を更新して長く運用されていたらしい。"

Apparently quite a few had been operating long after other combat weapons had been developed with updated autonomous circuits.

Pare che, anche molto dopo che le altre armi da combattimento si erano evolute, parecchi esemplari abbiano aggiornato i circuiti autonomi e siano rimasti in servizio a lungo.

it: È della famiglia del Cub, ma è grossa e sa tirare fuori una bella velocità. Rispetto al Cub ha vita più breve, ed è permalosa e ruvida. Dà il suo daffare, ma se il Cub lo conosci già e quello che cerchi è la velocità, tenerne una può valere la pena.

jp: 良くも悪くもまっすぐなエレアの青年。正義感の強かった亡き父に憧れ、森の自警団に所属していた。かつて各国の軍が森へ侵攻してきた際には、即席の妨害部隊を結成し最後まで地味に抵抗を続けていたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "良くも悪くもまっすぐなエレアの青年。正義感の強かった亡き父に憧れ、森の自警団に所属していた。かつて各国の軍が森へ侵攻してきた際には、即席の妨害部隊を結成し最後まで地味に抵抗を続けていたらしい。"
en: For better or worse this young man is a straightforward Elean. Admiring his late father who had a strong sense of justice he was a member of the forest vigilante group. In the past when armies from various countries invaded the forest they formed an impromptu interdiction squad and steadfastly resisted until the end.
en_grezzo: "For better or worse this young man is a straightforward Elean. Admiring his late father who had a strong sense of justice he was a member of the forest vigilante group. In the past when armies from various countries invaded the forest they formed an impromptu interdiction squad and steadfastly resisted until the end."
it: Un giovane Elea tutto d'un pezzo, nel bene e nel male. Ammirava il padre morto, che aveva un forte senso della giustizia, e stava nella ronda del bosco. Quando in passato gli eserciti di più paesi entrarono nel bosco, pare che abbia messo insieme su due piedi un reparto di disturbo e abbia continuato a resistere in sordina fino all'ultimo.

it: L'arma non morta di grado più alto in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. Si credeva che non ne esistessero più, ma di recente ne è comparsa una dalle rovine antiche di Eulderna, insieme ad altre armi. Si dice che abbia distrutto tutto quello che poteva finché una donna non è riuscita a tenerla a freno.

jp_grezzo: "事故で人間並みの知性を手に入れたが、代償に理性が欠如したイーク。それゆえに悪魔や邪神の強大さに簡単に魅入られてしまった。他のイークたちからは、近寄るとヤバイやつだと認識されている。"
en: In an accident he gains human-level intelligence but at the cost of his mind losing his reason. That's why he was so easily enchanted by the mighty power of demons and evil gods. The other yeeks recognize him as a dangerous individual if he gets close to them.

it: Specie antica degli yeek. Ha il potere di comandare la stirpe degli yeek, di qualunque tipo siano. Coltiva l'ambizione solenne di fondare uno stato degli yeek, per opera degli yeek e a vantaggio degli yeek, ma su come farlo davvero non ci ha ancora pensato.

en: He used to be a terrible slob. However after risking his life to conquer one of the Nefian dungeons he had a change of heart. He has awakened to the joy of adventure and is still working as a ruins vandal today.
en_grezzo: "He used to be a terrible slob. However after risking his life to conquer one of the Nefian dungeons he had a change of heart. He has awakened to the joy of adventure and is still working as a ruins vandal today."

jp_grezzo: "イークの働き者"
en: yeek hard worker

it: lo yeek lavoratore

jp_grezzo: "実家に縛られるのを嫌い幼い頃に家出。放浪中に誤って裏の業界へ踏み入ってしまうが、記憶力と洞察力で賭博に逆転勝利し生き残った。その後スリルを求めて裏の仕事に携わる中、一人の行き倒れに出会う。"
en: She ran away from home at an early age because she hated being tied to her parents' home. While wandering she accidentally ventured into the underworld but survived by winning the gamble to regain her memory and insight. Later while working behind the scenes in search of thrills he meets a man who has fallen.
en_grezzo: "She ran away from home at an early age because she hated being tied to her parents' home. While wandering she accidentally ventured into the underworld but survived by winning the gamble to regain her memory and insight. Later while working behind the scenes in search of thrills he meets a man who has fallen."
it: Non sopportava di stare legata alla casa di famiglia, e da piccola scappò via. Mentre girava senza meta mise per sbaglio piede nel giro losco, ma con la memoria e l'intuito ribaltò la partita al gioco d'azzardo e ne uscì viva. Poi, mentre si dava ai lavori sporchi per il gusto del rischio, si imbatté in una persona stramazzata per strada.

jp_grezzo: "別名、クイックリングの仕事人。小さい体を活かして闇に紛れ、標的を待ち伏せする。そして糸を自在に操って目にもとまらぬ速さで標的を惨殺するのだ。その腕前は鮮やか。"
en: Also known as a quickling workman. He uses his small body to blend in with the darkness and ambush his targets. He then manipulates the string to slaughter the target with uncanny speed. His skills are superb.
en_grezzo: "Also known as a quickling workman. He uses his small body to blend in with the darkness and ambush his targets. He then manipulates the string to slaughter the target with uncanny speed. His skills are superb."
it: Lo chiamano anche il professionista dei quickling. Sfrutta il corpo piccolo per confondersi col buio e aspetta il bersaglio all'agguato. Poi manovra i fili come vuole e lo fa a pezzi a una velocità che l'occhio non segue. Un lavoro pulito.

en: This special quickling is created by a storm of miasma that blew into a remote area of the underworld. They've felt a sense of destiny after hearing that there was a black sword called Stormbringer from rumors in the wind.
en_grezzo: "This special quickling is created by a storm of miasma that blew into a remote area of the underworld. They've felt a sense of destiny after hearing that there was a black sword called Stormbringer from rumors in the wind."
it: Un quickling speciale, che nasce dentro le tempeste di miasma che si dice infurino nelle terre remote dell'oltretomba. Da quando il vento gli ha portato la voce che esiste una spada nera chiamata Stormbringer, si sente addosso qualcosa che somiglia a un destino.

jp: ストームブリング
jp_grezzo: "ストームブリング"
en: stormbling
en_grezzo: "stormbling"
it: il tempestello

jp: 草原を駆ける小人。尋常でない脚力を持ち、足を一振りするだけで衝撃波が発生する。代償として生まれつき膝に爆弾を抱えており、全力で走ったり蹴ったりすると反動に耐え切れずに破裂してしまう難儀な生物。
jp_grezzo: "草原を駆ける小人。尋常でない脚力を持ち、足を一振りするだけで衝撃波が発生する。代償として生まれつき膝に爆弾を抱えており、全力で走ったり蹴ったりすると反動に耐え切れずに破裂してしまう難儀な生物。"
en: A midget running through a meadow. It has extraordinary leg strength and a shockwave is generated with a single swing of the leg. As a quid pro quo it was born with a charge in its knee and if it runs or kicks with all its might it will be unable to withstand the recoil and explode.
en_grezzo: "A midget running through a meadow. It has extraordinary leg strength and a shockwave is generated with a single swing of the leg. As a quid pro quo it was born with a charge in its knee and if it runs or kicks with all its might it will be unable to withstand the recoil and explode."
it: Un ometto che corre per le praterie. Ha nelle gambe una forza fuori dal comune, e gli basta un colpo di piede per sollevare un'onda d'urto. Il prezzo lo paga alla nascita: ha una carica esplosiva nel ginocchio, e se corre o calcia a tutta forza non regge il contraccolpo e scoppia. Una creatura scomoda.

jp: グラスキラー
jp_grezzo: "グラスキラー"
en: grass killer
en_grezzo: "grass killer"
it: l'ammazzaerba

jp: クイックリングの近縁種。草原で踊り狂う小人。手先が器用で陽気な性格。普段はステップが速すぎてどんな踊りなのかよくわからないが、時折見せる魅力的な動作と妖しい視線は、観客の心を一瞬で惑わす。
jp_grezzo: "クイックリングの近縁種。草原で踊り狂う小人。手先が器用で陽気な性格。普段はステップが速すぎてどんな踊りなのかよくわからないが、時折見せる魅力的な動作と妖しい視線は、観客の心を一瞬で惑わす。"
en: A close relative of Quickling. A midget dancing in the meadow. He has a dexterous hand and a cheerful personality. Usually the steps are too fast to know what kind of dance they are doing but sometimes their charming movements and mysterious gazes will bewitch the audience in an instant.
en_grezzo: "A close relative of Quickling. A midget dancing in the meadow. He has a dexterous hand and a cheerful personality. Usually the steps are too fast to know what kind of dance they are doing but sometimes their charming movements and mysterious gazes will bewitch the audience in an instant."
it: Parente stretto del quickling. Un ometto che balla come un forsennato nelle praterie. Ha le mani abili e il carattere allegro. Di solito i passi vanno troppo veloci per capire che ballo sia, ma i gesti pieni di grazia che si lascia sfuggire ogni tanto, e quello sguardo ambiguo, confondono il pubblico in un istante.

jp: グラスダンサー
jp_grezzo: "グラスダンサー"
en: grass dancer
en_grezzo: "grass dancer"
it: il danzaerba

jp: ザナンの秘密実験施設で酷使されていた兵士。脱出・亡命できたのはいいが身体の異状に悩まされていた。ロスリアで最近開発された緩和薬によって、能力はやや落ちるものの安定性を手に入れた模様。
jp_grezzo: "ザナンの秘密実験施設で酷使されていた兵士。脱出・亡命できたのはいいが身体の異状に悩まされていた。ロスリアで最近開発された緩和薬によって、能力はやや落ちるものの安定性を手に入れた模様。"
en: A soldier who has been subjected to harsh treatment at a secret experimental facility in Zanan. He was able to flee and defect but he was suffering from a physical disorder. With the recent development of a palliative in Lothria he seems to have gained stability although his abilities are slightly less.
en_grezzo: "A soldier who has been subjected to harsh treatment at a secret experimental facility in Zanan. He was able to flee and defect but he was suffering from a physical disorder. With the recent development of a palliative in Lothria he seems to have gained stability although his abilities are slightly less."
it: Un soldato sfruttato fino all'osso nel centro sperimentale segreto di Zanan. Fuggire e passare dall'altra parte gli è riuscito, ma il corpo gli è rimasto guasto e non gli dava pace. Pare che con il farmaco lenitivo messo a punto di recente a Lothria abbia guadagnato stabilità, in cambio di un po' di quello che sa fare.

jp: ザナン強化兵
jp_grezzo: "ザナン強化兵"
en: zanan enhanced soldier
en_grezzo: "zanan enhanced soldier"
it: il soldato potenziato di Zanan

jp: 熟練した兵士だったが寄る年波には勝てないと判断され、とっくの昔に軍を強制引退させられている。血で汚れすぎた自分は戦場でしか生きられないと悟り、他国へ亡命。経験を買われ再就職できた。

en: He was a skilled soldier but he was forced out of the army long ago when it was decided that he was no match given to his age. He realizes that he has become too stained with blood and can only live on the battlefield so he goes into exile in another country. He was able to re-enter the workforce because of his experience.
en_grezzo: "He was a skilled soldier but he was forced out of the army long ago when it was decided that he was no match given to his age. it: Era un soldato provetto, ma decisero che contro il peso degli anni non c'era niente da fare e da un pezzo lo misero in congedo a forza. Capito che ormai si era sporcato di troppo sangue e che vivere poteva solo sul campo di battaglia, se n'è andato in un altro paese. L'esperienza gliel'hanno comprata volentieri, e ha trovato un altro ingaggio.

jp: 歴戦の老兵
jp_grezzo: "歴戦の老兵"
en: zanan old soldier
en_grezzo: "zanan old soldier"
it: il veterano

jp: 看護疲れをこじらせ、殺人の快楽に目覚めたナース。機関銃を乱射して連続殺人を繰り返す。殺した後に慈愛の心が一瞬だけ蘇り、死体に優しく接する。
jp_grezzo: "看護疲れをこじらせ、殺人の快楽に目覚めたナース。機関銃を乱射して連続殺人を繰り返す。殺した後に慈愛の心が一瞬だけ蘇り、死体に優しく接する。"
en: The nurses tire of nursing and awaken to the pleasures of murder. They fire a machine gun and go on a series of murders. Their compassionate hearts revived for a moment after the killing and they treat the corpse gently.
en_grezzo: "The nurses tire of nursing and awaken to the pleasures of murder. They fire a machine gun and go on a series of murders. Their compassionate hearts revived for a moment after the killing and they treat the corpse gently."
it: Un'infermiera che, a furia di stancarsi nel curare, si è risvegliata al piacere di uccidere. Spara raffiche di mitragliatrice e ammazza a ripetizione. Dopo il colpo, per un istante, il cuore pietoso le torna: e allora tratta il cadavere con dolcezza.

en_grezzo: "killer nurse"
it: l'infermiera assassina

en: Daughter of the former Commander of the Knights of Lothria. Although her father kept her from fighting she became a corpsman at her own insistence. it: Figlia del precedente comandante dell'ordine cavalleresco di Lothria. Il padre la teneva lontana dai combattimenti, ma lei ha voluto a tutti i costi fare almeno l'infermiera di reparto. Mentre lui era via in missione le è sbocciato un talento notevole per la battaglia, e si è arrampicata fino a comandante facente funzione. I capelli ribelli, quelli sì, li ha presi in famiglia, e le danno pensiero.

en: <Lankata> the lightning of blue

en: The parent company is the Knights of Lothria which was disbanded when Vallius was deposed. He was secretly recalled with the return of Vallius and carried out various missions in the shadows. He wears a modified version of the magical armor that came in from Eulderna.
en_grezzo: "The parent company is the Knights of Lothria which was disbanded when Vallius was deposed. He was secretly recalled with the return of Vallius and carried out various missions in the shadows. He wears a modified version of the magical armor that came in from Eulderna."
it: Nasce dall'ordine cavalleresco di Lothria, sciolto quando Barius cadde in disgrazia. Con il ritorno di Barius al potere il reparto fu richiamato di nascosto, e ha portato a termine ogni sorta di missione restando nell'ombra. Indossa una versione rimaneggiata dell'armatura magica arrivata da Eulderna.

jp_grezzo: "ロスリア特務部隊"

en: A subspecies that has the same roots as a normal Elea but has adapted to life outside the strange forest. They have strong magical powers dark skin and are reluctant to form groups. In terms of personality they are more warlike and worldly than normal Elea.
en_grezzo: "A subspecies that has the same roots as a normal Elea but has adapted to life outside the strange forest. They have strong magical powers dark skin and are reluctant to form groups. In terms of personality they are more warlike and worldly than normal Elea."
it: Ha le stesse radici degli Elea comuni, ma è la sottospecie che si è adattata alla vita fuori dal bosco di Vindale. Ha un forte potere magico e la pelle scura, e non ama mettersi in gruppo. Di carattere, rispetto agli Elea comuni, è più bellicoso e più attaccato alle cose del mondo.

jp: ダークエレア
jp_grezzo: "ダークエレア"
en: dark elea
en_grezzo: "dark elea"
it: l'Elea oscuro

it: Viene dal popolo delle colline, e commerciava dalle parti del confine fra Kikkasu e Niesa. Si proclama mercante avventuriera, e smercia la sua roba nei campi di battaglia e in altri posti pericolosi. Il suo stile pare essere vendere caro dove c'è richiesta, e infatti cambia merce a seconda del posto.

en_grezzo: "A space crab that inhabited a black hole. It was captured by an alien species and bred for use in invasions. Mainly fighting with scissors and liquid solvents. In recent years some of them have been kept as space pets because of their adorable calls and movements."
it: Un granchio spaziale che viveva dentro un buco nero. Una specie aliena lo catturò e lo selezionò per usarlo nelle invasioni. Combatte soprattutto con le chele e con un liquido che scioglie. Il verso e i movimenti sono così graziosi che negli ultimi tempi c'è chi lo tiene come animale da compagnia spaziale.
