en_grezzo: "A giant sowbug that lived in a bizarre forest. He reigns as the king of the forest with an intelligence beyond that of humans and a generous heart. He also lives in symbiosis with Elea and when the forest was burned he led the people amidst the flames with his strength. In reality he is a relic of a biochemical civilization."
it: Un porcellino di terra gigantesco che viveva nel bosco di Vindale. Ha un'intelligenza superiore a quella degli uomini e un cuore magnanimo, e regna sul bosco come suo sovrano. Vive in simbiosi anche con gli Elea, e quando il bosco fu dato alle fiamme fece scudo col proprio corpo per guidare fuori la gente circondata dal fuoco. In verità è un lascito della civiltà biochimica.

jp: 甲殻王者『キングダンゴムシ』

en: <Shell King of Vindale>
en_grezzo: "<Shell King of Vindale>"
it: <Re Porcellino> il sovrano dei crostacei

jp: 冥界蟹の近縁種。三途の川の河川敷から、冥海の海岸まで幅広く分布しており、あちら側では冥界蟹よりもポピュラーな存在。発達した片腕で死者を導く習性があるが、生者は魂ごと引っ張られるので危険。
jp_grezzo: "冥界蟹の近縁種。三途の川の河川敷から、冥海の海岸まで幅広く分布しており、あちら側では冥界蟹よりもポピュラーな存在。発達した片腕で死者を導く習性があるが、生者は魂ごと引っ張られるので危険。"
en: A close relative of the underworld crab. It is widely found from the riverbed of the Sanzu River to the shore of the Underworld and is more popular than the Underworld crab on the other side. It has a habit of guiding the dead with one arm but it is dangerous to the living because their souls will be pulled away.
en_grezzo: "A close relative of the underworld crab. It is widely found from the riverbed of the Sanzu River to the shore of the Underworld and is more popular than the Underworld crab on the other side. It has a habit of guiding the dead with one arm but it is dangerous to the living because their souls will be pulled away."
it: Parente stretto del granchio dell'oltretomba. È diffuso su un tratto largo, dalle golene del fiume Sanzu fino alle coste del mare dei morti, e di là è più comune del granchio dell'oltretomba. Ha l'abitudine di guidare i defunti con la chela che ha sviluppato, ma per un vivo è pericoloso: verrebbe tirato via con tutta l'anima.

jp: 死ヲ招キ
jp_grezzo: "死ヲ招キ"
en: death maneki
en_grezzo: "death maneki"
it: il chiamamorte

jp: 重なり合った王冠のような形の外殻を持つ。その見た目から古代サイロニアでは王の資質を見定める存在とされ、背中に登るのが王位継承の儀式となっていた。現代でも祭りにその儀式の名残が見られる。
jp_grezzo: "重なり合った王冠のような形の外殻を持つ。その見た目から古代サイロニアでは王の資質を見定める存在とされ、背中に登るのが王位継承の儀式となっていた。現代でも祭りにその儀式の名残が見られる。"
en: It has an outer shell that is shaped like an overlapping crown. Because of its appearance it was regarded as the judge of kingly qualities in ancient Cyronia and climbing on its back was a ritual of succession to the throne. Remnants of the ritual can still be seen in festivals today.
en_grezzo: "It has an outer shell that is shaped like an overlapping crown. Because of its appearance it was regarded as the judge of kingly qualities in ancient Cyronia and climbing on its back was a ritual of succession to the throne. Remnants of the ritual can still be seen in festivals today."
it: Ha il guscio fatto a corone sovrapposte. Per quell'aspetto, nell'antica Cyronia lo tenevano per il giudice che riconosceva la stoffa di un re, e salirgli in groppa era il rito con cui si saliva al trono. Ancora oggi, nelle feste, di quel rito si vede qualche residuo.

jp: 王冠蟲
jp_grezzo: "王冠蟲"
en: king woodlouse
en_grezzo: "king woodlouse"
it: l'insetto coronato

jp: 超古代に絶滅したと思われていた海洋生物が、地中での暮らしに適応進化して生き延びていた。雌が植物の根を摂取して体内で精油を作り、フェロモンとして求愛行動に用いることからこの名がついた。
jp_grezzo: "超古代に絶滅したと思われていた海洋生物が、地中での暮らしに適応進化して生き延びていた。雌が植物の根を摂取して体内で精油を作り、フェロモンとして求愛行動に用いることからこの名がついた。"
en: Marine life thought to have gone extinct in extreme antiquity survived by adapting and evolving to live underground. It got its name from the fact that the female ingests the roots of the plant and produces essential oil in her body which she uses as a pheromone in her courtship behavior.
en_grezzo: "Marine life thought to have gone extinct in extreme antiquity survived by adapting and evolving to live underground. It got its name from the fact that the female ingests the roots of the plant and produces essential oil in her body which she uses as a pheromone in her courtship behavior."
it: Una creatura marina che si credeva estinta in un'antichità remotissima, e che invece era sopravvissuta adattandosi alla vita sottoterra. Il nome le viene dal fatto che la femmina si nutre di radici di piante, se ne ricava dentro il corpo un olio essenziale e lo usa come feromone nel corteggiamento.

jp: アロマカリス
jp_grezzo: "アロマカリス"
en: aroma-locaris
en_grezzo: "aroma-locaris"
it: l'aromalocaris

jp: 狙撃銃を殻に仕込んだやどかり。殻の丈夫さから、足を止めての撃ちあいに強い。足が遅いため、狙撃に耐えられる生物相手には簡単に捕食されてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "狙撃銃を殻に仕込んだやどかり。殻の丈夫さから、足を止めての撃ちあいに強い。足が遅いため、狙撃に耐えられる生物相手には簡単に捕食されてしまう。"
en: They have a sniper rifle on their shells. Due to the strength of the shell it is strong enough to shoot at a standstill. Because of its slow legs it is easily preyed upon by creatures that can withstand the sniping.
en_grezzo: "They have a sniper rifle on their shells. Due to the strength of the shell it is strong enough to shoot at a standstill. Because of its slow legs it is easily preyed upon by creatures that can withstand the sniping."
it: Un paguro che si è montato un fucile di precisione dentro il guscio. Il guscio è robusto, e quindi nello scambio di colpi a piede fermo se la cava bene. Ma le zampe sono lente: chi regge il tiro di precisione se lo mangia senza fatica.

jp_grezzo: "スナイプハーミット"
en: snipe hermit
en_grezzo: "snipe hermit"
it: il paguro cecchino

jp: 人に似た上半身を持ち、ニンゲンやヒトガタなどと呼ばれるが、巻貝の仲間。古代から陸上にも生息していたが透明なので気づかれなかったし、海で発見されても海洋哺乳類の見間違いだとされていた。
jp_grezzo: "人に似た上半身を持ち、ニンゲンやヒトガタなどと呼ばれるが、巻貝の仲間。古代から陸上にも生息していたが透明なので気づかれなかったし、海で発見されても海洋哺乳類の見間違いだとされていた。"
en: It has an upper body that resembles a human and is called a ningen or hitokata but it is a member of the snail family. They've lived on land since ancient times but have gone unnoticed because they're so transparent and when they're found in the ocean they've been misidentified as marine mammals.
en_grezzo: "It has an upper body that resembles a human and is called a ningen or hitokata but it is a member of the snail family. They've lived on land since ancient times but have gone unnoticed because they're so transparent and when they're found in the ocean they've been misidentified as marine mammals."
it: Ha il busto simile a quello di una persona, e infatti lo chiamano Ningen o Hitogata, ma è parente delle chiocciole. Fin dall'antichità viveva anche sulla terraferma, solo che nessuno se n'era accorto perché è trasparente; e quando qualcuno lo avvistava in mare, si diceva che avesse scambiato per altro un mammifero marino.

jp: 透明ニンゲン
jp_grezzo: "透明ニンゲン"
en: sea fallen angel
en_grezzo: "sea fallen angel"
it: l'umanoide trasparente

jp: 高速で突進し、鋭い顎を突き刺してくる魚。人の頭蓋骨を余裕で貫通する。鋭い歯を持っておりインド象の鼻を食いちぎったケースも。完璧主義者であり、相手を仕留められないと刺さったまま回転して大暴れする。
jp_grezzo: "高速で突進し、鋭い顎を突き刺してくる魚。人の頭蓋骨を余裕で貫通する。鋭い歯を持っておりインド象の鼻を食いちぎったケースも。完璧主義者であり、相手を仕留められないと刺さったまま回転して大暴れする。"
en: A fish that rushes at high speed and pierces you with its sharp maw. It can penetrate a person's skull at will. It has sharp teeth and in some cases it has bitten off the nose of an Indian elephant. They're perfectionists and if they can't finish off their opponents they'll go on a rampage stabbing and spinning.
en_grezzo: "A fish that rushes at high speed and pierces you with its sharp maw. It can penetrate a person's skull at will. It has sharp teeth and in some cases it has bitten off the nose of an Indian elephant. They're perfectionists and if they can't finish off their opponents they'll go on a rampage stabbing and spinning."
it: Un pesce che carica ad alta velocità e infilza con le mascelle affilate. Un cranio umano lo passa da parte a parte senza sforzo. Ha i denti aguzzi, e si sono visti casi in cui ha staccato con un morso la proboscide a un elefante indiano. È perfezionista: se non riesce a finire l'avversario, resta infilzato e si mette a girare su se stesso come un ossesso.

jp_grezzo: "ナインダツフィッシュ"

en_grezzo: "nine dart garfish"
it: l'aguglia dai nove dardi

jp: 三途の川の終着点である、「冥海」出身。好奇心が強く、見知らぬ相手にも無邪気にジャレつくのだがそれがシャレにならない。巨体によるおふざけ突進や、鎧を圧砕する甘噛みに耐えられる者は少ないだろう。
jp_grezzo: "三途の川の終着点である、「冥海」出身。好奇心が強く、見知らぬ相手にも無邪気にジャレつくのだがそれがシャレにならない。巨体によるおふざけ突進や、鎧を圧砕する甘噛みに耐えられる者は少ないだろう。"
en: He is from the Land of the Dead the terminus of the Sanzu River. He has a strong curiosity and innocently plays games with strangers but is no joke. Few would be able to withstand the goofy rush of a huge body and the sweet bite that crushes armor.
en_grezzo: "He is from the Land of the Dead the terminus of the Sanzu River. He has a strong curiosity and innocently plays games with strangers but is no joke. Few would be able to withstand the goofy rush of a huge body and the sweet bite that crushes armor."
it: Viene dal mare dei morti, il capolinea del fiume Sanzu. È di una curiosità insaziabile, e fa festa con innocenza anche a chi non conosce, solo che di festoso ha poco. Alla carica per gioco di quel corpaccione, e al morsetto affettuoso che sfonda un'armatura, resiste poca gente.

en: orcinus orca

it: il demone marino Orcinus

jp: 温厚な性格で、毒針もないエイ。普段はエーテルの風に乗り低空を遊泳しながら空気中のマナや羽虫を食って生きているが、肉も食えないことはない。戦闘になると糸を撒いて敵の動きを止め、放電を行う。
jp_grezzo: "温厚な性格で、毒針もないエイ。普段はエーテルの風に乗り低空を遊泳しながら空気中のマナや羽虫を食って生きているが、肉も食えないことはない。戦闘になると糸を撒いて敵の動きを止め、放電を行う。"
en: They are mild-mannered and have no poisonous needles. Normally they live off of mana and winged insects in the air as they swim low in the etheric winds but they are not incapable of eating meat either. When it comes to combat it stops the enemy's movement by scattering threads and discharging them.
en_grezzo: "They are mild-mannered and have no poisonous needles. Normally they live off of mana and winged insects in the air as they swim low in the etheric winds but they are not incapable of eating meat either. When it comes to combat it stops the enemy's movement by scattering threads and discharging them."
it: Una razza di indole mite, e per giunta senza aculeo velenoso. Di solito vive nuotando bassa sul vento d'etere e mangiando il mana e i moscerini che trova nell'aria, ma la carne non è che non la mangi. Se si arriva alle mani, sparge fili per bloccare il nemico sul posto e poi scarica la corrente.

jp: イトマキシビレエイ
jp_grezzo: "イトマキシビレエイ"
en: manta rayarn
en_grezzo: "manta rayarn"
it: la manta torpedine

jp: 海底にたたずむ一輪の花。実際は珊瑚虫の群体である。藻類と共生しており、光合成も可能。色とりどりの外骨格を形成するが、生息しやすいようにと周囲に海水を撒きちらすので、あまり観賞には向かない。
jp_grezzo: "海底にたたずむ一輪の花。実際は珊瑚虫の群体である。藻類と共生しており、光合成も可能。色とりどりの外骨格を形成するが、生息しやすいようにと周囲に海水を撒きちらすので、あまり観賞には向かない。"
en: A single flower resting on the sea floor. In fact it is a group of coral worms. It lives in symbiosis with algae and is also capable of photosynthesis. It forms a multi-colored exoskeleton but it is not easily seen because it sprays seawater around it to make it habitable.
en_grezzo: "A single flower resting on the sea floor. In fact it is a group of coral worms. It lives in symbiosis with algae and is also capable of photosynthesis. It forms a multi-colored exoskeleton but it is not easily seen because it sprays seawater around it to make it habitable."
it: Un fiore solitario che se ne sta in fondo al mare. In realtà è una colonia di polipi di corallo. Vive in simbiosi con le alghe e sa anche fare la fotosintesi. Costruisce uno scheletro esterno di tutti i colori, ma come ornamento non vale molto: per stare comodo sparge acqua di mare tutt'intorno.

jp: 花珊瑚
jp_grezzo: "花珊瑚"
en: flower coral
en_grezzo: "flower coral"
it: il corallo fiorito

jp: 海のビッグスターを自称する巨大なヒトデ。最近、陸にはハムスターという人気者がいると聞いて、負けじと陸に上がってきた。手裏剣のことを寡黙な同族だと思い込んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "海のビッグスターを自称する巨大なヒトデ。最近、陸にはハムスターという人気者がいると聞いて、負けじと陸に上がってきた。手裏剣のことを寡黙な同族だと思い込んでいる。"
en: A giant starfish that calls itself the Big Star of the Sea. Recently it heard that there was a popular creature so he came up to not be outdone. He thinks of shuriken as a taciturn kindred spirit.
en_grezzo: "A giant starfish that calls itself the Big Star of the Sea. Recently it heard that there was a popular creature so he came up to not be outdone. He thinks of shuriken as a taciturn kindred spirit."
it: Una stella marina enorme che si proclama la grande stella del mare. Di recente ha sentito dire che sulla terraferma c'è un beniamino di nome criceto, e per non essere da meno è salita anche lei all'asciutto. È convinta che gli shuriken siano parenti suoi, solo un po' taciturni.

jp: ビッグアビスター
jp_grezzo: "ビッグアビスター"
en: abysstar
en_grezzo: "abysstar"

jp: 海の犯罪者と呼ばれる。スリや食い逃げがメインだが、ある日やばすぎる犯罪を行ってしまい、現在は陸へ高飛び中。ほとぼりが冷めた頃に海に帰ろうと考えている。
jp_grezzo: "海の犯罪者と呼ばれる。スリや食い逃げがメインだが、ある日やばすぎる犯罪を行ってしまい、現在は陸へ高飛び中。ほとぼりが冷めた頃に海に帰ろうと考えている。"
en: They are called the Criminals of the Sea. They''re mainly pickpockets and food runners but one day they commit a terrible crime and are now flying overland. They are thinking of returning to the sea when the heat has cooled down.
en_grezzo: "They are called the Criminals of the Sea. They''re mainly pickpockets and food runners but one day they commit a terrible crime and are now flying overland. They are thinking of returning to the sea when the heat has cooled down."
it: Lo chiamano il delinquente del mare. Di mestiere fa il borseggiatore e mangia senza pagare, ma un giorno ha combinato un guaio troppo grosso, e adesso è alla macchia sulla terraferma. Conta di tornarsene in mare quando le acque si saranno calmate.

jp: タカトビウオ
jp_grezzo: "タカトビウオ"
en: flight fish
en_grezzo: "flight fish"
it: il pesce volante rapace

jp: 波の向くまま、気の向くままにさすらう海のガンマン。日光浴が大好きで、わざわざショートテレポートを連打して陸の岩の上まで寝そべりに行く。そして帰りに苦労する。
jp_grezzo: "波の向くまま、気の向くままにさすらう海のガンマン。日光浴が大好きで、わざわざショートテレポートを連打して陸の岩の上まで寝そべりに行く。そして帰りに苦労する。"
en: A sea gunslinger who wanders at the direction of the waves and at his own whim. He loves to soak up the sun and deliberately goes to lie down on the rocks on the land with a series of short teleports. And struggle on the way home.
en_grezzo: "A sea gunslinger who wanders at the direction of the waves and at his own whim. He loves to soak up the sun and deliberately goes to lie down on the rocks on the land with a series of short teleports. And struggle on the way home."
it: Un pistolero del mare che vaga dove lo portano le onde e dove gli gira. Va matto per il bagno di sole, e per andare a sdraiarsi sugli scogli a riva si spara una raffica di teletrasporti corti. Poi, al ritorno, sono guai.

jp: ガンマンボウ
jp_grezzo: "ガンマンボウ"
en: gunfish
en_grezzo: "gunfish"
it: il pesce cannone

jp: 既存の忍術に縛られなくなったことで天性の才能が開花。よくわからないコードネームを名乗ってノリノリで活動している。…後年、クッションに顔を埋めて手足をバタバタさせてのた打ち回ることになりそうである。
jp_grezzo: "既存の忍術に縛られなくなったことで天性の才能が開花。よくわからないコードネームを名乗ってノリノリで活動している。…後年、クッションに顔を埋めて手足をバタバタさせてのた打ち回ることになりそうである。"
en: Her natural talent blossomed when she was no longer bound by existing ninjutsu. She goes by a code name that nobody understands and is in high spirits. ...In later years she's going to be burying her face in the cushion and lazing around.
en_grezzo: "Her natural talent blossomed when she was no longer bound by existing ninjutsu. She goes by a code name that nobody understands and is in high spirits. ...In later years she's going to be burying her face in the cushion and lazing around."
it: Il talento naturale le è sbocciato quando ha smesso di stare legata alle arti ninja come si erano sempre fatte. Adesso si presenta con un nome in codice che non si capisce bene e si diverte un mondo. ...C'è da scommettere che fra qualche anno finirà a ficcare la faccia in un cuscino e a sbattere braccia e gambe per la vergogna.

jp_grezzo: "謎のお洒落忍者『シャドウシスター』"
en: <Fashionable Kunoichi>
en_grezzo: "<Fashionable Kunoichi>"
it: <Kunoichi alla moda>

jp: 人間に友好的な犬の神。人間嫌いの弟と喧嘩になり、森を出て彷徨った結果メイルーンへ辿り着いた。吹雪で遭難した旅人を導いている内に一部地域で信仰されるようになったが、まだまだマイナーな神らしい。
jp_grezzo: "人間に友好的な犬の神。人間嫌いの弟と喧嘩になり、森を出て彷徨った結果メイルーンへ辿り着いた。吹雪で遭難した旅人を導いている内に一部地域で信仰されるようになったが、まだまだマイナーな神らしい。"
en: A dog god who is friendly to humans. He got into a fight with his brother who hates humans and wandered out of the forest resulting in his arrival in Mayroon. While guiding travelers who were lost in a blizzard the god came to be worshipped in some areas but it seems that it is still a minor god.
en_grezzo: "A dog god who is friendly to humans. He got into a fight with his brother who hates humans and wandered out of the forest resulting in his arrival in Mayroon. While guiding travelers who were lost in a blizzard the god came to be worshipped in some areas but it seems that it is still a minor god."
it: Un dio cane, e in buoni rapporti con gli uomini. Litigò con il fratello minore, che gli uomini invece li detesta, e uscì dal bosco: girovagando finì a Mayroon. A furia di guidare i viaggiatori sperduti nella tormenta si è guadagnato il culto di qualche zona, ma resta un dio piuttosto minore.

jp: 白氷の『サイメーブ』
jp_grezzo: "白氷の『サイメーブ』"
en: <Saimef> the doggod
en_grezzo: "<Saimef> the doggod"
it: <Saimef> il bianco ghiaccio

jp_grezzo: "神の欠片を宿す巨大なムカデ。欠片は毒と死者の守護神のものだったらしいが、そんなことはお構いなしに力に溺れて暴れまわる。人間にチヤホヤされている白銀龍蟲のことが嫌い。"
en: A giant centipede that harbors a piece of God. Apparently the pieces belonged to the guardian gods of venom and the dead but they don't care about that and go on a rampage drowning in power. It dislikes the white silver dragon bugs that are being flattered by humans.
en_grezzo: "A giant centipede that harbors a piece of God. Apparently the pieces belonged to the guardian gods of venom and the dead but they don't care about that and go on a rampage drowning in power. It dislikes the white silver dragon bugs that are being flattered by humans."
it: Un millepiedi gigantesco che porta in sé una scheggia di divinità. La scheggia pare fosse del nume che protegge i veleni e i morti, ma di questo a lui non importa niente: si ubriaca della forza e mette tutto a soqquadro. Non sopporta il millepiedi drago argenteo, che gli uomini si tengono caro.

jp: セパ
jp_grezzo: "セパ"
en: sepa
en_grezzo: "sepa"

it: È una belva magica in fin di vita che si è impossessata, senza chiedere permesso, di una signora che passava di lì. Le ha cancellato la memoria e le ha preso il posto. La sua missione è cancellare tutti i ricordi di questo mondo, e per riuscirci trama nell'ombra per riprendersi la forza che ha perduto.

en_grezzo: "A bird-man wearing blue armor. It seems that the armor contains the power of the bird deity. jp_grezzo: "恋も知らずに幼くして死んだ少女の魂が転生したもの。獲物を誘惑し、油断したところを攻撃する。頭部を砕いて脳髄を吸うのが好き、となかなかにアグレッシブ。"

en_grezzo: "The reincarnation of the soul of a girl who died at an early age without knowing love. They lure their prey and attack them when they are caught off guard. They like to crush the head and suck the brain tissue and they are quite aggressive."

He is a warrior at heart but his personality is a bit of a drinker. Stomach acid is special and burps with a hallucinogenic component.
en_grezzo: "A swordsman who travels the various stars while eating and peddling swords. In addition to his normal arms he fights with two tentacles that extend from his shoulders. it: Uno spadaccino che gira di stella in stella mangiando dove capita e vendendo la lama a chi paga. Oltre alle braccia normali combatte con due tentacoli che gli escono dalle spalle. È di stirpe guerriera fino al midollo, ma di carattere se la prende con calma. Ha i succhi gastrici particolari, e i rutti gli vengono con dentro una sostanza che dà allucinazioni.

jp_grezzo: "波動を操る力を身に着けた竜人の戦士。すさまじい戦闘力を誇るが、なぜそんな力が身についたのか、そもそも何の波動なのか、本人もよくわかっていない。"

jp_grezzo: "体温が上がらないとテンションが上がらないので、周囲の熱を吸収して冷気に変えて放出する。複数体集まれば熱い地域にも吹雪を起こせるほどになる。"
en: When their body temperature doesn't rise their tension doesn't rise so they absorb the heat around them turn it into cold air and release it. If you collect more than one of them it's enough to cause a blizzard in a hot area.
en_grezzo: "When their body temperature doesn't rise their tension doesn't rise so they absorb the heat around them turn it into cold air and release it. If you collect more than one of them it's enough to cause a blizzard in a hot area."
it: Se non le sale la temperatura del corpo non le sale nemmeno l'umore, e allora assorbe il calore che ha intorno, lo trasforma in aria gelida e la butta fuori. Se se ne mettono insieme parecchie, arrivano a scatenare una tormenta perfino in una regione calda.

en: A powerful dragon man wielding a greatsword. He likes the sturdy weight of the greatsword. He is confident in his skills and has no reservations when it comes to fighting dragons and dragon hunters.
en_grezzo: "A powerful dragon man wielding a greatsword. He likes the sturdy weight of the greatsword. He is confident in his skills and has no reservations when it comes to fighting dragons and dragon hunters."
it: Un uomo lucertola pieno di forza, che maneggia uno spadone. Gli piace il peso pieno che ha lo spadone. Del proprio braccio è sicuro, e non fa distinzioni: se la prende con i draghi come con i cacciatori di draghi.

jp: ドラゴクレイモア
jp_grezzo: "ドラゴクレイモア"
en: claymore dragonewt
en_grezzo: "claymore dragonewt"

jp_grezzo: "竜人の暗殺者。竜人限定の暗殺者ギルドを作り、一族の脅威となる者を暗殺して回っている。シッポが邪魔で群衆に紛れることができないため、ステルス能力のある服を愛用している。"

it: L'assassino degli uomini lucertola. Hanno messo su una gilda di assassini riservata alla loro gente, e vanno in giro a togliere di mezzo chi minaccia la stirpe. La coda è ingombrante e non permette di confondersi nella folla, e per questo portano volentieri abiti che aiutano a non farsi vedere.

jp: アサシンリザード
jp_grezzo: "アサシンリザード"

en_grezzo: "assassin lizard"

jp_grezzo: "火を吐くことに憧れ、火炎の力を身に着けようとして全身の鱗が熱で焦げるほどの修行をした。結局ダメだったことに絶望して性格が歪んでしまい、結果的に吐けるようになったのは毒だけだった。"
en: He longed to breathe fire and cultivated so much that the scales on his entire body burned with heat in an attempt to acquire the power of the flame. In the end his personality was warped in despair that it didn't work and the only thing that resulted in him being able to throw up was poison.
en_grezzo: "He longed to breathe fire and cultivated so much that the scales on his entire body burned with heat in an attempt to acquire the power of the flame. In the end his personality was warped in despair that it didn't work and the only thing that resulted in him being able to throw up was poison."
it: Sognava di sputare fuoco, e per impadronirsi della forza della fiamma si sottopose a un tirocinio tale che il calore gli bruciacchiò le scaglie su tutto il corpo. Alla fine non ci riuscì, la disperazione gli storse il carattere, e l'unica cosa che ha finito per saper sputare è il veleno.

jp: 黒鱗の毒含竜
jp_grezzo: "黒鱗の毒含竜"

en_grezzo: "black lizardman"
it: il drago velenoso dalle scaglie nere

jp_grezzo: "頑張って魔法を身に着けた竜人。とはいえ肉体がもともと強靭なので、魔法攻撃よりも物理攻撃のほうが強い。そのことに長い間葛藤した結果、補助魔法を使う形に落ち着いた。"
en: The dragon man has worked hard to acquire magic. However since his body is strong to begin with his physical attacks are more powerful than his magical attacks. After struggling with that for a long time he settled on using auxiliary magic.
en_grezzo: "The dragon man has worked hard to acquire magic. However since his body is strong to begin with his physical attacks are more powerful than his magical attacks. After struggling with that for a long time he settled on using auxiliary magic."
it: Un uomo lucertola che a furia di impegnarsi si è impadronito della magia. Solo che il corpo ce l'ha robusto in partenza, e quindi gli attacchi fisici gli riescono meglio di quelli magici. Dopo essersi tormentato a lungo sulla faccenda, si è accomodato sulle magie di sostegno.

jp: リザードメイジ
jp_grezzo: "リザードメイジ"
en: lizard mage
en_grezzo: "lizard mage"
it: il mago lucertola

jp: 妖精族に危機迫る時、光の衣を纏って泉から生まれるという伝説の妖精。ただし他種族の台頭により、ここ数百年断続的に生まれてきている。本人たちは希少性の低下に悩んでいる模様。
jp_grezzo: "妖精族に危機迫る時、光の衣を纏って泉から生まれるという伝説の妖精。ただし他種族の台頭により、ここ数百年断続的に生まれてきている。本人たちは希少性の低下に悩んでいる模様。"
en: Legend has it that when a fairy tribe was threatened she was born from a spring clothed in a robe of light. However due to the rise of other races they have been born sporadically over the past few hundred years. They are suffering from diminishing numbers.
en_grezzo: "Legend has it that when a fairy tribe was threatened she was born from a spring clothed in a robe of light. However due to the rise of other races they have been born sporadically over the past few hundred years. They are suffering from diminishing numbers."
it: La fata leggendaria che, quando sul popolo delle fate incombe il pericolo, nasce dalla sorgente avvolta in una veste di luce. Solo che, con le altre stirpi che avanzano, negli ultimi secoli continua a nascerne una ogni tanto senza mai smettere. Pare che a loro dispiaccia parecchio essere diventate meno rare.

jp: 光輝の妖精
jp_grezzo: "光輝の妖精"
en: fairy the shining
en_grezzo: "fairy the shining"
it: la fata splendente

jp: 赤く燃えているくらいで、見た目こそ普通の妖精とそう変わらないが、通常の妖精の6000倍以上の質量を持つ。ものすごい勢いで特攻してくるので、頑張って避けよう。
jp_grezzo: "赤く燃えているくらいで、見た目こそ普通の妖精とそう変わらないが、通常の妖精の6000倍以上の質量を持つ。ものすごい勢いで特攻してくるので、頑張って避けよう。"
en: It burns red and although it looks no different from a normal fairy it has more than 6000 times the mass of a normal fairy. It attacks with great force so try your best to avoid it.
en_grezzo: "It burns red and although it looks no different from a normal fairy it has more than 6000 times the mass of a normal fairy. It attacks with great force so try your best to avoid it."
it: A parte il fatto che brucia di rosso, all'aspetto non è tanto diversa da una fata comune; solo che ha una massa oltre seimila volte quella di una fata normale. Ti si butta addosso con una violenza tremenda, quindi mettici tutto l'impegno che hai per schivarla.

jp: フェアリーゴラス
jp_grezzo: "フェアリーゴラス"
en: yousei gorath
en_grezzo: "yousei gorath"

jp_grezzo: "火の元素から生まれた妖精。その証拠に火の魔法が使える。男は威厳があり、女は美しいとされる。ほぼ人間と同じサイズであり、人間と結婚することも珍しくない。"
en: A fairy born of the fire element. To prove it it will use fire magic. Men are said to be dignified and women are said to be beautiful. They are almost the same size as humans and it is not uncommon for them to marry humans.
en_grezzo: "A fairy born of the fire element. To prove it it will use fire magic. Men are said to be dignified and women are said to be beautiful. They are almost the same size as humans and it is not uncommon for them to marry humans."
it: Una fata nata dall'elemento del fuoco. La prova è che sa usare la magia del fuoco. I maschi passano per solenni, le femmine per bellissime. Sono grandi pressappoco come una persona, e non è raro che sposino un umano.

jp: ペリ
jp_grezzo: "ペリ"
en: peri
en_grezzo: "peri"
it: la peri

jp_grezzo: "先天的な病気で、成長抑制因子が正常に機能しなかった妖精。人間大にまで成長してしまい、やむなく妖精の里から出るはめになった。魔法も上手く使えないので、専ら人間用の弓などで戦う。"
en: A fairy with a congenital disease that prevented its growth inhibitors from functioning properly. They have grown to the size of a human and have had to leave the fairy home. They can''t use magic very well so they fight with human bows.
en_grezzo: "A fairy with a congenital disease that prevented its growth inhibitors from functioning properly. They have grown to the size of a human and have had to leave the fairy home. They can''t use magic very well so they fight with human bows."
it: Una fata a cui, per una malattia di nascita, il fattore che frena la crescita non ha funzionato come doveva. È cresciuta fino alla taglia di una persona, e si è vista costretta ad andarsene dal villaggio delle fate. La magia le riesce male, e perciò combatte con archi e simili, di quelli fatti per gli uomini.

jp: ギガントフェアリー
jp_grezzo: "ギガントフェアリー"
en: gigantic fairy
en_grezzo: "gigantic fairy"
it: la fata gigante

jp_grezzo: "洗礼を受けずに死んだ子供の魂が転生したものとされる。人間にいたずらをするのが大好きだが、義理堅く仕事熱心な性格。月光を浴びながら集団で踊る。"
en: It is said to be the reincarnation of the soul of an unbaptized and dead child. They love to play pranks on humans but they are loyal and hardworking. They dance in groups while basking in the moonlight.
en_grezzo: "It is said to be the reincarnation of the soul of an unbaptized and dead child. They love to play pranks on humans but they are loyal and hardworking. They dance in groups while basking in the moonlight."
it: Si dice che sia l'anima di un bambino morto senza battesimo, tornata al mondo in un altro corpo. Adora fare scherzi agli uomini, ma è di parola e sul lavoro ci si mette d'impegno. Danza in gruppo sotto la luce della luna.

jp: ピクシー
jp_grezzo: "ピクシー"
en: pixie
en_grezzo: "pixie"
it: la pixie

jp_grezzo: "奇跡的に人格を取り戻したが、肉体的には既に人外。肉体制御によって人間だった頃の姿を再現しているにすぎない。兄による外部神経調整でメシェーラの影響をどうにか抑え込んでいる。"

it: Un demone dai gusti rovesciati: adora legare e adora essere legato. Gli dei l'hanno sbattuta dentro il castello immenso, ma i suoi poteri non sono limitati quanto quelli degli altri demoni. Si pensa che il sigillo abbia fatto meno presa proprio per via della facoltà che si ritrova.

jp: 束縛の悪魔『エゲルベイル』
jp_grezzo: "束縛の悪魔『エゲルベイル』"
en: <Egelveil> the bind
en_grezzo: "<Egelveil> the bind"
it: <Egelveil> il demone dei vincoli

jp: 恐怖の体現者。構ってちゃんであり、寂しくなると死んでしまうからなどという理由（もちろん嘘である）で誰彼構わず引き寄せ、阿鼻叫喚の地獄を作り出す。
jp_grezzo: "恐怖の体現者。構ってちゃんであり、寂しくなると死んでしまうからなどという理由（もちろん嘘である）で誰彼構わず引き寄せ、阿鼻叫喚の地獄を作り出す。"
en: The embodiment of fear. It is a caring person and when it gets lonely it will die etc. A lie of course. So it attracts everyone and creates a hell of a scene.
en_grezzo: "The embodiment of fear. It is a caring person and when it gets lonely it will die etc. A lie of course. So it attracts everyone and creates a hell of a scene."
it: Il terrore fatto carne. È uno di quelli che vogliono attenzione a tutti i costi: con la scusa che se resta solo muore, che è una bugia bella e buona, si tira addosso chiunque gli capiti e ne ricava un inferno di urla e di strazio.

jp: ドレッドラビット
jp_grezzo: "ドレッドラビット"
en: dread rabbit
en_grezzo: "dread rabbit"
it: il coniglio del terrore

jp: かつて神々の大戦時に、風の女神に敗北してしまい身体を引き裂かれた虹の女神…その破片を宿すリス。生まれたばかりの頃は破片の支配力が強いため、身体が虹色に発光する。
jp_grezzo: "かつて神々の大戦時に、風の女神に敗北してしまい身体を引き裂かれた虹の女神…その破片を宿すリス。生まれたばかりの頃は破片の支配力が強いため、身体が虹色に発光する。"
en: The goddess of the rainbow once defeated by the goddess of the wind in a great war between the gods which tore her body apart...these squirrels houses the pieces. When they are newborn their bodies glow a rainbow of colors due to the dominance of the fragments.
en_grezzo: "The goddess of the rainbow once defeated by the goddess of the wind in a great war between the gods which tore her body apart...these squirrels houses the pieces. When they are newborn their bodies glow a rainbow of colors due to the dominance of the fragments."
it: Ai tempi della grande guerra fra gli dei, la dea dell'arcobaleno fu sconfitta dalla dea del vento e ne ebbe il corpo squarciato: questo scoiattolo ospita una di quelle schegge. Appena nato la scheggia lo domina più che mai, e allora il corpo gli si accende dei colori dell'arcobaleno.

jp: イリス
jp_grezzo: "イリス"
en: iris
en_grezzo: "iris"
it: l'iris

jp: 真っ白な兎。神として祭り上げられたことにより微弱ながらも神力を持つ。祖先の記憶が遺伝子に強く刷り込まれており、サメが苦手。縁結びが特技らしい。
jp_grezzo: "真っ白な兎。神として祭り上げられたことにより微弱ながらも神力を持つ。祖先の記憶が遺伝子に強く刷り込まれており、サメが苦手。縁結びが特技らしい。"
en: A pure white rabbit. It has a weak but divine power because it was raised as a god. Ancestral memories are strongly imprinted in its genes and it is not good at sharks. They are said to be good at matching couples.
en_grezzo: "A pure white rabbit. It has a weak but divine power because it was raised as a god. Ancestral memories are strongly imprinted in its genes and it is not good at sharks. They are said to be good at matching couples."
it: Un coniglio bianchissimo. A furia di essere innalzato a divinità si ritrova un potere divino, debole ma vero. La memoria degli antenati gli è rimasta stampata a fondo nel sangue, e per questo con gli squali non se la sente. Pare che la sua specialità sia far nascere le coppie.

jp: 白兎神
jp_grezzo: "白兎神"
en: hakutoshin
en_grezzo: "hakutoshin"
it: il dio lepre bianca

jp: 兎社会に潜む怪物。夜な夜な墓を掘り返して遺体を食らうため、屍食兎とも呼ばれる。兎だけでなく他の生物をも魅了し、食料としてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "兎社会に潜む怪物。夜な夜な墓を掘り返して遺体を食らうため、屍食兎とも呼ばれる。兎だけでなく他の生物をも魅了し、食料としてしまう。"
en: A monster lurking in rabbit society. They are also called corpse-eating rabbits because they dig up graves at night and devour the bodies. It attracts not only rabbits but also other creatures and uses them as food.
en_grezzo: "A monster lurking in rabbit society. They are also called corpse-eating rabbits because they dig up graves at night and devour the bodies. It attracts not only rabbits but also other creatures and uses them as food."
it: Un mostro che si nasconde dentro la società dei conigli. Notte dopo notte scava nelle tombe e divora i corpi, e per questo lo chiamano anche il coniglio mangiacadaveri. Non attira soltanto i conigli: adesca anche le altre creature e se le mangia.

jp: バニーグール
jp_grezzo: "バニーグール"
en: bunny ghoul
en_grezzo: "bunny ghoul"
it: il coniglio ghoul

jp: リスこそが地上で最も尊い生物であるという考えのもとに行動する。土地の明け渡しと無条件降伏をあちこちに要求したが、当然拒否されたため無差別破壊活動に走った。
jp_grezzo: "リスこそが地上で最も尊い生物であるという考えのもとに行動する。土地の明け渡しと無条件降伏をあちこちに要求したが、当然拒否されたため無差別破壊活動に走った。"
en: They act on the idea that squirrels are the most noble creatures on earth. They demanded land surrender and unconditional surrender but were naturally refused so they went on an indiscriminate subversive campaign.
en_grezzo: "They act on the idea that squirrels are the most noble creatures on earth. They demanded land surrender and unconditional surrender but were naturally refused so they went on an indiscriminate subversive campaign."
it: Agisce partendo dal principio che lo scoiattolo sia la creatura più nobile che ci sia sulla terra. Ha preteso qua e là la consegna delle terre e la resa senza condizioni; naturalmente gli hanno detto di no, e allora si è dato alla distruzione a casaccio.

jp: テロリス
jp_grezzo: "テロリス"
en: terrorism squirrel
en_grezzo: "terrorism squirrel"
it: lo scoiattolo terrorista

jp: 兎と亀の合成獣。遥か昔に兎と亀の徒競走があったらしいが、もしその場にこの生物がいた場合、結果はどうなっていただろうか。全ては亀のみぞ…もとい、神のみぞ知る。
jp_grezzo: "兎と亀の合成獣。遥か昔に兎と亀の徒競走があったらしいが、もしその場にこの生物がいた場合、結果はどうなっていただろうか。全ては亀のみぞ…もとい、神のみぞ知る。"
en: A synthetic beast of a rabbit and a tortoise. There was a race between a rabbit and a tortoise a long time ago and I wonder what the outcome would have been if this creature had been there. All things are in the hands of the tortoise... and God knows.
en_grezzo: "A synthetic beast of a rabbit and a tortoise. There was a race between a rabbit and a tortoise a long time ago and I wonder what the outcome would have been if this creature had been there. All things are in the hands of the tortoise... and God knows."
it: Una bestia sintetica, metà coniglio e metà tartaruga. Tanto tempo fa pare ci sia stata una gara di corsa fra una lepre e una tartaruga: chissà come sarebbe andata a finire se quel giorno ci fosse stata anche questa creatura. Lo sa soltanto la tartaru... pardon, soltanto il cielo.

jp: タートルラビット
jp_grezzo: "タートルラビット"
en: turtle rabbit
en_grezzo: "turtle rabbit"
it: il coniglio tartaruga

jp: 鏡の世界に住む巨大蝙蝠。サバイバルを繰り返し、こちら側の世界にも適応した。疾風の如く空を駆ける。執着心が強く、一度捕食しようとした獲物は徹底的に狙う。
jp_grezzo: "鏡の世界に住む巨大蝙蝠。サバイバルを繰り返し、こちら側の世界にも適応した。疾風の如く空を駆ける。執着心が強く、一度捕食しようとした獲物は徹底的に狙う。"
en: The giant bat lives in the mirror world. It has adapted to this side of the world through repeated survival. It flies in the sky like a swift wind. They are obsessive and once they have attempted to prey on their prey they target them thoroughly.
en_grezzo: "The giant bat lives in the mirror world. It has adapted to this side of the world through repeated survival. It flies in the sky like a swift wind. They are obsessive and once they have attempted to prey on their prey they target them thoroughly."
it: Un pipistrello gigantesco che abita il mondo dello specchio. A furia di sopravvivere una volta dopo l'altra si è adattato anche al mondo di qua. Corre per il cielo come una raffica di vento. È di quelli che non mollano: la preda che ha deciso di mangiarsi una volta se la tiene di mira fino in fondo.

jp: ダークレイダー
jp_grezzo: "ダークレイダー"
en: dark raider
en_grezzo: "dark raider"
it: il razziatore oscuro

jp: 蝙蝠の神。闇にまぎれて、病気や悪魔から人々を守るヒーロー。普通の蝙蝠と間違われて、守るべき人々からよく攻撃されるのが悩みの種。特技は死んだふり。
jp_grezzo: "蝙蝠の神。闇にまぎれて、病気や悪魔から人々を守るヒーロー。普通の蝙蝠と間違われて、守るべき人々からよく攻撃されるのが悩みの種。特技は死んだふり。"
en: The bat god. A hero who under the cover of darkness protects people from disease and demons. It often gets mistaken for a normal bat and is attacked by the people it is supposed to protect. It's good at playing dead.
en_grezzo: "The bat god. A hero who under the cover of darkness protects people from disease and demons. It often gets mistaken for a normal bat and is attacked by the people it is supposed to protect. It's good at playing dead."
it: Il dio dei pipistrelli. Un eroe che, confondendosi con il buio, difende la gente dalle malattie e dai demoni. Il suo cruccio è che lo scambiano spesso per un pipistrello qualunque e finisce attaccato proprio da quelli che dovrebbe proteggere. La sua specialità è fingersi morto.

jp: カパプカムイ
jp_grezzo: "カパプカムイ"
en: kapapu-kamui
en_grezzo: "kapapu-kamui"
it: il kapapukamui

jp: 人間たちが戦争している様子を遠巻きに観察して、戦闘技術を独自に学んだ蝙蝠。銃の扱いを覚えたが、兵士たちの口汚い罵倒まで覚えてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "人間たちが戦争している様子を遠巻きに観察して、戦闘技術を独自に学んだ蝙蝠。銃の扱いを覚えたが、兵士たちの口汚い罵倒まで覚えてしまった。"
en: Bats have learned their own fighting skills by observing the humans at war from a distance. They learned how to handle the guns and even learned the foul-mouthed abuse of the soldiers.
en_grezzo: "Bats have learned their own fighting skills by observing the humans at war from a distance. They learned how to handle the guns and even learned the foul-mouthed abuse of the soldiers."
it: Un pipistrello che, osservando da lontano gli uomini che si facevano la guerra, si è imparato da sé la tecnica del combattimento. Ha imparato a maneggiare le armi da fuoco, e insieme a quelle si è imparato anche il turpiloquio dei soldati.

jp: コンバット
jp_grezzo: "コンバット"
en: com-bat
en_grezzo: "com-bat"
it: il combattistrello

jp: やけにでかい蝙蝠だと思ったら、なんと妖怪らしい。樹の穴に住み、子供の泣き声で人々をおびき寄せる。気に入った子供はさらい、そうでない子供や大人には噛みついてくる。
jp_grezzo: "やけにでかい蝙蝠だと思ったら、なんと妖怪らしい。樹の穴に住み、子供の泣き声で人々をおびき寄せる。気に入った子供はさらい、そうでない子供や大人には噛みついてくる。"
en: It looks to be a very large bat but it seems to be a monster. They live in a hole in the tree and lure people in with the cries of children. Kids who like it will be snatched and kids and adults who don't will be bitten by it.
en_grezzo: "It looks to be a very large bat but it seems to be a monster. They live in a hole in the tree and lure people in with the cries of children. Kids who like it will be snatched and kids and adults who don't will be bitten by it."
it: Sembrava un pipistrello smisuratamente grosso, e invece pare che sia uno spirito. Abita nel cavo di un albero e attira la gente col pianto di un bambino. I bambini che gli piacciono se li porta via; quelli che non gli piacciono, e gli adulti, li morde e basta.

jp: モモツカ
jp_grezzo: "モモツカ"
en: momotuka
en_grezzo: "momotuka"
it: il momotuka

jp: 究極の力に目覚めたネズミ。普通のネズミと大きさはそう変わらないが戦闘力は段違い。さらに、「究鼠猫を噛み殺し、ついでにインド象も殺す」というコトワザがあるくらい凶暴。
jp_grezzo: "究極の力に目覚めたネズミ。普通のネズミと大きさはそう変わらないが戦闘力は段違い。さらに、「究鼠猫を噛み殺し、ついでにインド象も殺す」というコトワザがあるくらい凶暴。"
en: The rats have awakened to their ultimate power. It's no different in size from a normal rat but it's fighting power is much different. In addition there is a saying that they bite and kill the ultimate rat cat and eventually kill the Indian elephant.
en_grezzo: "The rats have awakened to their ultimate power. It's no different in size from a normal rat but it's fighting power is much different. In addition there is a saying that they bite and kill the ultimate rat cat and eventually kill the Indian elephant."
it: Un topo che si è risvegliato alla forza suprema. Di taglia non è granché diverso da un topo comune, ma la forza in combattimento è un'altra cosa. Ed è talmente feroce che c'è perfino un detto: il ratto sommo ammazza il gatto a morsi, e già che c'è ammazza anche l'elefante indiano.

jp: 究鼠
jp_grezzo: "究鼠"
en: kyuso
en_grezzo: "kyuso"
it: il ratto sommo

jp: 災厄の象徴とされる巨大ハムスター。その旺盛な食欲と繁殖力により一帯の食物を食い尽くしてしまう。さらに、伸び続ける前歯を削るため樹木や柱にかじりつくので、森も建物も残らない。
jp_grezzo: "災厄の象徴とされる巨大ハムスター。その旺盛な食欲と繁殖力により一帯の食物を食い尽くしてしまう。さらに、伸び続ける前歯を削るため樹木や柱にかじりつくので、森も建物も残らない。"
en: A giant hamster that is considered a symbol of disaster. Its voracious appetite and fecundity will devour the food in the area. In addition the trees and pillars are gnawed by the ever-growing front teeth so no forests or buildings are left behind.
en_grezzo: "A giant hamster that is considered a symbol of disaster. Its voracious appetite and fecundity will devour the food in the area. In addition the trees and pillars are gnawed by the ever-growing front teeth so no forests or buildings are left behind."
it: Un criceto gigantesco, che passa per il simbolo della calamità. Con quell'appetito smisurato e quella facilità a riprodursi divora tutto il cibo della zona. E siccome per limarsi gli incisivi, che gli crescono senza mai fermarsi, si mette a rosicchiare alberi e pilastri, non restano in piedi né i boschi né gli edifici.

jp: ディザスター
jp_grezzo: "ディザスター"
en: disaster
en_grezzo: "disaster"
it: il disastro

jp: 老いたハムスターが化けたもの。ハムスターの世界では、ハム将軍に仕える最高位の存在。遊ぶためにしょっちゅう脱走していなくなるので、代わりが何匹もいる。
jp_grezzo: "老いたハムスターが化けたもの。ハムスターの世界では、ハム将軍に仕える最高位の存在。遊ぶためにしょっちゅう脱走していなくなるので、代わりが何匹もいる。"
en: An elderly hamster disguised as an older hamster. In the hamster world he is the highest ranking being in the service of General Ham. They often escape to play so there are a number of substitutes.
en_grezzo: "An elderly hamster disguised as an older hamster. In the hamster world he is the highest ranking being in the service of General Ham. They often escape to play so there are a number of substitutes."
it: È un criceto che, invecchiando, si è trasformato in altro. Nel mondo dei criceti è il grado più alto al servizio del criceto generale. Siccome scappa di continuo per andare a giocare e non lo si trova mai, di sostituti ce n'è più d'uno.

jp: ハム大老
jp_grezzo: "ハム大老"
en: ham-tairou
en_grezzo: "ham-tairou"
it: il criceto gran anziano

jp: 初代ミノタウロスの別名と同じ名前を持つ牛人。星、雷光を意味する名前。ミノタウロスの中でも神がかり的な強さを持つ者だけが、こう名乗ることを許されている。
jp_grezzo: "初代ミノタウロスの別名と同じ名前を持つ牛人。星、雷光を意味する名前。ミノタウロスの中でも神がかり的な強さを持つ者だけが、こう名乗ることを許されている。"
en: A cattleman with the same name as the alias of the first Minotaur. The name means star or thunderbolt. Only those with divine strength among the minotaurs are allowed to call themselves so.
en_grezzo: "A cattleman with the same name as the alias of the first Minotaur. The name means star or thunderbolt. Only those with divine strength among the minotaurs are allowed to call themselves so."
it: Un uomo toro che porta lo stesso nome con cui si chiamava anche il primo minotauro. È un nome che vuol dire stella, e anche lampo. Fra i minotauri, a chiamarsi così sono ammessi soltanto quelli che hanno una forza da far pensare a un dio.

jp: アステリオス
jp_grezzo: "アステリオス"
en: asterios
en_grezzo: "asterios"
it: l'Asterio

jp: 人の身体に牛の頭と蹄を持つ。今でこそ化け物扱いだが、元は武器の神。性格は勇敢で忍耐強く、霧を操る能力を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "人の身体に牛の頭と蹄を持つ。今でこそ化け物扱いだが、元は武器の神。性格は勇敢で忍耐強く、霧を操る能力を持つ。"
en: A human body with the head and hooves of a cow. He is now a monster but he was once a god of weapons. His personality is brave and patient and he has the ability to control the fog.
en_grezzo: "A human body with the head and hooves of a cow. He is now a monster but he was once a god of weapons. His personality is brave and patient and he has the ability to control the fog."
it: Ha corpo d'uomo, testa e zoccoli di bue. Oggi lo trattano da mostro, ma in origine era il dio delle armi. Di carattere è coraggioso e paziente, e ha la facoltà di comandare la nebbia.

jp: シユウ
jp_grezzo: "シユウ"
en: chihyu
en_grezzo: "chihyu"
it: lo Chiyou

jp: 青い身体にものすごい力を秘めた雄牛。自分の力を制御できないことでブルーになり、よくブルブル震えている。直接話したことはないが、ブルーバブルにはなんだか親近感を覚えている。
jp_grezzo: "青い身体にものすごい力を秘めた雄牛。自分の力を制御できないことでブルーになり、よくブルブル震えている。直接話したことはないが、ブルーバブルにはなんだか親近感を覚えている。"
en: A bull with a blue body and tremendous power. They are blue from not being able to control their own power and are often burbling and shaking. I've never spoken to them directly but I feel somehow familiar with the Blue Bubble.
en_grezzo: "A bull with a blue body and tremendous power. They are blue from not being able to control their own power and are often burbling and shaking. I've never spoken to them directly but I feel somehow familiar with the Blue Bubble."
it: Un toro dal corpo azzurro, che dentro nasconde una forza spaventosa. Non riuscendo a controllarla gli viene il magone, e se ne sta lì a tremare come una foglia. Con la bolla azzurra non ci ha mai parlato di persona, ma prova per lei una specie di simpatia.

jp: ブルーブル
jp_grezzo: "ブルーブル"
en: blue bull
en_grezzo: "blue bull"
it: il toro blu

jp: 超古代の頃から搾乳や精肉のために家畜として扱われている。ミノタウロスたちからは祖先として神聖視されており、牛を解放するためにミノタウロスが人を襲うこともあるのだとか。
jp_grezzo: "超古代の頃から搾乳や精肉のために家畜として扱われている。ミノタウロスたちからは祖先として神聖視されており、牛を解放するためにミノタウロスが人を襲うこともあるのだとか。"
en: They have been domesticated for milking and for meat since ancient times. The cattle are considered sacred as ancestors by the minotaurs and the minotaurs sometimes attack people in order to free the cattle.
en_grezzo: "They have been domesticated for milking and for meat since ancient times. The cattle are considered sacred as ancestors by the minotaurs and the minotaurs sometimes attack people in order to free the cattle."
it: Fin dall'antichità più remota lo tengono come bestia da allevamento, per il latte e per la carne. I minotauri lo venerano come antenato, e pare che a volte assalgano gli uomini proprio per liberare i bovini.

jp: 牛
en: cattle
en_grezzo: "cattle"
it: il bovino

jp: ケンタウロスの中では珍しく、魔術と近接戦闘術に秀でる。派手好きな性格で、元からピカピカの鎧をさらに魔力でもって発光させている。基本的に雄しかいない。
jp_grezzo: "ケンタウロスの中では珍しく、魔術と近接戦闘術に秀でる。派手好きな性格で、元からピカピカの鎧をさらに魔力でもって発光させている。基本的に雄しかいない。"
en: Rare among the centaurs he excels in magic and melee combat. He has a flair for flamboyance making his original shiny armor glow with even more magical power. Basically there are only males.
en_grezzo: "Rare among the centaurs he excels in magic and melee combat. He has a flair for flamboyance making his original shiny armor glow with even more magical power. Basically there are only males."
it: Fra i centauri è raro: eccelle insieme nella magia e nel combattimento ravvicinato. Ama farsi notare, e l'armatura, che è già lucida di suo, se la fa pure risplendere con il potere magico. Di regola ne esistono soltanto maschi.

jp: マスタリオン
jp_grezzo: "マスタリオン"
en: mastallion
en_grezzo: "mastallion"
it: il mastallone

en: A centaur wearing full body armor. He prefers to fight alone and has a high level of pride and fighting power. He doesn't like to be put on his armor unless his opponent is very skilled.
en_grezzo: "A centaur wearing full body armor. He prefers to fight alone and has a high level of pride and fighting power. He doesn't like to be put on his armor unless his opponent is very skilled."

jp_grezzo: "小さめのバリスタであれば単独で扱えるように訓練された軍馬。馬の筋力を持ってしてもバリスタは相当重いらしく、足を止めて構えないと撃てない模様。"
en: A military horse trained to handle a small ballista on its own. Even with the muscle strength of a horse the ballista seems to be quite heavy and it cannot be shot unless it stops its feet and takes a posture.

jp: バリスタリオン

en: The centaurs have switched from bows and arrows to guns. It excels in reflexes and athleticism such as shooting a distant Indian elephant between the eyebrows while sprinting. Their favorite thing is bolt action.
en_grezzo: "The centaurs have switched from bows and arrows to guns. It excels in reflexes and athleticism such as shooting a distant Indian elephant between the eyebrows while sprinting. Their favorite thing is bolt action."
it: Un centauro che ha lasciato l'arco per l'arma da fuoco. Ha riflessi e prontezza fuori dal comune: mentre corre a perdifiato prende un elefante indiano lontanissimo in mezzo agli occhi. La cosa che gli piace di più è l'otturatore a scorrimento.

jp: ガンタウロス
jp_grezzo: "ガンタウロス"
en: gunntaurs
en_grezzo: "gunntaurs"
it: il pistolauro

en: A half-man half-horse creature. Their center of gravity is more forward than a normal horse so if they try to lean forward they might fall over. They live by hunting and farming in herds.
en_grezzo: "A half-man half-horse creature. Their center of gravity is more forward than a normal horse so if they try to lean forward they might fall over. They live by hunting and farming in herds."
it: Una creatura metà uomo e metà cavallo. Ha il baricentro più avanti di un cavallo normale, e se prova a sporgersi in avanti rischia di ribaltarsi. Vive in gruppo, di caccia e di agricoltura.

jp: ケンタウロス
jp_grezzo: "ケンタウロス"
en: kentaurs
en_grezzo: "kentaurs"
it: il centauro

jp: パンを愛しすぎた精霊が、焼きたてのパンと一つになった姿。パンの構成物質の６割が、ショクパンヨリフランスパンという謎の超硬度物質に変化している。硬さを活かして体当たりで物を破壊する。

en: A spirit who loved the bread too much became one with the freshly baked bread. Sixty percent of the bread's constituents have been transformed into a mysterious super-hard substance called shoku panyori French bread. He uses his hardness to destroy objects with his body hit.

Il sessanta per cento di quello che compone il pane si è mutato in una misteriosa sostanza durissima chiamata megliobaguettechepancarré. Quella durezza se la sfrutta: distrugge le cose prendendole a testate.

jp: パンの精霊
jp_grezzo: "パンの精霊"

en_grezzo: "spirit of bread"

en: A wisp fused with countless souls. It burns fiercely under the influence of a soul crazed with anger and hatred. Its movements are slow but it is difficult to escape because it pulls the body and soul of the opponent towards it.
en_grezzo: "A wisp fused with countless souls. It burns fiercely under the influence of a soul crazed with anger and hatred. Its movements are slow but it is difficult to escape because it pulls the body and soul of the opponent towards it."

jp: 荒鬼火
jp_grezzo: "荒鬼火"
en: araonibi
en_grezzo: "araonibi"
it: il fuoco fatuo selvaggio

en: An extremely developed discharge cloud that has been transformed by taking in a large amount of water vapor. It has a huge impact on the weather. They live by hunting birds while hovering in the air as if they were being swept away by the wind whenever the wind blows.

it: È una nube temporalesca cresciuta fino all'estremo, che a forza di inghiottire vapore acqueo ha cambiato forma. Sul tempo atmosferico pesa parecchio. Vive cacciando uccelli mentre galleggia lassù in alto, portato dove tira il vento e dove gli gira, come se lo trascinasse la corrente.

en: It features a moai extending from the core on all four sides. The moai part is a strong shield as well as a propulsion device. To prevent the core from taking damage the moai's stone head parries the attack.
en_grezzo: "It features a moai extending from the core on all four sides. The moai part is a strong shield as well as a propulsion device. To prevent the core from taking damage the moai's stone head parries the attack."
it: Lo si riconosce dai moai che gli si allungano dal nucleo verso i quattro lati. La parte dei moai è insieme il propulsore e uno scudo solido. Perché il nucleo non prenda danno, sono le teste di pietra dei moai a incassare i colpi.

jp: ヴァイフコア
jp_grezzo: "ヴァイフコア"
en: moai core
en_grezzo: "moai core"
it: il nucleo dei moai

en: A complex magic circuit is carved into the board and a huge amount of magic can be stored in the board. It has been given a provisional life and is capable of autonomous action. It is secretly tested and operated as a magical power supply device for the front lines and as a magical power battery for facilities.
en_grezzo: "A complex magic circuit is carved into the board and a huge amount of magic can be stored in the board. It has been given a provisional life and is capable of autonomous action. it: Porta inciso un circuito magico complicato, e nella lastra può accumulare una quantità enorme di potere magico. Gli hanno dato una vita provvisoria, e così si muove da sé. Lo stanno provando di nascosto come rifornitore di potere magico per la prima linea e come batteria magica per gli impianti.

jp: マナモノリス
jp_grezzo: "マナモノリス"
en: mana monolith
en_grezzo: "mana monolith"
it: il monolito di mana

en: A troubled moai scattering landmines. With sensors that are more powerful than necessary he doesn't get caught by mines himself. He is regarded as a rival by landmine dogs but he doesn't seem to care about that.
en_grezzo: "A troubled moai scattering landmines. With sensors that are more powerful than necessary he doesn't get caught by mines himself. He is regarded as a rival by landmine dogs but he doesn't seem to care about that."
it: Un moai fastidioso che semina mine a più non posso. Monta sensori più potenti del necessario, e nelle mine non ci finisce mai lui. Il cane mina lo tratta da rivale, ma a lui della faccenda pare non importi niente.

jp: クレイモアイ
jp_grezzo: "クレイモアイ"
en: claymoai
en_grezzo: "claymoai"
it: il minamoai

jp: 先代の収穫の神が使役していた魔物。大雨の夜、首のない死体から一斉に生えてきたという。関連する伝承が世界各地に多く残っており、今日では死神というと一般的にこの魔物のことを指す。
jp_grezzo: "先代の収穫の神が使役していた魔物。大雨の夜、首のない死体から一斉に生えてきたという。関連する伝承が世界各地に多く残っており、今日では死神というと一般的にこの魔物のことを指す。"
en: A demon that was used by the previous god of harvest. It is said that on a night of heavy rains a batch of headless corpses grew out of them. Many related lore survives throughout the world and today the term reaper generally refers to this demon.
en_grezzo: "A demon that was used by the previous god of harvest. It is said that on a night of heavy rains a batch of headless corpses grew out of them. Many related lore survives throughout the world and today the term reaper generally refers to this demon."
it: Un mostro che il precedente dio del raccolto teneva al proprio servizio. Si racconta che in una notte di pioggia battente ne siano spuntati tutti insieme da certi cadaveri senza testa. Di leggende su di lui ne restano tante in ogni parte del mondo, e oggi, quando si dice la morte, di solito si intende lui.

jp: 刈り取る者
jp_grezzo: "刈り取る者"
en: grim reaper
en_grezzo: "grim reaper"
it: il mietitore

jp: 死を超越しようとして禁忌に手を出した者の成れの果て。シズルコードと呼ばれる魔術書を一部解読し、その秘術でアンデッドを身体に取り込んだが失敗。本当は綺麗に融合し、３対の翼が生えてくるはずだった。
jp_grezzo: "死を超越しようとして禁忌に手を出した者の成れの果て。シズルコードと呼ばれる魔術書を一部解読し、その秘術でアンデッドを身体に取り込んだが失敗。本当は綺麗に融合し、３対の翼が生えてくるはずだった。"
en: It is the result of those who try to transcend death and meddle with the taboo. He deciphered a part of a magic book called the Ssil Code and used its magic to bring the undead into his body but failed. In truth they should have fused beautifully and sprouted three pairs of wings.
en_grezzo: "It is the result of those who try to transcend death and meddle with the taboo. He deciphered a part of a magic book called the Ssil Code and used its magic to bring the undead into his body but failed. In truth they should have fused beautifully and sprouted three pairs of wings."
it: È il punto d'arrivo di chi ha voluto superare la morte e ha messo le mani sul proibito. Decifrò una parte del libro di magia che chiamano il Codice di Ssil e, con quell'arte segreta, si fece entrare in corpo un non morto: ma andò male. Nelle intenzioni i due dovevano fondersi alla perfezione, e sarebbero dovute spuntare tre paia d'ali.

jp_grezzo: "冒涜の魔導亡者"
en: profanity priest
en_grezzo: "profanity priest"
it: il non morto blasfemo

en: A gnarled ghost created by a necromancer somewhere. The name is also intact meaning Tsugihagi in an ancient artificial language. The body is unbalanced due to the forced installation. The ego is far from unbalanced it's broken.

it: Uno spettro rattoppato, opera di un negromante di chissà dove. Anche il nome dice quello e nient'altro: in un'antica lingua artificiale vuol dire proprio rattoppato. I pezzi glieli hanno attaccati a forza, e il corpo è tutto sbilanciato. L'io, più che sbilanciato, è andato in pezzi da un pezzo.

jp_grezzo: "ミクシフォーナ"
en: mikscxifona
en_grezzo: "mikscxifona"
it: la mikscxifona

en: Concerned about being consumed by the war between the nations he gathered his comrades and formed a mercenary group. He has saved his comrades many times with his superior survivorship and many mercenaries look up to him as a mentor. When he's not working as a mercenary he's farming at his parents' house.

it: Si chiese perché mai dovesse lasciarsi consumare nelle liti fra un paese e l'altro, e allora raccolse dei compagni e mise in piedi una compagnia di ventura. Ha salvato i commilitoni infinite volte, tanto sa cavarsela, e non pochi mercenari lo prendono per maestro. Quando non c'è lavoro da mercenario, torna a casa dei suoi a fare il contadino.

jp: 歴戦の傭兵『シュライダ』
jp_grezzo: "歴戦の傭兵『シュライダ』"
en: <Shuraida> the expert merc
en_grezzo: "<Shuraida> the expert merc"
it: <Shuraida> il mercenario veterano

jp: 黒いオーラの部分が本体。バフォメットの死骸を操って活動する。細菌を魔術で生成・制御して甚大な被害をもたらす。だが扱うのが封印当時の細菌ベースで、制御なしだとイルヴァの現代生物にはほぼ効かない。
jp_grezzo: "黒いオーラの部分が本体。バフォメットの死骸を操って活動する。細菌を魔術で生成・制御して甚大な被害をもたらす。だが扱うのが封印当時の細菌ベースで、制御なしだとイルヴァの現代生物にはほぼ効かない。"

But the infection is based on germs from the time of the sealing and without control it is almost ineffective against modern creatures in Irva.

Solo che i batteri da cui parte sono quelli di quando lo sigillarono, e senza il suo governo sulle creature della Irva di oggi non fanno quasi niente.

jp: 疫病の悪魔『ロアトニス』
jp_grezzo: "疫病の悪魔『ロアトニス』"
en: <Roatonis> the infections
en_grezzo: "<Roatonis> the infections"

it: Una lumaca rinforzata da cima a fondo con la magia oscura. Un mago malintenzionato di chissà dove la creò per puro divertimento e la liberò all'aperto, e quella si moltiplicò a dismisura. Le chiocciole selvatiche dicono di lei che è un tipo cupo, e che avvicinarla mette soggezione.

jp: ダークネスラッグ
jp_grezzo: "ダークネスラッグ"
en: darknesslug

it: Un orso enorme che ha preso il gusto della carne umana. Si spinge fin sotto le case senza farsi problemi, e a una preda che ha scelto non rinuncia più. Lo si ritiene un dio malvagio, e dai tempi più antichi la gente gli dà la caccia per sterminarlo.

jp: ウェンカムイ
jp_grezzo: "ウェンカムイ"
en: wenkamui
en_grezzo: "wenkamui"
it: il wenkamui

jp: 遺跡から発見された生体兵器。ボディの一部が機械や装甲に置き換えられた虎。獣の俊敏さを生かした連続突進を避けるのは困難。ぎらぎらと発光していることからその名がつけられたようだ。
jp_grezzo: "遺跡から発見された生体兵器。ボディの一部が機械や装甲に置き換えられた虎。獣の俊敏さを生かした連続突進を避けるのは困難。ぎらぎらと発光していることからその名がつけられたようだ。"
en: Bioweapons discovered in the ruins. A tiger whose body has been partially replaced by a machine or armor. It's hard to avoid continuous rushes with the agility of a beast. It seems to have been named after the glittering lights.
en_grezzo: "Bioweapons discovered in the ruins. A tiger whose body has been partially replaced by a machine or armor. It's hard to avoid continuous rushes with the agility of a beast. It seems to have been named after the glittering lights."
it: Un'arma biologica ritrovata fra le rovine: una tigre a cui hanno sostituito parte del corpo con macchine e corazze. Sfrutta l'agilità della belva per caricare a ripetizione, ed è difficile scansarla. Il nome pare che le venga da quel suo luccicare accecante.

jp: グレア
jp_grezzo: "グレア"
en: glare tiger
en_grezzo: "glare tiger"
it: la tigre abbagliante

jp: ライオンをベースとして呪術で生み出された合成獣。人並の知能…というより完全に人の知性を有しており、生み出される際にいったいどんなことが行われたのか気になるところである。
jp_grezzo: "ライオンをベースとして呪術で生み出された合成獣。人並の知能…というより完全に人の知性を有しており、生み出される際にいったいどんなことが行われたのか気になるところである。"
en: A synthetic beast based on a lion and spawned through magic. It has the intelligence of a human or rather the intelligence of a complete human and it is curious to know what was done when it was created.
en_grezzo: "A synthetic beast based on a lion and spawned through magic. It has the intelligence of a human or rather the intelligence of a complete human and it is curious to know what was done when it was created."
it: Una bestia sintetica generata con le arti maledette a partire da un leone. Ha un'intelligenza pari a quella di un uomo... anzi, ha proprio l'intelligenza di un uomo, e vien voglia di sapere che cosa sia successo davvero mentre la creavano.

jp: 呪縛のマンティコア
jp_grezzo: "呪縛のマンティコア"
en: manticore
en_grezzo: "manticore"
it: la manticora della maledizione

jp: カーバンクルの亜種であり、より小型。しかし魔力は通常種よりも強く、様々なモンスターを召喚することができる。伝説上の生き物とされてきたが、今日ではその伝説の内容を知るものが一人もいない。
jp_grezzo: "カーバンクルの亜種であり、より小型。しかし魔力は通常種よりも強く、様々なモンスターを召喚することができる。伝説上の生き物とされてきたが、今日ではその伝説の内容を知るものが一人もいない。"
en: It is a subspecies of the carbuncle and is smaller. However its magic power is stronger than that of the normal species and it can summon a variety of monsters. It was once considered a fabled creature but today no one knows what the legend is.
en_grezzo: "It is a subspecies of the carbuncle and is smaller. However its magic power is stronger than that of the normal species and it can summon a variety of monsters. It was once considered a fabled creature but today no one knows what the legend is."
it: Una sottospecie del carbonchio, più minuta. Il potere magico però ce l'ha più forte di quella comune, e riesce a evocare mostri di ogni sorta. È sempre stato considerato una creatura da leggenda, ma oggi non c'è più nessuno che sappia dire che cosa raccontasse quella leggenda.

jp: ルビーカーバンクル
jp_grezzo: "ルビーカーバンクル"
en: ruby carbuncle
en_grezzo: "ruby carbuncle"
it: il carbonchio rubino

jp: 悪夢が羊の形をとったもの。逃げる羊を追いかけていくと、いつの間にか悪夢に迷い込んでいるという。もしも…あなたが夢の中でこの羊に会ってしまった場合、「決して目を合わせてはいけない」
jp_grezzo: "悪夢が羊の形をとったもの。逃げる羊を追いかけていくと、いつの間にか悪夢に迷い込んでいるという。もしも…あなたが夢の中でこの羊に会ってしまった場合、「決して目を合わせてはいけない」"
en: The nightmare took the form of a sheep. He chases a fleeing sheep but before he knows it he's lost in a nightmare. If...you have met this sheep in your dreams Never make eye contact.
en_grezzo: "The nightmare took the form of a sheep. He chases a fleeing sheep but before he knows it he's lost in a nightmare. If...you have met this sheep in your dreams Never make eye contact."
it: Un incubo che ha preso la forma di una pecora. Si dice che a inseguire la pecora che scappa ci si ritrovi smarriti dentro l'incubo senza nemmeno accorgersene. E se mai... se mai in sogno dovesse capitarti di incontrare questa pecora: non incrociare mai il suo sguardo.

jp: 悪夢の化身
jp_grezzo: "悪夢の化身"
en: nightmare sheep
en_grezzo: "nightmare sheep"
it: l'incarnazione dell'incubo

jp: エウダーナで過剰なまでの魔術改造を施された黒い羊。可視光線を吸収し姿を消すことができる。透明化して敵に近づき生気を奪う。名前が示す通り、まさに外道。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナで過剰なまでの魔術改造を施された黒い羊。可視光線を吸収し姿を消すことができる。透明化して敵に近づき生気を奪う。名前が示す通り、まさに外道。"
en: A black sheep that has been subjected to an excessive amount of magical modification in Eulderna. It can absorb visible light and disappear. They turn invisible and approach the enemy taking their life away. As the name implies it is truly an outsider.
en_grezzo: "A black sheep that has been subjected to an excessive amount of magical modification in Eulderna. It can absorb visible light and disappear. They turn invisible and approach the enemy taking their life away. As the name implies it is truly an outsider."
it: Una pecora nera su cui a Eulderna hanno accanito le modifiche magiche fino all'eccesso. Assorbe la luce visibile e sparisce alla vista. Si fa invisibile, si accosta al nemico e gli succhia via il soffio vitale. Come dice il nome, ha proprio smarrito la retta via.

jp: アストレイ・シープ
jp_grezzo: "アストレイ・シープ"
en: astray sheep
en_grezzo: "astray sheep"
it: la pecora smarrita

jp: 迷える子羊が心身ともに成長し、迷いを乗り越えた姿。その瞳を覗き込めば、固い決意と覚悟に満ち溢れていることがわかるだろう。迷える子羊を優しく見守り、時には導く存在。
jp_grezzo: "迷える子羊が心身ともに成長し、迷いを乗り越えた姿。その瞳を覗き込めば、固い決意と覚悟に満ち溢れていることがわかるだろう。迷える子羊を優しく見守り、時には導く存在。"
en: A lost lamb grows up in mind and body and overcomes his hesitation. If you look into those eyes you can see that they are full of determination and resolve. He is a gentle watcher and sometimes a guide to the lost lamb.
en_grezzo: "A lost lamb grows up in mind and body and overcomes his hesitation. If you look into those eyes you can see that they are full of determination and resolve. He is a gentle watcher and sometimes a guide to the lost lamb."
it: È la pecorella smarrita che, cresciuta nel corpo e nell'animo, ha vinto lo smarrimento. Basta guardarlo negli occhi per accorgersi che è colmo di decisione e di fermezza. Veglia con dolcezza sulle pecorelle smarrite, e ogni tanto le guida.

jp: 迷いなき大羊
jp_grezzo: "迷いなき大羊"
en: not stray sheep
en_grezzo: "not stray sheep"
it: il grande montone mai smarrito

jp: 羽の生えた魔力ある蛇神。割と小柄で、５ｍ程度しかない。体から発散している悪臭と毒は疫病神すらも逃げ出す程強烈で、実際に撃退したことがある。毒をもって毒を制すとはこのことだろう。
jp_grezzo: "羽の生えた魔力ある蛇神。割と小柄で、５ｍ程度しかない。体から発散している悪臭と毒は疫病神すらも逃げ出す程強烈で、実際に撃退したことがある。毒をもって毒を制すとはこのことだろう。"
en: A feathered and magical serpent god. It is relatively small only about 5 meters long. The stench and poison that is emanating from the body is so strong that even the pestilence god runs away and has actually been repelled. This is what it means to conquer poison with poison isn't it?
en_grezzo: "A feathered and magical serpent god. It is relatively small only about 5 meters long. The stench and poison that is emanating from the body is so strong that even the pestilence god runs away and has actually been repelled. This is what it means to conquer poison with poison isn't it?"
it: Un serpente divino, alato e pieno di potere magico. È piuttosto minuto: non arriva ai 5 metri. Il fetore e il veleno che gli escono dal corpo sono così violenti da mettere in fuga perfino il dio della pestilenza, e una volta è successo davvero. Ecco che cosa vuol dire vincere il veleno col veleno.

jp: オヤウカムイ
jp_grezzo: "オヤウカムイ"
en: oyaukamui
en_grezzo: "oyaukamui"
it: l'oyaukamui

jp: 石のように重い声で鳴く蛇。よって鳴蛇。4枚の翼を持ち、水中に巣を作る。水源地を占拠したり雲の中の水分を吸ったりするため、天敵のいない地域ではかんばつが起きる。
jp_grezzo: "石のように重い声で鳴く蛇。よって鳴蛇。4枚の翼を持ち、水中に巣を作る。水源地を占拠したり雲の中の水分を吸ったりするため、天敵のいない地域ではかんばつが起きる。"
en: A snake with a voice as heavy as stone. They have four wings and build a nest in the water. As they occupy water source areas and absorb moisture in the clouds drought occurs in areas without natural enemies.
en_grezzo: "A snake with a voice as heavy as stone. They have four wings and build a nest in the water. As they occupy water source areas and absorb moisture in the clouds drought occurs in areas without natural enemies."
it: Un serpente che stride con una voce pesante come la pietra: di qui il suo nome. Ha quattro ali e fa il nido sott'acqua. Occupa le sorgenti e succhia via l'acqua dentro le nuvole, e così dove non ha nemici naturali arriva la siccità.

jp: メイダ
jp_grezzo: "メイダ"
en: meida
en_grezzo: "meida"
it: la meida

jp: キッカス原産の蛇でその体長は20ｍ程度にもなる。毒はないが締めつける力が強く、馬や熊が絞殺される。ペットとして連れてこられたものが飼い主を食い殺して脱走し増殖、今日では世界中で家畜を襲っている。
jp_grezzo: "キッカス原産の蛇でその体長は20ｍ程度にもなる。毒はないが締めつける力が強く、馬や熊が絞殺される。ペットとして連れてこられたものが飼い主を食い殺して脱走し増殖、今日では世界中で家畜を襲っている。"
en: This snake is native to Kikkas and its body can be as long as 20 meters. It's not poisonous but it's a tightening force and it strangles horses and bears. Those brought in as pets devour their owners escape and multiply and today attack livestock all over the world.
en_grezzo: "This snake is native to Kikkas and its body can be as long as 20 meters. It's not poisonous but it's a tightening force and it strangles horses and bears. Those brought in as pets devour their owners escape and multiply and today attack livestock all over the world."
it: Un serpente originario di Kikkasu, che arriva a una ventina di metri di lunghezza. Veleno non ne ha, ma stringe con una forza tale da strangolare cavalli e orsi. Quelli portati via come animali da compagnia si sono mangiati il padrone, sono scappati e si sono moltiplicati, e oggi assaltano il bestiame in tutto il mondo.

jp: キッカスパイソン
jp_grezzo: "キッカスパイソン"
en: kikkas pythonidae
en_grezzo: "kikkas pythonidae"
it: il pitone di Kikkasu

jp: 地獄の泥から作られたゴーレム。力が強くて普通に危険なのだが、地獄の冷気をまとっており掠っただけでも生気を吸い取られてしまう。あの世に送られた邪悪な魔術師が生み出したとされる。
jp_grezzo: "地獄の泥から作られたゴーレム。力が強くて普通に危険なのだが、地獄の冷気をまとっており掠っただけでも生気を吸い取られてしまう。あの世に送られた邪悪な魔術師が生み出したとされる。"
en: A golem made from the mud of hell. It is powerful and normally dangerous but it is covered with the cold air of hell and even if it is grazed its life will be lost. It is said to have been created by an evil sorcerer sent to the other world.
en_grezzo: "A golem made from the mud of hell. It is powerful and normally dangerous but it is covered with the cold air of hell and even if it is grazed its life will be lost. It is said to have been created by an evil sorcerer sent to the other world."
it: Un golem fatto col fango dell'inferno. È forte, e già così sarebbe pericoloso, ma per giunta è avvolto nel gelo infernale: basta che ti sfiori e ti succhia via il soffio vitale. Si dice che l'abbia creato un mago malvagio spedito nell'aldilà.

jp: ネザーマッドゴーレム
jp_grezzo: "ネザーマッドゴーレム"
en: mad mud golem
en_grezzo: "mad mud golem"
it: il golem di fango dell'oltretomba

jp: 強靭な筋肉の塊。構造・成り立ちから間違いなくゴーレムに分類され、人造人間などとはまた趣が異なる。筋肉の維持に生物を取り込む必要があるのだが、他生物の遺伝子が混ざりすぎると暴走してしまう。
jp_grezzo: "強靭な筋肉の塊。構造・成り立ちから間違いなくゴーレムに分類され、人造人間などとはまた趣が異なる。筋肉の維持に生物を取り込む必要があるのだが、他生物の遺伝子が混ざりすぎると暴走してしまう。"
en: A mass of strong muscle. It is definitely categorized as a golem because of its structure and composition and it has a different flavor from an artificial person. They need to take the organism in to maintain their muscles but if the genes of other organisms get mixed in too much they run amok.
en_grezzo: "A mass of strong muscle. It is definitely categorized as a golem because of its structure and composition and it has a different flavor from an artificial person. They need to take the organism in to maintain their muscles but if the genes of other organisms get mixed in too much they run amok."
it: Un ammasso di muscoli tenacissimi. Per come è fatto e per come è nato va senza dubbio contato fra i golem, ed è tutt'altra cosa dagli uomini artificiali. Per mantenere i muscoli deve inglobare altri esseri viventi, ma se i geni degli altri si mescolano troppo perde il controllo e si scatena.

jp: マッスルゴーレム
jp_grezzo: "マッスルゴーレム"
en: muscle golem
en_grezzo: "muscle golem"
it: il golem muscoloso

jp: 10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。「辺境の家ほど珍しいお菓子がある」という謎の噂が子供たちの間で広がっており、僻地が逆に人気の模様。かなり本気度の高い仮装で有名。
jp_grezzo: "10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。「辺境の家ほど珍しいお菓子がある」という謎の噂が子供たちの間で広がっており、僻地が逆に人気の模様。かなり本気度の高い仮装で有名。"
en: On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. A mysterious rumor is spreading among children that there are more rare treats than a frontier house and it seems that the frontier is becoming more popular in turn. They are famous for their rather serious fancy dress.
en_grezzo: "On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. A mysterious rumor is spreading among children that there are more rare treats than a frontier house and it seems that the frontier is becoming more popular in turn. They are famous for their rather serious fancy dress."
it: Quando arriva ottobre si traveste e si presenta a casa d'altri. Fra i bambini gira una voce misteriosa, che più la casa è sperduta più i dolci sono rari, e così le zone fuori mano sono diventate le più ambite. È famoso per travestimenti fatti con una serietà notevole.

jp: 仮装子
jp_grezzo: "仮装子"
en: halloween children
en_grezzo: "halloween children"
it: il bambino in maschera

jp: 10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。怖いもの知らずであり、お菓子のためなら魔物の群れも突っ切り、冒険者の家にも飛び込む。とてつもない執念深さを恐れて居留守を使う家庭も多い。
jp_grezzo: "10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。怖いもの知らずであり、お菓子のためなら魔物の群れも突っ切り、冒険者の家にも飛び込む。とてつもない執念深さを恐れて居留守を使う家庭も多い。"
en: On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. They are fearless and will fight through a pack of demons for sweets even jumping into the homes of adventurers. There are many families who fear that they will be extremely vindictive.
en_grezzo: "On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. They are fearless and will fight through a pack of demons for sweets even jumping into the homes of adventurers. There are many families who fear that they will be extremely vindictive."
it: Quando arriva ottobre si traveste e si presenta a casa d'altri. Non conosce paura: per un dolce attraversa un branco di mostri e si butta perfino dentro casa di un avventuriero. Molte famiglie ne temono l'ostinazione smisurata e fanno finta di non essere in casa.

jp: 遺跡から発見された量産型の恐竜メカ。解析したところ、ジラをモデルとして作られたことが判明した。パワーはあるが格闘戦は苦手で、ホバー能力を用いて距離を取り、砲撃戦を展開する。
jp_grezzo: "遺跡から発見された量産型の恐竜メカ。解析したところ、ジラをモデルとして作られたことが判明した。パワーはあるが格闘戦は苦手で、ホバー能力を用いて距離を取り、砲撃戦を展開する。"
en: A mass-produced dinosaur mecha that was discovered in the ruins. Analysis revealed that it was built with Zilla as a model. He has power but is not good at fighting and uses his hover ability to gain distance and engage in gunfights.
en_grezzo: "A mass-produced dinosaur mecha that was discovered in the ruins. Analysis revealed that it was built with Zilla as a model. He has power but is not good at fighting and uses his hover ability to gain distance and engage in gunfights."
it: Un dinosauro meccanico di serie, ritrovato fra le rovine. Analizzandolo si è scoperto che l'hanno costruito prendendo a modello lo zilla. La potenza ce l'ha, ma il corpo a corpo non fa per lui: si alza da terra per tenere le distanze e apre il fuoco da lontano.

jp: メカジラ
jp_grezzo: "メカジラ"
en: metal zilla
en_grezzo: "metal zilla"
it: il Meccazilla

jp: 数十ｍサイズの霧状の怪物。肉食性であり、普段は雲に擬態して船などを襲っている。捕食の際には体の一部を固体化させ、口などの器官を作り出す。
jp_grezzo: "数十ｍサイズの霧状の怪物。肉食性であり、普段は雲に擬態して船などを襲っている。捕食の際には体の一部を固体化させ、口などの器官を作り出す。"
en: A foggy monster several tens of meters in size. It is carnivorous and usually mimics a cloud to attack ships. During predation it solidifies parts of its body and produces organs such as its mouth.
en_grezzo: "A foggy monster several tens of meters in size. It is carnivorous and usually mimics a cloud to attack ships. During predation it solidifies parts of its body and produces organs such as its mouth."
it: Un mostro fatto di nebbia, grande alcune decine di metri. È carnivoro, e di solito si finge nuvola per assalire le navi e simili. Quando divora si solidifica una parte del corpo e si fabbrica una bocca e gli altri organi che gli servono.

jp: クラウドビースト
jp_grezzo: "クラウドビースト"
en: cloud beast
en_grezzo: "cloud beast"
it: la bestia di nuvola

jp: 百ｍ前後もの体長を持つ巨大で細長い生物。不可視の存在。旺盛な食欲で大地を食らい、他の星を死滅させたこともある。イルヴァではギガモールという天敵がおり、たまらず地上へ逃げてくることが多い。
jp_grezzo: "百ｍ前後もの体長を持つ巨大で細長い生物。不可視の存在。旺盛な食欲で大地を食らい、他の星を死滅させたこともある。イルヴァではギガモールという天敵がおり、たまらず地上へ逃げてくることが多い。"
en: A huge slender creature with a body length of around one hundred meters. An invisible presence. It has devoured the earth with its voracious appetite and has even killed other stars. In Irva there is a natural enemy called Gigamor and it often runs away to the ground in desperation.
en_grezzo: "A huge slender creature with a body length of around one hundred meters. An invisible presence. It has devoured the earth with its voracious appetite and has even killed other stars. In Irva there is a natural enemy called Gigamor and it often runs away to the ground in desperation."
it: Un essere enorme e affusolato, lungo attorno ai cento metri. Alla vista non c'è. Con la sua fame smisurata divora la terra, e altri pianeti li ha già fatti morire. A Irva però ha un nemico naturale, la talpa colossale, e spesso non ce la fa più e scappa in superficie.

jp: ドール
jp_grezzo: "ドール"
en: dhole
en_grezzo: "dhole"
it: il dhole

jp: 神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。鬼の中でも上位の存在。自らでも抑えきれないほどの高い魔力を持ち、体から漏れる魔力が「輝き」を放つ。
jp_grezzo: "神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。鬼の中でも上位の存在。自らでも抑えきれないほどの高い魔力を持ち、体から漏れる魔力が「輝き」を放つ。"
en: They are originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. It is a high ranking among the demons. It possesses a high level of magical power that is uncontrollable even by itself and the magical power leaking from its body gives off a glow.
en_grezzo: "They are originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. It is a high ranking among the demons. It possesses a high level of magical power that is uncontrollable even by itself and the magical power leaking from its body gives off a glow."
it: Una creatura soprannaturale che ha lati da dio, da demone e da spirito della terra, ma in origine era un uomo. Fra i suoi simili sta in alto. Ha un potere magico così grande che nemmeno lui riesce a contenerlo, e quello che gli trabocca dal corpo manda un bagliore.
