it: la mascotte a ore

jp: 長い間、森とそこで暮らす生き物たちを守ってきた。寿命が尽きたその時、森の生き物たちの信仰心によって、白き炎に包まれ神への転生を果たした。
jp_grezzo: "長い間、森とそこで暮らす生き物たちを守ってきた。寿命が尽きたその時、森の生き物たちの信仰心によって、白き炎に包まれ神への転生を果たした。"
en: For a long time he protected the forest and the creatures that live in it. At the end of his life he was reincarnated as a god enveloped in white fire by the faith of the creatures of the forest.
en_grezzo: "For a long time he protected the forest and the creatures that live in it. At the end of his life he was reincarnated as a god enveloped in white fire by the faith of the creatures of the forest."
it: Per lunghissimo tempo ha protetto la foresta e le creature che ci vivono. E quando la sua vita è arrivata al termine, la fede di quelle creature lo ha avvolto in una fiamma bianca e lo ha fatto rinascere dio.

jp: 白炎の『エストーク』
jp_grezzo: "白炎の『エストーク』"
en: <Estork> the doggod
en_grezzo: "<Estork> the doggod"
it: <Estork> la bianca fiamma

jp: 遺伝子操作により生み出された人工生命体。エーテルの生成・散布器官をもち広範囲を浄化する。対メシェーラの切り札だったが量産される前にレム・イドは滅亡した。
jp_grezzo: "遺伝子操作により生み出された人工生命体。エーテルの生成・散布器官をもち広範囲を浄化する。対メシェーラの切り札だったが量産される前にレム・イドは滅亡した。"
en: Genetically engineered artificial life forms. It has an ether generation and dispersal organ and can spread to a wide range of areas. It was a trump card against Meshera but Rehmido was destroyed before it could be mass-produced.
en_grezzo: "Genetically engineered artificial life forms. It has an ether generation and dispersal organ and can spread to a wide range of areas. It was a trump card against Meshera but Rehmido was destroyed before it could be mass-produced."
it: Una forma di vita artificiale nata dalla manipolazione dei geni. Ha un organo che produce e diffonde l'etere, e purifica aree molto vaste. Era la carta vincente contro i Meshera, ma Rehm-Ido cadde prima che se ne potessero fare in quantità.

jp: 『エーテルジェネレイター』
jp_grezzo: "『エーテルジェネレイター』"
en: <Ether Generator>
en_grezzo: "<Ether Generator>"
it: <Ether Generator>

jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。普段は皆シェルターで生活しており、庭園に出るのは月に一度ほど。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。普段は皆シェルターで生活しており、庭園に出るのは月に一度ほど。"
en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. They all live in a shelter and only go out to the garden about once a month.
en_grezzo: "The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. They all live in a shelter and only go out to the garden about once a month."
it: Discende da chi sopravvisse alla civiltà di Rehm-Ido. Vivono tutti dentro il rifugio, e nel giardino escono si e no una volta al mese.

jp: 旧人類
jp_grezzo: "旧人類"
en: old humankind
en_grezzo: "old humankind"
it: l'umano arcaico

jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威とエーテルの加護について次の世代に語り継ぐのが主な仕事。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威とエーテルの加護について次の世代に語り継ぐのが主な仕事。"
en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. His main job is to tell the next generation about the threat of Meshera and the blessings of the ether.
en_grezzo: "The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. His main job is to tell the next generation about the threat of Meshera and the blessings of the ether."
it: Discende da chi sopravvisse alla civiltà di Rehm-Ido. Il suo compito principale è raccontare a chi verrà dopo che cosa sono la minaccia dei Meshera e la protezione dell'etere.

jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威をよくわかっておらず、外の世界に憧れを抱いている。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威をよくわかっておらず、外の世界に憧れを抱いている。"
en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. He is not familiar with the threats of Meshera and has a longing for the outside world.
en_grezzo: "The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. He is not familiar with the threats of Meshera and has a longing for the outside world."
it: Discende da chi sopravvisse alla civiltà di Rehm-Ido. Che cosa sia la minaccia dei Meshera non l'ha ben capito, e il mondo di fuori lo attira.

jp: 元は三匹のドラゴンだったが、元素のイツパロトルの加護を受け神化を果たした。火炎と氷という、相反する属性のブレスを融合させるだけの実力はない。
jp_grezzo: "元は三匹のドラゴンだったが、元素のイツパロトルの加護を受け神化を果たした。火炎と氷という、相反する属性のブレスを融合させるだけの実力はない。"
en: He was originally three dragons but with the blessing of the elemental Itzparotl he became a deity. It does not have the ability to merge the conflicting attributes of fire and ice breaths.
en_grezzo: "He was originally three dragons but with the blessing of the elemental Itzparotl he became a deity. It does not have the ability to merge the conflicting attributes of fire and ice breaths."
it: In origine erano tre draghi, poi la protezione di Itzpalt degli elementi li ha fatti diventare un dio. Ma la stoffa per fondere in un soffio solo due elementi opposti come il fuoco e il ghiaccio non ce l'ha.

jp: エレメントドラゴン
jp_grezzo: "エレメントドラゴン"
en: element dragon
en_grezzo: "element dragon"
it: il drago elementale

jp: 全ての魔族の頂点に立つ王。退屈症のため暇つぶし感覚でイルヴァにやってきている。強い魔力を持ち、深い絆が無ければ王の洗脳を跳ね除けるのは困難である。
jp_grezzo: "全ての魔族の頂点に立つ王。退屈症のため暇つぶし感覚でイルヴァにやってきている。強い魔力を持ち、深い絆が無ければ王の洗脳を跳ね除けるのは困難である。"
en: The king who stands at the top of all the demon races. They come to Irva to pass the time due to boredom. Without strong magic and a deep bond it would be difficult to repel the king's brainwashing.
en_grezzo: "The king who stands at the top of all the demon races. They come to Irva to pass the time due to boredom. Without strong magic and a deep bond it would be difficult to repel the king's brainwashing."
it: Il re che sta in cima a tutte le stirpi demoniache. Si annoia, e viene a Irva tanto per passare il tempo. Ha un potere magico forte: senza un legame profondo, scrollarsi di dosso il lavaggio del cervello del re è difficile.

jp: 魔王
jp_grezzo: "魔王"
en: demon's ruler
en_grezzo: "demon's ruler"
it: il re dei demoni

jp: 下位の悪魔達を束ね治める領主。調子に乗った部下を一喝するのも仕事の一環。人の下につくのが嫌で全力で振り落としに掛かるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "下位の悪魔達を束ね治める領主。調子に乗った部下を一喝するのも仕事の一環。人の下につくのが嫌で全力で振り落としに掛かるらしい。"
en: A lord who unites and reigns over the lower demons. It's part of the job to cheer up a subordinate who's in a bad mood. They don't like to get under people so they try their best to shake them off.
en_grezzo: "A lord who unites and reigns over the lower demons. It's part of the job to cheer up a subordinate who's in a bad mood. They don't like to get under people so they try their best to shake them off."
it: Il signore che tiene insieme e governa i demoni di grado inferiore. Zittire con un urlo il sottoposto che si monta la testa fa parte del mestiere. Stare sotto qualcuno non gli va giù, e pare che faccia di tutto per scrollarselo di dosso.

jp: デモンズロード
jp_grezzo: "デモンズロード"
en: demon's lord
en_grezzo: "demon's lord"
it: il signore dei demoni

jp: 堕落と原罪をこよなく愛する一般的な悪魔。他者を虐げることを好しとする彼らの戦闘能力は高い。肉弾戦でも魔法でも並の人間を上回るだろう。
jp_grezzo: "堕落と原罪をこよなく愛する一般的な悪魔。他者を虐げることを好しとする彼らの戦闘能力は高い。肉弾戦でも魔法でも並の人間を上回るだろう。"
en: A general devil who loves depravity and original sin immensely. Their fighting ability is high as they prefer to bully others. They would outperform the average human both in physical combat and in magic.
en_grezzo: "A general devil who loves depravity and original sin immensely. Their fighting ability is high as they prefer to bully others. They would outperform the average human both in physical combat and in magic."
it: Un demone qualunque, che ama alla follia la corruzione e il peccato d'origine. Poiché il suo gusto è calpestare gli altri, in combattimento vale molto: nel corpo a corpo e nella magia batte l'uomo comune.

jp: デーモン
jp_grezzo: "デーモン"
en: demon
en_grezzo: "demon"
it: il demone

jp: 深い洞窟内であろうと特殊電波により通信が可能。開発主任が直々に設計開発しておりやたら高性能。待機中は自動で戦闘行動を行い、データも収集する。
jp_grezzo: "深い洞窟内であろうと特殊電波により通信が可能。開発主任が直々に設計開発しておりやたら高性能。待機中は自動で戦闘行動を行い、データも収集する。"
en: Special radio waves can be used to communicate even in deep caves. It is designed and developed directly by the chief developer and is very high performance. While on standby it automatically performs combat actions and also collects data.
en_grezzo: "Special radio waves can be used to communicate even in deep caves. It is designed and developed directly by the chief developer and is very high performance. While on standby it automatically performs combat actions and also collects data."
it: Con le sue onde speciali riesce a comunicare perfino in fondo a una grotta. L'ha progettato e costruito di persona il capo dello sviluppo, e infatti rende una cosa esagerata. Quando è in attesa combatte da solo e intanto raccoglie dati.

jp: 『イェルス自律戦闘通信機』
jp_grezzo: "『イェルス自律戦闘通信機』"
en: <Mobile Communication Equipment>
en_grezzo: "<Mobile Communication Equipment>"
it: <Apparato di comunicazione mobile>

jp: イルヴァで最も強い毒を持つ生物として有名。特定の巣を持たず集団で移動と襲撃を繰り返し生活する。獰猛で攻撃的であり、非常に危険。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァで最も強い毒を持つ生物として有名。特定の巣を持たず集団で移動と襲撃を繰り返し生活する。獰猛で攻撃的であり、非常に危険。"
en: It is renowned as the most poisonous creature in Irva. They do not have a specific nest and live in groups repeatedly moving and attacking. They are fierce aggressive and very dangerous.
en_grezzo: "It is renowned as the most poisonous creature in Irva. They do not have a specific nest and live in groups repeatedly moving and attacking. They are fierce aggressive and very dangerous."
it: È famoso come la creatura dal veleno più forte di tutta Irva. Un nido suo non ce l'ha: vive in sciame e passa la vita a spostarsi e a piombare addosso a qualcuno. È feroce e aggressivo, e pericolosissimo.

jp: ブラックホーネット
jp_grezzo: "ブラックホーネット"
en: black hornet
en_grezzo: "black hornet"
it: il calabrone nero

jp: 神と星の加護を受けて変異したサソリ。一見何の変哲もない普通のサソリだが、その神経毒で動けなくなり殺される冒険者は後を断たない。
jp_grezzo: "神と星の加護を受けて変異したサソリ。一見何の変哲もない普通のサソリだが、その神経毒で動けなくなり殺される冒険者は後を断たない。"
en: A scorpion mutated with the blessings of the gods and stars. At first glance it appears to be an ordinary scorpion but there is no shortage of adventurers who are paralyzed and killed by its neurotoxin.
en_grezzo: "A scorpion mutated with the blessings of the gods and stars. At first glance it appears to be an ordinary scorpion but there is no shortage of adventurers who are paralyzed and killed by its neurotoxin."
it: Uno scorpione mutato sotto la protezione degli dei e delle stelle. A prima vista è uno scorpione come tanti, ma il suo veleno prende i nervi, e di avventurieri che restano immobili e ci lasciano la pelle non si finisce mai di contarne.

jp: オリオンキラー
jp_grezzo: "オリオンキラー"
en: Orion killer
en_grezzo: "Orion killer"
it: l'uccisore di Orione

jp: 進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種…のさらなる変異体。骨と筋肉の構造が特殊であり、片翼での攻撃でも異常な破壊力をたたき出す。
jp_grezzo: "進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種…のさらなる変異体。骨と筋肉の構造が特殊であり、片翼での攻撃でも異常な破壊力をたたき出す。"
en: A further mutant of a subspecies of the dragon...born in the process of evolution. It has a special bone and muscle structure and even a single-winged attack can be unusually destructive.
en_grezzo: "A further mutant of a subspecies of the dragon...born in the process of evolution. It has a special bone and muscle structure and even a single-winged attack can be unusually destructive."
it: Una sottospecie di drago nata lungo il cammino dell'evoluzione, e poi mutata un'altra volta ancora. Ha ossa e muscoli fatti in modo particolare: perfino un colpo dato con una sola ala sprigiona una potenza distruttiva fuori dal comune.

jp: バリアント・ワイバーン
jp_grezzo: "バリアント・ワイバーン"
en: valiant wyvern
en_grezzo: "valiant wyvern"
it: la viverna valorosa

jp: 混沌の力を操る黒きユニコーン。複数のモンスターが互いに取り込みあい融合した混沌の化身。偉いことには違いないのだが、混沌の神にはそこまで好かれていないようだ。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の力を操る黒きユニコーン。複数のモンスターが互いに取り込みあい融合した混沌の化身。偉いことには違いないのだが、混沌の神にはそこまで好かれていないようだ。"
en: A black unicorn that controls the power of chaos. An incarnation of chaos where multiple monsters have taken each other in and fused together. It must be a huge feat but the god of chaos doesn't seem to like it that much.
en_grezzo: "A black unicorn that controls the power of chaos. An incarnation of chaos where multiple monsters have taken each other in and fused together. It must be a huge feat but the god of chaos doesn't seem to like it that much."
it: Un unicorno nero che comanda la forza del caos. È l'incarnazione del caos, nata da più mostri che si sono divorati a vicenda e poi fusi insieme. Che sia una gran cosa non c'è dubbio, ma pare che al dio del caos non stia poi tanto simpatico.

jp: 混沌の王『カオス・ユニコーン』
jp_grezzo: "混沌の王『カオス・ユニコーン』"
en: <Chaos Unicorn> King of Chaos
en_grezzo: "<Chaos Unicorn> King of Chaos"
it: <Unicorno del Caos> il re del caos

jp: 混沌より生み出された眷属。混沌に呑まれ素材とされた者たちの意識が混ざり合っている。素材の中には混沌に立ち向かった勇士も混ざっているのだとか。
jp_grezzo: "混沌より生み出された眷属。混沌に呑まれ素材とされた者たちの意識が混ざり合っている。素材の中には混沌に立ち向かった勇士も混ざっているのだとか。"
en: The spawn of chaos. The consciousness of those who have been swallowed by chaos and made into material is blended. The material is mixed with the warriors who stood up to the chaos.
en_grezzo: "The spawn of chaos. The consciousness of those who have been swallowed by chaos and made into material is blended. The material is mixed with the warriors who stood up to the chaos."
it: Un figlio del caos, generato dal caos stesso. Dentro di lui si mescolano le coscienze di quelli che il caos ha inghiottito e usato come materia prima. E fra quella materia, dicono, ci sono anche i valorosi che gli tennero testa.

jp: カオス・スピリット
jp_grezzo: "カオス・スピリット"
en: chaos spirit
en_grezzo: "chaos spirit"
it: lo spirito del caos

jp: 素早い動きで敵をかく乱しつつ多方向から攻撃を行う。兵士のサポート用に言語機能を標準搭載している。ちょろちょろついてくるのもあって、ペット感覚で扱う兵士も多い。
jp_grezzo: "素早い動きで敵をかく乱しつつ多方向から攻撃を行う。兵士のサポート用に言語機能を標準搭載している。ちょろちょろついてくるのもあって、ペット感覚で扱う兵士も多い。"
en: It attacks from multiple directions while disrupting the enemy with its quick movements. It comes standard with a language feature for supporting soldiers. There are also many soldiers who follow along and treat it as a pet.
en_grezzo: "It attacks from multiple directions while disrupting the enemy with its quick movements. It comes standard with a language feature for supporting soldiers. There are also many soldiers who follow along and treat it as a pet."
it: Si muove svelto, scompiglia il nemico e intanto lo attacca da più parti insieme. Di serie ha la funzione della lingua, per dare una mano ai soldati. E siccome trotterella dietro a tutti, molti soldati lo trattano come un animale di casa.

jp: ゼイレン支援攻撃端末
jp_grezzo: "ゼイレン支援攻撃端末"
en: Xeren satellite unit
en_grezzo: "Xeren satellite unit"
it: il terminale d'attacco Xeren

jp: 機械文明の遺産。レールガンの開発過程で生まれた雷撃砲を搭載している。基本は自走砲であるため最低限の装甲しか取り付けられていない。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明の遺産。レールガンの開発過程で生まれた雷撃砲を搭載している。基本は自走砲であるため最低限の装甲しか取り付けられていない。"
en: The legacy of mechanical civilization. It is equipped with a lightning cannon that was created during the development of the railgun. Since it is basically a self-propelled artillery it is equipped with only minimal armor.
en_grezzo: "The legacy of mechanical civilization. It is equipped with a lightning cannon that was created during the development of the railgun. Since it is basically a self-propelled artillery it is equipped with only minimal armor."
it: Un lascito della civiltà delle macchine. Monta il cannone a fulmini che venne fuori mentre si metteva a punto il cannone elettromagnetico. In sostanza è un pezzo semovente, e infatti di corazza ne ha il minimo indispensabile.

jp: ゼイレン自走雷撃砲
jp_grezzo: "ゼイレン自走雷撃砲"
en: Xeren electric tank
en_grezzo: "Xeren electric tank"
it: il semovente a fulmini di Xeren

jp: ボコノン教を守るための存在。教徒がカラースの本来の目的から逸脱しそうになったとき、思考を打ち消し馬鹿げたものにしてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "ボコノン教を守るための存在。教徒がカラースの本来の目的から逸脱しそうになったとき、思考を打ち消し馬鹿げたものにしてしまう。"
en: They exist to defend Bokononism. When the congregation is about to deviate from the original purpose of Kalas they cancel out the thought and render it foolish.
en_grezzo: "They exist to defend Bokononism. When the congregation is about to deviate from the original purpose of Kalas they cancel out the thought and render it foolish."
it: Esiste per difendere il bokononismo. Quando un fedele sta per allontanarsi dallo scopo vero del karass, gli cancella il pensiero e glielo riduce a una sciocchezza.

jp: カラースの番人
jp_grezzo: "カラースの番人"
en: wrang-wrang
en_grezzo: "wrang-wrang"
it: il guardiano del karass

jp: 3年もの間グウェンは心無い冒険者に捕まっていた。命からがら脱走に成功したが過酷な環境は少女を冷酷な戦士へと変えたのだった。
jp_grezzo: "3年もの間グウェンは心無い冒険者に捕まっていた。命からがら脱走に成功したが過酷な環境は少女を冷酷な戦士へと変えたのだった。"
en: For three years Gwen has been held captive by a heartless adventurer. She manages to escape with her life but the harsh environment has turned her into a ruthless warrior.
en_grezzo: "For three years Gwen has been held captive by a heartless adventurer. She manages to escape with her life but the harsh environment has turned her into a ruthless warrior."
it: Per tre anni interi Gwen è rimasta prigioniera di un avventuriero senza cuore. È riuscita a fuggire per il rotto della cuffia, ma quella vita durissima aveva ormai fatto della ragazzina una guerriera spietata.

jp: 無慈悲な戦士『グウェン』
jp_grezzo: "無慈悲な戦士『グウェン』"
en: <Gwen> the pitiless
en_grezzo: "<Gwen> the pitiless"
it: <Gwen> la guerriera spietata

jp: 主を守れなかった騎士の嘆きと絶望が呪いを生み、所持していた盾を変化させた。守るべきものを求めて彷徨う。しかし騎士の顔がへばりついているのが気味悪いので誰も護衛してほしがらない。
jp_grezzo: "主を守れなかった騎士の嘆きと絶望が呪いを生み、所持していた盾を変化させた。守るべきものを求めて彷徨う。しかし騎士の顔がへばりついているのが気味悪いので誰も護衛してほしがらない。"
en: The lament and despair of the knight's failure to protect the Lord gave rise to a curse that transformed the shield in his possession. It wanders in search of things to protect. However no one wants to be escorted because the knight's face is so creepy.
en_grezzo: "The lament and despair of the knight's failure to protect the Lord gave rise to a curse that transformed the shield in his possession. It wanders in search of things to protect. However no one wants to be escorted because the knight's face is so creepy."
it: Il lamento e la disperazione di un cavaliere che non era riuscito a proteggere il suo signore generarono una maledizione, e la maledizione trasformò lo scudo che teneva in mano. Vaga in cerca di qualcosa da proteggere; ma il viso del cavaliere ci è rimasto appiccicato sopra, e fa un effetto tale che nessuno lo vuole come scorta.

jp: グリーフシールド
jp_grezzo: "グリーフシールド"
en: <Grief Shield>
en_grezzo: "<Grief Shield>"
it: <Scudo del Dolore>

jp: 音もなく静かに獲物に忍び寄る。だがその図体のせいですぐに見つかってしまう。一応、霧を発生させるなどの工夫はするのだが…。
jp_grezzo: "音もなく静かに獲物に忍び寄る。だがその図体のせいですぐに見つかってしまう。一応、霧を発生させるなどの工夫はするのだが…。"
en: They creep up on their prey quietly and without sound. But because of its figure it was soon discovered. It's trying to create a fog but...
en_grezzo: "They creep up on their prey quietly and without sound. But because of its figure it was soon discovered. It's trying to create a fog but..."
it: Si avvicina alla preda in silenzio, senza fare il minimo rumore. Solo che, con quel corpaccione, la scoprono subito. Qualcosa per rimediare la fa, tipo tirare fuori la nebbia, ma insomma.

jp: サイレント・ヒル
jp_grezzo: "サイレント・ヒル"
en: silent leech
en_grezzo: "silent leech"
it: la sanguisuga silenziosa

jp: 獲物めがけて長距離を跳躍する。200メートル以上も跳ぶものもいる。跳びついたあとはひたすら血を吸う。獲物に避けられても華麗に着地する技術を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "獲物めがけて長距離を跳躍する。200メートル以上も跳ぶものもいる。跳びついたあとはひたすら血を吸う。獲物に避けられても華麗に着地する技術を持つ。"
en: They leap long distances in pursuit of their prey some jumping over 200 meters. After jumping it sucks blood. It has the skill to land brilliantly even when its prey avoids it.
en_grezzo: "They leap long distances in pursuit of their prey some jumping over 200 meters. After jumping it sucks blood. It has the skill to land brilliantly even when its prey avoids it."
it: Spicca salti lunghissimi puntando alla preda, e ce n'è che supera i duecento metri. Una volta arrivata addosso, succhia sangue e basta. E anche quando la preda si scansa, sa atterrare con eleganza.

jp: フライング・ヒル
jp_grezzo: "フライング・ヒル"
en: flying leech
en_grezzo: "flying leech"
it: la sanguisuga volante

jp: ただ街を散歩しているだけなのに、なぜかとても嬉しそうにしている変な市民。まるで忍者のように俊敏なうえ、手裏剣を隠し持っている。
jp_grezzo: "ただ街を散歩しているだけなのに、なぜかとても嬉しそうにしている変な市民。まるで忍者のように俊敏なうえ、手裏剣を隠し持っている。"
en: It's a strange citizen who is just strolling around town but somehow seems very happy about it. In addition to being as agile as a ninja she has a hidden shuriken.
en_grezzo: "It's a strange citizen who is just strolling around town but somehow seems very happy about it. In addition to being as agile as a ninja she has a hidden shuriken."
it: Una cittadina strana: passeggia per la città e nient'altro, eppure ha un'aria felicissima. Oltre a essere svelta come una ninja, tiene nascosti addosso degli shuriken.

jp: 市民のライエ
jp_grezzo: "市民のライエ"
en: new citizen
en_grezzo: "new citizen"
it: la cittadina

jp: 主人を守るため色々なものを犠牲にして魔法を会得した少女。いったいどんな苦痛を経験してきたのか、かなりひどい目に遭っても全然平気。
jp_grezzo: "主人を守るため色々なものを犠牲にして魔法を会得した少女。いったいどんな苦痛を経験してきたのか、かなりひどい目に遭っても全然平気。"
en: A girl who sacrificed many things to protect her master and mastered magic. She doesn't care at all what kind of pain she's been through even though she's been through some pretty bad things.
en_grezzo: "A girl who sacrificed many things to protect her master and mastered magic. She doesn't care at all what kind of pain she's been through even though she's been through some pretty bad things."
it: Una bambina che ha imparato la magia sacrificando ogni sorta di cosa, pur di proteggere il suo padrone. Chissà quali dolori ha passato: per quanto la concino male, a lei non fa né caldo né freddo.

jp: Ｍ少女
jp_grezzo: "Ｍ少女"
en: M girl
en_grezzo: "M girl"
it: la bambina masochista

jp: ものすごく駄目な姉。身だしなみやお洒落に全く興味がないどころか、寝癖を直す気すらない。最低限、下着さえつけていればジャージも着なくていいんじゃないかと最近思い始めている。
jp_grezzo: "ものすごく駄目な姉。身だしなみやお洒落に全く興味がないどころか、寝癖を直す気すらない。最低限、下着さえつけていればジャージも着なくていいんじゃないかと最近思い始めている。"
en: She's a very bad sister. Not only does she have no interest in grooming or dressing up she doesn't even bother to fix her sleeping habits. Recently she's started to think that she doesn't have to wear a jersey as long as she's wearing at least some underwear.
en_grezzo: "She's a very bad sister. Not only does she have no interest in grooming or dressing up she doesn't even bother to fix her sleeping habits. Recently she's started to think that she doesn't have to wear a jersey as long as she's wearing at least some underwear."
it: Una sorella maggiore buona a nulla, ma proprio a nulla. Non solo di curarsi e di vestirsi bene non le importa niente: non ha nemmeno voglia di aggiustarsi i capelli schiacciati dal cuscino. Di recente ha cominciato a pensare che, purché addosso ci sia almeno la biancheria, la tuta si potrebbe anche non metterla.

jp: 駄目姉
jp_grezzo: "駄目姉"
en: lazy older sister
en_grezzo: "lazy older sister"
it: la sorella maggiore buona a nulla

jp: 事故で主人と離ればなれになった犬。はぐれた先で変異を繰り返しながら外敵と戦い続けた結果、悪魔を退けるほどの力を身に着けた。
jp_grezzo: "事故で主人と離ればなれになった犬。はぐれた先で変異を繰り返しながら外敵と戦い続けた結果、悪魔を退けるほどの力を身に着けた。"
en: The dog was separated from her master by an accident. As a result of repeatedly mutating and fighting external enemies at the point where she got separated she became powerful enough to fend off demons.
en_grezzo: "The dog was separated from her master by an accident. As a result of repeatedly mutating and fighting external enemies at the point where she got separated she became powerful enough to fend off demons."
it: Una cagna che un incidente ha separato dal suo padrone. Là dove si era persa ha continuato a battersi contro i nemici, mutando una volta dopo l'altra, e alla fine si è ritrovata forte abbastanza da respingere un demone.

jp: イヌの偉大なる『パスカル』
jp_grezzo: "イヌの偉大なる『パスカル』"
en: <Pascal>
en_grezzo: "<Pascal>"
it: <Pascal>

jp: 年を経た亀が変異した。元が亀とは思えないほど素早い。四肢は自らの意思で形状変化させることができる。悪ガキが近寄ってくるとプラズマを吐いて消し炭にする。
jp_grezzo: "年を経た亀が変異した。元が亀とは思えないほど素早い。四肢は自らの意思で形状変化させることができる。悪ガキが近寄ってくるとプラズマを吐いて消し炭にする。"
en: A tortoise that has mutated over the years. It is so fast that it is hard to believe that it was originally a tortoise. Its limbs can change shape at will. When a naughty kid comes close to it, it spits out plasma to obliterate the kid.
en_grezzo: "A tortoise that has mutated over the years. It is so fast that it is hard to believe that it was originally a tortoise. Its limbs can change shape at will. When a naughty kid comes close to it, it spits out plasma to obliterate the kid."
it: È una tartaruga che, con gli anni, è mutata. È così svelta che non si direbbe mai che tartaruga lo fosse davvero. Le zampe può cambiarle di forma quando le pare. E se le si avvicina un monello, gli sputa addosso il plasma e lo riduce in cenere.

jp: 玄武の『レイキ』
jp_grezzo: "玄武の『レイキ』"
en: <Leiki>
en_grezzo: "<Leiki>"
it: <Leiki> la tartaruga nera

jp: 九頭竜の子孫。その触手のような髪の毛を巧みに操る。何万年も海の底で暮らしていたため、地上の世界に興味深々。お弁当作りが趣味で、時々レイキに材料を買いに行ってもらっている。
jp_grezzo: "九頭竜の子孫。その触手のような髪の毛を巧みに操る。何万年も海の底で暮らしていたため、地上の世界に興味深々。お弁当作りが趣味で、時々レイキに材料を買いに行ってもらっている。"
en: Descendant of the nine-headed dragon. She is skilled in manipulating her tentacle-like hair. Having lived at the bottom of the sea for tens of thousands of years, she is deeply interested in the world above ground. She enjoys making lunch boxes and sometimes asks Leiki to go shopping for ingredients.
en_grezzo: "Descendant of the nine-headed dragon. She is skilled in manipulating her tentacle-like hair. Having lived at the bottom of the sea for tens of thousands of years, she is deeply interested in the world above ground. She enjoys making lunch boxes and sometimes asks Leiki to go shopping for ingredients."
it: Discende dal drago a nove teste. Maneggia con maestria quei suoi capelli che paiono tentacoli. Ha vissuto decine di migliaia di anni in fondo al mare, e il mondo di sopra la incuriosisce moltissimo. Il suo passatempo è preparare cestini da pranzo, e ogni tanto manda Leiki a comprare gli ingredienti.

jp: 深海の姫『ミヅキ』
jp_grezzo: "深海の姫『ミヅキ』"
en: <Mizuki> The Abyss Princess
en_grezzo: "<Mizuki> The Abyss Princess"
it: <Mizuki> la principessa dell'abisso

jp: 元々は普通の魚だったものがミヅキの神気にあてられ変化した存在。今では彼女と彼女の祖先を崇拝する奉仕種族となっている。
jp_grezzo: "元々は普通の魚だったものがミヅキの神気にあてられ変化した存在。今では彼女と彼女の祖先を崇拝する奉仕種族となっている。"
en: Originally an normal fish, they were transformed by Mizuki's divine energy. They are now a service tribe that worships her and her ancestors.
en_grezzo: "Originally an normal fish, they were transformed by Mizuki's divine energy. They are now a service tribe that worships her and her ancestors."
it: Era un pesce come tanti, poi il soffio divino di Mizuki lo ha investito e lo ha cambiato. Adesso è una stirpe di servitori, che venera lei e i suoi antenati.

jp: 海底生物
jp_grezzo: "海底生物"
en: abyss animal
en_grezzo: "abyss animal"
it: la creatura dei fondali

jp: 魔法国家に滅ぼされた国の戦士のなれの果て。次々と浴びせられる魔法にも怯まず、祖国のため最期まで戦い抜いた英雄。
jp_grezzo: "魔法国家に滅ぼされた国の戦士のなれの果て。次々と浴びせられる魔法にも怯まず、祖国のため最期まで戦い抜いた英雄。"
en: The last of the warriors of a kingdom destroyed by a magical kingdom. A hero who fought to the last for his country, undaunted by the magic that was hurled at him one after another.
en_grezzo: "The last of the warriors of a kingdom destroyed by a magical kingdom. A hero who fought to the last for his country, undaunted by the magic that was hurled at him one after another."
it: È quel che resta del guerriero di un regno che una nazione di maghi ha distrutto. Un eroe che non si perse d'animo sotto le magie che gli piovevano addosso una dopo l'altra, e si batté per la patria fino all'ultimo.

jp: 屍の英雄
jp_grezzo: "屍の英雄"
en: skeleton hero
en_grezzo: "skeleton hero"
it: l'eroe cadaverico

jp: 戦友を想う心が愛用の銃に宿り、持ち主の死後に魂と結合し精霊と化した。死してもなお、どこかの誰かのために戦い続ける存在。
jp_grezzo: "戦友を想う心が愛用の銃に宿り、持ち主の死後に魂と結合し精霊と化した。死してもなお、どこかの誰かのために戦い続ける存在。"
en: The love for one's comrades-in-arms is embodied in one's favourite gun, which combines with the soul after the owner's death and transforms into a spirit. Even in death, he continues to fight for someone somewhere.
en_grezzo: "The love for one's comrades-in-arms is embodied in one's favourite gun, which combines with the soul after the owner's death and transforms into a spirit. Even in death, he continues to fight for someone somewhere."
it: Il pensiero rivolto ai compagni d'arme si annidò nel fucile che il padrone aveva sempre con sé; poi il padrone morì, l'anima si unì all'arma e ne venne fuori uno spirito. Anche da morto continua a battersi per qualcuno, da qualche parte.

jp: スピリット・レイナーダ
jp_grezzo: "スピリット・レイナーダ"
en: gun spirit
en_grezzo: "gun spirit"
it: lo spirito delle armi

jp: イルヴァ土着の深海の住人。もとは別の神を崇めていたが、ミヅキの祖先の強い神気にあてられて改宗した。生まれた時はほぼ人の姿だが、歳をとるにつれて魚っぽくなっていく。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァ土着の深海の住人。もとは別の神を崇めていたが、ミヅキの祖先の強い神気にあてられて改宗した。生まれた時はほぼ人の姿だが、歳をとるにつれて魚っぽくなっていく。"
en: Indigenous Irva inhabitants of the deep sea. Originally worshipped other deities, but converted due to the strong divine spirit of Mizuki's ancestors. At birth, they are almost human in appearance, but as they age they become more fish-like.
en_grezzo: "Indigenous Irva inhabitants of the deep sea. Originally worshipped other deities, but converted due to the strong divine spirit of Mizuki's ancestors. At birth, they are almost human in appearance, but as they age they become more fish-like."
it: Gente degli abissi, nativa di Irva. Un tempo venerava un altro dio, poi il soffio divino potente degli antenati di Mizuki la investì e la fece convertire. Alla nascita ha quasi la forma di un uomo, ma invecchiando somiglia sempre di più a un pesce.

jp: 深淵の住人
jp_grezzo: "深淵の住人"
en: abyss dweller
en_grezzo: "abyss dweller"
it: l'abitante dell'abisso

jp: とても高貴な生まれ。物腰こそ柔らかだが、その性格は残虐で冷徹。使用人を戯れで皆殺しにしてしまい、もう少し頑丈な使用人を探している。来ている服こそ白いが、その実態は果てしなく黒い。
jp_grezzo: "とても高貴な生まれ。物腰こそ柔らかだが、その性格は残虐で冷徹。使用人を戯れで皆殺しにしてしまい、もう少し頑丈な使用人を探している。来ている服こそ白いが、その実態は果てしなく黒い。"
en: A young lady of very noble birth. She has a soft manner, but her nature is cruel and cold-hearted. She kills all her servants for fun and is looking for a sturdier servant. Her clothes are white, but in reality she is endlessly black.
en_grezzo: "A young lady of very noble birth. She has a soft manner, but her nature is cruel and cold-hearted. She kills all her servants for fun and is looking for a sturdier servant. Her clothes are white, but in reality she is endlessly black."
it: Di nascita nobilissima. I modi sono garbati, ma il carattere è crudele e gelido. Per gioco ha ammazzato tutta la servitù, e adesso cerca servitori un po' più robusti. Il vestito che porta è bianco; quello che c'è sotto è nero senza fondo.

jp: 黒お嬢様
jp_grezzo: "黒お嬢様"
en: white young lady
en_grezzo: "white young lady"
it: la signorina dal cuore nero

jp: 現在の神々のまとめ役。三元素を司る。話が難しいうえに長いのでやや避けられ気味。本来は若々しい姿と他の神より強い力を持っているのだが、今はそのどちらも一部テスカトリポカのものとなっている。
jp_grezzo: "現在の神々のまとめ役。三元素を司る。話が難しいうえに長いのでやや避けられ気味。本来は若々しい姿と他の神より強い力を持っているのだが、今はそのどちらも一部テスカトリポカのものとなっている。"
en: Head of the current group of deities. Governs the three elements. He is somewhat avoided because of his difficult and long story. He originally has a youthful appearance and more power than the other gods, but both of these are now partly the properties of Tezcatlipoca.
en_grezzo: "Head of the current group of deities. Governs the three elements. He is somewhat avoided because of his difficult and long story. He originally has a youthful appearance and more power than the other gods, but both of these are now partly the properties of Tezcatlipoca."
it: È lui che tiene insieme gli dei di adesso, e governa i tre elementi. Parla difficile e parla lungo, e per questo lo evitano un po' tutti. Di suo avrebbe un aspetto giovane e una forza superiore a quella degli altri dei, ma oggi l'uno e l'altra sono in parte roba di Tezcatlipoca.

jp: 《元素のイツパロトル》
jp_grezzo: "《元素のイツパロトル》"
en: <Itzpalt>
en_grezzo: "<Itzpalt>"
it: <Itzpalt>

jp: 自らが支配する三元素の力を極限まで昇華させたイツパロトル。体が周囲の元素とリンクしたことによりマナの総量が膨れ上がっている。
jp_grezzo: "自らが支配する三元素の力を極限まで昇華させたイツパロトル。体が周囲の元素とリンクしたことによりマナの総量が膨れ上がっている。"
en: Itzparotl has sublimated the power of the three elements he controls to the utmost limit. The total amount of mana has swelled as a result of the body's link with the surrounding elements.
en_grezzo: "Itzparotl has sublimated the power of the three elements he controls to the utmost limit. The total amount of mana has swelled as a result of the body's link with the surrounding elements. "
it: È Itzpalt che ha portato all'estremo la forza dei tre elementi su cui comanda. Il corpo gli si è legato agli elementi che ha intorno, e per questo la sua mana è cresciuta a dismisura.

jp: 《エレメンティード》
jp_grezzo: "《エレメンティード》"
en: <The Element>
en_grezzo: "<The Element>"
it: <L'Elemento>

jp: 商売が好きで相手が神でも人でも魔物でも分け隔てなく取引を行う。お金にうるさく1gpの無駄も許さない。最近手に入れた石のお金がお気に入り。
jp_grezzo: "商売が好きで相手が神でも人でも魔物でも分け隔てなく取引を行う。お金にうるさく1gpの無駄も許さない。最近手に入れた石のお金がお気に入り。"
en: She loves business and will trade with anyone, whether they are gods, men or demons. She is very picky about money and will not allow even 1gp to be wasted. Loves the stone money she has recently acquired.
en_grezzo: "She loves business and will trade with anyone, whether they are gods, men or demons. She is very picky about money and will not allow even 1gp to be wasted. Loves the stone money she has recently acquired."
it: Le piace commerciare, e tratta senza fare differenze con gli dei, con gli uomini e con i mostri. Sui soldi è pignola e non ammette che si sprechi neanche una moneta d'oro. Ultimamente va matta per certe monete di pietra che si è procurata.

jp: 《富のヤカテクト》
jp_grezzo: "《富のヤカテクト》"
en: <Yacatect>
en_grezzo: "<Yacatect>"
it: <Yacatect>

jp: 激昂したヤカテクト。完全に我を忘れており、大事なコレクションを投げつけるなどの暴挙におよぶ。落ち着いた後はそのことで自己嫌悪に陥る。
jp_grezzo: "激昂したヤカテクト。完全に我を忘れており、大事なコレクションを投げつけるなどの暴挙におよぶ。落ち着いた後はそのことで自己嫌悪に陥る。"
en: Yacatect in a rage. She completely loses control of herself and goes on a rampage, throwing her precious collection at people. After she calms down, she suffers from self-loathing over the incident.
en_grezzo: "Yacatect in a rage. She completely loses control of herself and goes on a rampage, throwing her precious collection at people. After she calms down, she suffers from self-loathing over the incident."
it: Yacatect fuori di sé dalla rabbia. Non è più in sé per niente e arriva a scagliare addosso alla gente la sua preziosa collezione. Quando poi si calma, si detesta per quello che ha fatto.

jp: 《ハイパー・ヤカテクト》
jp_grezzo: "《ハイパー・ヤカテクト》"
en: <Hyper Yacatect>
en_grezzo: "<Hyper Yacatect>"
it: <Iper Yacatect>

jp: 石像の如き気品を漂わせる巨大な鳥。ほとんど動かないがそれは獲物に警戒心を抱かせないためである。とは言え、その目つきは鋭すぎて警戒せざるを得ない。
jp_grezzo: "石像の如き気品を漂わせる巨大な鳥。ほとんど動かないがそれは獲物に警戒心を抱かせないためである。とは言え、その目つきは鋭すぎて警戒せざるを得ない。"
en: A huge bird with the elegance of a stone statue. It is almost motionless, but this is so as not to alarm its prey. Nevertheless, its eyes are so sharp that one has no choice but to be wary.
en_grezzo: "A huge bird with the elegance of a stone statue. It is almost motionless, but this is so as not to alarm its prey. Nevertheless, its eyes are so sharp that one has no choice but to be wary."
it: Un uccello enorme, che emana la nobiltà di una statua di pietra. Non si muove quasi mai, e lo fa per non mettere in allarme la preda. Solo che ha uno sguardo talmente tagliente che in allarme ci si mette lo stesso.

jp: ハシビロコウさん
jp_grezzo: "ハシビロコウさん"
en: shoebill

it: il signor becco a scarpa

jp_grezzo: "弛まぬ鍛錬の末に人である事を捨てたもの。質量のある残像で敵を翻弄し、物量で押し潰す様は正に圧巻。木を隠すなら森の中、隠密機動の真髄がここにある。"
en: A ninja that, after relentless training, has abandoned the idea of being a human. The way it uses its massive afterimages to toy with the enemy and crush them with its sheer mass is truly breathtaking. They say that if you want to hide a tree, hide in the forest, the essence of covert manoeuvre is mastered by this ninja.
en_grezzo: "A ninja that, after relentless training, has abandoned the idea of being a human. The way it uses its massive afterimages to toy with the enemy and crush them with its sheer mass is truly breathtaking. They say that if you want to hide a tree, hide in the forest, the essence of covert manoeuvre is mastered by this ninja."
it: Uno che, dopo un allenamento senza tregua, ha smesso di essere un uomo. Confonde il nemico con immagini residue che hanno una massa vera e poi lo schiaccia con la quantità: uno spettacolo. Se vuoi nascondere un albero, nascondilo nel bosco: l'essenza del movimento furtivo sta tutta qui.

jp: レッドニンジャ
jp_grezzo: "レッドニンジャ"
en: red ninja
en_grezzo: "red ninja"
it: il ninja rosso

en: From an early age, she often ran away from home because she could not endure the rigorous training of the ninja. She does not have a very favourable view of ninjas. She has not been able to show her ability because she does not want to, but her brother and father saw that Eila had the potential to be a prodigious ninja.
en_grezzo: "From an early age, she often ran away from home because she could not endure the rigorous training of the ninja. She does not have a very favourable view of ninjas. She has not been able to show her ability because she does not want to, but her brother and father saw that Eila had the potential to be a prodigious ninja."
it: Da piccola non reggeva l'addestramento durissimo dei ninja e scappava spesso di casa. I ninja non le vanno tanto a genio. Siccome fa tutto controvoglia non rende quanto potrebbe, ma il fratello e il padre lo avevano capito, che Eila ha la stoffa del ninja geniale.

jp: 抜け忍の『影羅』
jp_grezzo: "抜け忍の『影羅』"
en: <Eila> the fugitive Kunoichi
en_grezzo: "<Eila> the fugitive Kunoichi"
it: <Eila> la kunoichi fuggiasca

jp: 幼い頃から忍者の厳しい修行に耐えてきた。若くして忍者軍団の頭領を務める。非常に厳格。特技は変わり身の術で、熟練の冒険者ですら欺く。
jp_grezzo: "幼い頃から忍者の厳しい修行に耐えてきた。若くして忍者軍団の頭領を務める。非常に厳格。特技は変わり身の術で、熟練の冒険者ですら欺く。"
en: He has endured the rigours of ninja training since childhood. He became chieftain of the ninja army at a young age. Extremely strict.His speciality is the art of shapeshifting, which can fool even the most seasoned adventurers.
en_grezzo: "He has endured the rigours of ninja training since childhood. He became chieftain of the ninja army at a young age. Extremely strict.His speciality is the art of shapeshifting, which can fool even the most seasoned adventurers."
it: Fin da piccolo ha retto l'addestramento durissimo dei ninja, e ancora giovane è diventato capo della schiera. È di una severità estrema. La sua specialità è l'arte della sostituzione, con cui inganna perfino l'avventuriero più smaliziato.

jp: 忍者ファイター『月影』
jp_grezzo: "忍者ファイター『月影』"
en: <Getuei> the ninja master
en_grezzo: "<Getuei> the ninja master"
it: <Getuei> il maestro ninja

jp: まっすぐで頑張り屋な性格だが、錬金術に関してはマッドな一面も見せる。錬金術の師と色々あって、ふかふかパン恐怖症になっている。
jp_grezzo: "まっすぐで頑張り屋な性格だが、錬金術に関してはマッドな一面も見せる。錬金術の師と色々あって、ふかふかパン恐怖症になっている。"
en: She has a straightforward and hard-working personality, but also shows a mad side when it comes to alchemy. She has a soft-bread phobia after a lot of things with her alchemy teacher.
en_grezzo: "She has a straightforward and hard-working personality, but also shows a mad side when it comes to alchemy. She has a soft-bread phobia after a lot of things with her alchemy teacher."
it: Di carattere è schietta e gran lavoratrice, ma quando si parla di alchimia mostra anche un lato da folle. Col suo maestro di alchimia ne sono successe di tutti i colori, e da allora ha il terrore del pane soffice.

en: Alchemist <Naplus>
en_grezzo: "Alchemist <Naplus>"
it: <Naplus> l'alchimista

jp: 同じ境遇のシラハとはとても仲が良い。それだけに引っ越すことが決まった際には大泣きし、「定期的に手紙のやり取りをする」と約束するまで離れなかった。
jp_grezzo: "同じ境遇のシラハとはとても仲が良い。それだけに引っ越すことが決まった際には大泣きし、「定期的に手紙のやり取りをする」と約束するまで離れなかった。"
en: She is very close to Siraha, who is experiencing the same difficulties since young. So much so that when she decided to move out, she cried a lot and didn't leave until he promised to exchange letters with her on a regular basis.
en_grezzo: "She is very close to Siraha, who is experiencing the same difficulties since young. So much so that when she decided to move out, she cried a lot and didn't leave until he promised to exchange letters with her on a regular basis."
it: Con Siraha, che ha avuto la sua stessa sorte, va d'accordissimo. Tanto che, quando si decise il trasloco, pianse a dirotto e non si staccò da lui finché non le promise che si sarebbero scritti con regolarità.

jp: 黒衣の『クロン』
jp_grezzo: "黒衣の『クロン』"
en: <Kuron> the black cloth
en_grezzo: "<Kuron> the black cloth"

jp: ヤギという、紙を食べる生物が祖先にいたらしい。そのせいか紙を見ると無意識に口に運んでしまう。今までに34回ほど、書いてる最中の手紙をうっかり食べてしまっている。
jp_grezzo: "ヤギという、紙を食べる生物が祖先にいたらしい。そのせいか紙を見ると無意識に口に運んでしまう。今までに34回ほど、書いてる最中の手紙をうっかり食べてしまっている。"
en: Goats, a paper-eating creature, are said to have been among their ancestors. Perhaps because of this, when he sees a piece of paper, he unconsciously brings it to his mouth. Until now, he has accidentally eaten a letter he was in the middle of writing about 34 times.
en_grezzo: "Goats, a paper-eating creature, are said to have been among their ancestors. Perhaps because of this, when he sees a piece of paper, he unconsciously brings it to his mouth. Until now, he has accidentally eaten a letter he was in the middle of writing about 34 times."
it: Pare che fra i suoi antenati ci fosse la capra, una bestia che mangia la carta. Sarà per questo che, quando vede un foglio, se lo porta alla bocca senza nemmeno accorgersene. Fino a oggi gli è capitato trentaquattro volte di mangiarsi per sbaglio la lettera che stava scrivendo.

jp: 白皙の『シラハ』
jp_grezzo: "白皙の『シラハ』"
en: <Siraha> the white cloth
en_grezzo: "<Siraha> the white cloth"
it: <Siraha> la pelle candida

jp: 安住の地を求めて街から街へと渡り歩く根無し草。資金を得て観光客になるか、力を得て冒険者や傭兵になるか人それぞれの道である。
jp_grezzo: "安住の地を求めて街から街へと渡り歩く根無し草。資金を得て観光客になるか、力を得て冒険者や傭兵になるか人それぞれの道である。"
en: Rootless people go from town to town in search of a safe haven. Each person's path is his or her own, whether to become a tourist for funds or an adventurer or mercenary for power.
en_grezzo: "Rootless people go from town to town in search of a safe haven. Each person's path is his or her own, whether to become a tourist for funds or an adventurer or mercenary for power."
it: Gente senza radici, che va di città in città in cerca di un posto dove fermarsi in pace. Chi mette insieme i quattrini si fa turista, chi mette insieme la forza va all'avventura o si fa mercenario: ognuno prende la sua strada.

jp: 旅人
jp_grezzo: "旅人"
en: traveler
en_grezzo: "traveler"

jp: 森を焼かれロスリアに移住したが、ロスリアの堕落とともに世界中へと散らばった難民。彼らは故郷も希望も失ったのに、真実が明かされた後も迫害だけは残っていた。
jp_grezzo: "森を焼かれロスリアに移住したが、ロスリアの堕落とともに世界中へと散らばった難民。彼らは故郷も希望も失ったのに、真実が明かされた後も迫害だけは残っていた。"
en: The refugees, who were burned out of their forests and settled in Lothria, were scattered all over the world with the fall of Lothria. They lost their homes and hope, but only persecution remained after the truth was revealed.
en_grezzo: "The refugees, who were burned out of their forests and settled in Lothria, were scattered all over the world with the fall of Lothria. They lost their homes and hope, but only persecution remained after the truth was revealed. "
it: Gli hanno bruciato la foresta e sono andati a stare a Lothria; poi Lothria è caduta in disgrazia e loro si sono sparsi per il mondo. Avevano perduto la patria e la speranza, e quando la verità è venuta a galla l'unica cosa che è rimasta è stata la persecuzione.

jp: エレアの難民
jp_grezzo: "エレアの難民"
en: refugee
en_grezzo: "refugee"
it: il profugo degli Elea

jp: カジノは誰をも拒むこと無く、一攫千金を夢見る者を歓迎する。カジノスタッフは、彼らがギャンブルに挑むその姿を心から応援しているのだ。その客が金を落とす限りは。
jp_grezzo: "カジノは誰をも拒むこと無く、一攫千金を夢見る者を歓迎する。カジノスタッフは、彼らがギャンブルに挑むその姿を心から応援しているのだ。その客が金を落とす限りは。"
en: The casino never rejects anyone and welcomes those who dream of getting rich. The casino staff are heartily supportive of their gambling endeavours. As long as the customer loses money.
en_grezzo: "The casino never rejects anyone and welcomes those who dream of getting rich. The casino staff are heartily supportive of their gambling endeavours. As long as the customer loses money."
it: Il casinò non respinge nessuno e accoglie a braccia aperte chi sogna di far fortuna in un colpo solo. E gli addetti fanno il tifo di cuore per chi si mette a giocare. Finché quel cliente lascia soldi sul tavolo.

jp: カジノスタッフ
jp_grezzo: "カジノスタッフ"
en: staff
en_grezzo: "staff"
it: l'addetto del casinò

jp: 我を殺し姿を潜め色々と黒い仕事をこなす者。中距離からの手裏剣と鎖鎌で相手の血と体力をジワジワと削り取る汚いやつ。仕事が無いときは農業などをして暮らしている。
jp_grezzo: "我を殺し姿を潜め色々と黒い仕事をこなす者。中距離からの手裏剣と鎖鎌で相手の血と体力をジワジワと削り取る汚いやつ。仕事が無いときは農業などをして暮らしている。"
en: A man who keeps to himself and hides in plain sight, performing all sorts of black work. This nasty fellow uses shuriken and chain scythes from medium range to slowly drain the blood and strength of the opponent. When not working, they live by farming.
en_grezzo: "A man who keeps to himself and hides in plain sight, performing all sorts of black work. This nasty fellow uses shuriken and chain scythes from medium range to slowly drain the blood and strength of the opponent. When not working, they live by farming."
it: Uno che mette da parte sé stesso, si nasconde e sbriga ogni sorta di lavoro sporco. Un tipo scorretto: da mezza distanza, con gli shuriken e la falce a catena, ti porta via il sangue e le forze un po' per volta. Quando non ha lavoro campa coltivando la terra.

jp: ニンジャ
jp_grezzo: "ニンジャ"
en: ninja
en_grezzo: "ninja"
it: il ninja

jp_grezzo: "斬り伏せた敵の魂を吸収し強大な力を自らの物としたブレイド。重力制御能力を持ち、簡単な飛行も可能。強敵と相対するとき、その力が全開する。"
en: A blade that absorbs the souls of enemies it has slain and takes their mighty power for itself. It has the ability to control gravity and is capable of simple flight. Its full power is unleashed when facing powerful enemies.
en_grezzo: "A blade that absorbs the souls of enemies it has slain and takes their mighty power for itself. It has the ability to control gravity and is capable of simple flight. Its full power is unleashed when facing powerful enemies."
it: Una lama che ha assorbito le anime dei nemici abbattuti e ne ha fatto propria la forza smisurata. Sa comandare la gravità e riesce perfino a volare, alla buona. Quando si trova davanti un avversario forte, quella forza si scatena tutta.

jp: ブレイドキング
jp_grezzo: "ブレイドキング"
en: blade king
en_grezzo: "blade king"
it: la lama re

jp: 海がとても好きで、綺麗な海岸線が広がるヴァルムへ遊びに来ている。海へ行くのが楽しみ過ぎて水着を着たまま来てしまった為に、着替えがなくて後で困る。
jp_grezzo: "海がとても好きで、綺麗な海岸線が広がるヴァルムへ遊びに来ている。海へ行くのが楽しみ過ぎて水着を着たまま来てしまった為に、着替えがなくて後で困る。"
en: They like the sea very much and come to visit Valm, where there is a beautiful coastline. They are too excited to go to the sea, so they come here in their swimming costumes and later get into trouble because they don't have any clothes to change into.
en_grezzo: "They like the sea very much and come to visit Valm, where there is a beautiful coastline. They are too excited to go to the sea, so they come here in their swimming costumes and later get into trouble because they don't have any clothes to change into."
it: Ama moltissimo il mare, e viene a divertirsi a Valm, dove la costa è bellissima. Ma non stava più nella pelle all'idea di andarci, ed è partito già col costume addosso: da cambiarsi non ha niente, e dopo saranno guai.

jp: 海水浴客
jp_grezzo: "海水浴客"
en: swimmer
en_grezzo: "swimmer"
it: l'estivante

jp_grezzo: "最新型の武装の試作機を優先的に配備される、イェルスの超エリート部隊の一員。開発主任の遊び心に翻弄され、泣きながら帰ってくる者もしばしば見受けられる。"
en: Members of the ultra-elite Yerles unit, where prototypes of the latest armaments are deployed as a priority. Often at the mercy of the chief development officer's playful attitude, some of them are seen returning home in tears.
en_grezzo: "Members of the ultra-elite Yerles unit, where prototypes of the latest armaments are deployed as a priority. Often at the mercy of the chief development officer's playful attitude, some of them are seen returning home in tears. "
it: Fa parte del reparto scelto fra gli scelti di Yerles, quello a cui i prototipi degli armamenti nuovi arrivano per primi. Lo spirito burlone del capo dello sviluppo se li rigira come vuole, e capita spesso di vederne tornare qualcuno in lacrime.

jp: 新型武装兵
jp_grezzo: "新型武装兵"
en: Yerles latest outfit soldier
en_grezzo: "Yerles latest outfit soldier"
it: il soldato Yerles di nuovo modello

jp: 定職につかず、賭博により生計を立てようとしている輩の総称。金が無くなったものは知らぬ間に消えており、その行方を知る者は居ない。
jp_grezzo: "定職につかず、賭博により生計を立てようとしている輩の総称。金が無くなったものは知らぬ間に消えており、その行方を知る者は居ない。"
en: A general term for people who do not have regular jobs and try to make a living through gambling. Those who lose their money disappear without being noticed, and no one knows their whereabouts.
en_grezzo: "A general term for people who do not have regular jobs and try to make a living through gambling. Those who lose their money disappear without being noticed, and no one knows their whereabouts."
it: È il nome che si dà a tutti quelli che non hanno un lavoro fisso e cercano di campare con l'azzardo. Quelli che restano senza soldi spariscono senza che nessuno se ne accorga, e dove siano finiti non lo sa nessuno.

jp: 遊び人
jp_grezzo: "遊び人"
en: gambler
en_grezzo: "gambler"
it: il giocatore d'azzardo

jp: イェルス軍の精鋭。取り込まれることは回避できたが、地面から伸びた菌糸に捕らえられ同化が進行してしまっている。人型を保てなくなるのも時間の問題だろう。
jp_grezzo: "イェルス軍の精鋭。取り込まれることは回避できたが、地面から伸びた菌糸に捕らえられ同化が進行してしまっている。人型を保てなくなるのも時間の問題だろう。"
en: The elites of the Yerles army. Although they were able to avoid being absorbed, they have been trapped by the mycelium growing from the ground and have undergone assimilation. It is only a matter of time before they are unable to retain their human form.
en_grezzo: "The elites of the Yerles army. Although they were able to avoid being absorbed, they have been trapped by the mycelium growing from the ground and have undergone assimilation. It is only a matter of time before they are unable to retain their human form."
it: Truppa scelta dell'esercito di Yerles. Di farsi inghiottire è riuscito a evitarlo, ma il micelio che spunta dal terreno lo ha afferrato e l'assimilazione va avanti. Che non riesca più a tenere la forma di uomo è solo questione di tempo.

jp: 同化兵
jp_grezzo: "同化兵"
en: infected yerles soldier
en_grezzo: "infected yerles soldier"
it: il soldato yerles infetto

jp: 死神が管理しているキャンドルが動き出した姿。瀕死で身動きが取れない人間に、熱したロウを垂らすのが趣味。頭の火は触っても不思議と熱くない。
jp_grezzo: "死神が管理しているキャンドルが動き出した姿。瀕死で身動きが取れない人間に、熱したロウを垂らすのが趣味。頭の火は触っても不思議と熱くない。"
en: A candle controlled by the Death that has been set in motion. It enjoys dropping hot wax on a dying, writhing human being. The fire in their heads is strangely not hot to the touch.
en_grezzo: "A candle controlled by the Death that has been set in motion. It enjoys dropping hot wax on a dying, writhing human being. The fire in their heads is strangely not hot to the touch."
it: Una candela che la Morte teneva in custodia e che si è messa in movimento. Il suo passatempo è gocciolare cera bollente addosso a chi è in fin di vita e non riesce più a muoversi. Il fuoco che ha in testa, stranamente, a toccarlo non scotta.

jp: ライフ・キャンドル
jp_grezzo: "ライフ・キャンドル"
en: candle wisp
en_grezzo: "candle wisp"
it: la candela della vita

jp: プリンに対する沢山の愛が集まり、精霊となった。素朴な表情と相まって非常にスイーツであると人気。ただし死体はプリン味ではない。
jp_grezzo: "プリンに対する沢山の愛が集まり、精霊となった。素朴な表情と相まって非常にスイーツであると人気。ただし死体はプリン味ではない。"
en: One has double-downed on their love for pudding gathered and became a pudding spirit. Popular for being very sweet, combined with a simple facial expression. However, their corpses are not pudding-flavoured.
en_grezzo: "One has double-downed on their love for pudding gathered and became a pudding spirit. Popular for being very sweet, combined with a simple facial expression. However, their corpses are not pudding-flavoured."
it: Tanto amore per il budino si è raccolto in un punto solo, ed è nato uno spirito. Con quella faccia da ingenuo piace parecchio, e tutti lo trovano dolcissimo. Il cadavere, però, di budino non sa.

jp: プリンの精霊
jp_grezzo: "プリンの精霊"
en: pudding spirit
en_grezzo: "pudding spirit"
it: lo spirito del budino

jp: すでにこの世を去った魔法使いたちの魔力の残滓が、大自然にあふれるマナと融合し精霊として独立した。特定の魔法に反応して寄ってくる。
jp_grezzo: "すでにこの世を去った魔法使いたちの魔力の残滓が、大自然にあふれるマナと融合し精霊として独立した。特定の魔法に反応して寄ってくる。"
en: The magical residues of wizards who have already left this world, have fused with the mana that abounds in the wilderness and become independent as spirits. They react to specific magic and come close to it.
en_grezzo: "The magical residues of wizards who have already left this world, have fused with the mana that abounds in the wilderness and become independent as spirits. They react to specific magic and come close to it. "
it: Quel che restava del potere magico dei maghi già andati via da questo mondo si è fuso con la mana di cui la natura abbonda, e se n'è staccato uno spirito. Se sente certe magie, arriva.

jp: スピリット・メギューム
jp_grezzo: "スピリット・メギューム"
en: magic spirit
en_grezzo: "magic spirit"
it: lo spirito magico

jp: 家族を守るため素手で魔物と戦い、刺し違えた者たちの魂の一部が精霊となった。その光り輝く拳は守るべき者のために振るわれる。

jp: 塩を体にふりかけられると体内の水分を奪われて溶けるように縮んで消えてしまう。イルヴァで最も鈍く情けない生き物でありながら今日まで絶滅していない理由は謎。
jp_grezzo: "塩を体にふりかけられると体内の水分を奪われて溶けるように縮んで消えてしまう。イルヴァで最も鈍く情けない生き物でありながら今日まで絶滅していない理由は謎。"
en: When exposed to salt, the water inside their bodies is absorbed, causing them to shrivel into nothingness. Without a doubt the most dull and pathetic creature in Irva. How the species has managed to survive is a complete mystery.
en_grezzo: "When exposed to salt, the water inside their bodies is absorbed, causing them to shrivel into nothingness. Without a doubt the most dull and pathetic creature in Irva. How the species has managed to survive is a complete mystery."
it: Se le si versa del sale addosso perde l'acqua che ha in corpo, si raggrinzisce come se si sciogliesse e sparisce. È la creatura più lenta e più misera di tutta Irva, eppure fino a oggi non si è estinta: perché, resta un mistero.

jp: かたつむり
jp_grezzo: "かたつむり"
en: snail
en_grezzo: "snail"
it: la chiocciola

jp: 負けてしまった者。その事実から目を背けるように逃げ続ける。何に負けたのかは人それぞれである。ただ、いつかは現実と戦わなければいけない日が来るのだろう。
jp_grezzo: "負けてしまった者。その事実から目を背けるように逃げ続ける。何に負けたのかは人それぞれである。ただ、いつかは現実と戦わなければいけない日が来るのだろう。"
en: A person who has lost to something, and continues to run in order to escape from that fact. The circumstances are unique to each individual, but sooner or later, the time will come when they must face reality.
en_grezzo: "A person who has lost to something, and continues to run in order to escape from that fact. The circumstances are unique to each individual, but sooner or later, the time will come when they must face reality."
it: Uno che ha perso. E continua a scappare per non guardare in faccia quel fatto. Che cosa ciascuno abbia perso è affare suo. Solo che, prima o poi, il giorno di battersi con la realtà arriverà.

jp: 敗残兵
jp_grezzo: "敗残兵"
en: fallen soldier
en_grezzo: "fallen soldier"
it: il soldato sconfitto

jp: 自分の力を様々な勢力に売り込む者たち。雇ってもらうためにちょっとした活躍を大げさに話したり戦歴をでっちあげたりする者も多いが不景気なので仕方がない。
jp_grezzo: "自分の力を様々な勢力に売り込む者たち。雇ってもらうためにちょっとした活躍を大げさに話したり戦歴をでっちあげたりする者も多いが不景気なので仕方がない。"
en: A fighter for hire. Many exaggerate their past deeds or lie about former military service in order to get hired, but considering the current economy, they don't have much of a choice.
en_grezzo: "A fighter for hire. Many exaggerate their past deeds or lie about former military service in order to get hired, but considering the current economy, they don't have much of a choice."
it: Gente che vende la propria forza a chiunque abbia una bandiera. Per farsi assumere in molti gonfiano una piccola impresa o si inventano trascorsi di guerra, ma di questi tempi magri non si può dar loro torto.

jp: 傭兵
jp_grezzo: "傭兵"
en: mercenary
en_grezzo: "mercenary"
it: il mercenario

jp: 完全にプライドと恐怖心を捨てており、金を得るためならば見ず知らずの冒険者の家にも乗り込むし土下座だってする。それが実を結ぶケースは少ないが。
jp_grezzo: "完全にプライドと恐怖心を捨てており、金を得るためならば見ず知らずの冒険者の家にも乗り込むし土下座だってする。それが実を結ぶケースは少ないが。"
en: A person who has completely abandoned their pride and fear, willing to even visit the homes of random adventurers and prostrate themselves for gold. It rarely ever works though.
en_grezzo: "A person who has completely abandoned their pride and fear, willing to even visit the homes of random adventurers and prostrate themselves for gold. It rarely ever works though."
it: Ha buttato via del tutto l'orgoglio e la paura: per rimediare del denaro entra perfino in casa di un avventuriero che non ha mai visto, e si butta in ginocchio. Che poi la cosa dia frutto capita di rado.

jp: 乞食
jp_grezzo: "乞食"
en: beggar
en_grezzo: "beggar"
it: l'accattone

jp: 料理や裁縫に長ける家庭的な人々。いくら野菜を生産しても安く買い叩かれるため、基本的には自分の家庭で消費している。
jp_grezzo: "料理や裁縫に長ける家庭的な人々。いくら野菜を生産しても安く買い叩かれるため、基本的には自分の家庭で消費している。"
en: Home-grown people skilled in cooking and sewing. No matter how much vegetables they produce, they are bought cheaply, so they basically live on the expenditure of their family.
en_grezzo: "Home-grown people skilled in cooking and sewing. No matter how much vegetables they produce, they are bought cheaply, so they basically live on the expenditure of their family."
it: Gente di casa, brava a cucinare e a cucire. Per quanta verdura produca gliela pagano sempre due soldi, e così in pratica se la consuma in famiglia.

jp: 農夫
jp_grezzo: "農夫"
en: farmer
en_grezzo: "farmer"
it: l'agricoltore

jp: 街の美観を損なう者は許さない。塩を常時携行しているため、かたつむり達から恐れられている。塩を撒き散らすことは清掃員的にはセーフのようだ。
jp_grezzo: "街の美観を損なう者は許さない。塩を常時携行しているため、かたつむり達から恐れられている。塩を撒き散らすことは清掃員的にはセーフのようだ。"
en: They will not tolerate anyone who spoils the beauty of the city. They are feared by snails because they carry salt with them at all times. It seems to be safe, in the eyes of the cleaners, to sprinkle salt at snails.
en_grezzo: "They will not tolerate anyone who spoils the beauty of the city. They are feared by snails because they carry salt with them at all times. It seems to be safe, in the eyes of the cleaners, to sprinkle salt at snails."
it: Chi rovina il decoro della città non la passa liscia. Porta sempre con sé del sale, e per questo le chiocciole lo temono. Spargere sale in giro, per uno spazzino, pare che non conti come sporcare.

jp: 清掃員
jp_grezzo: "清掃員"
en: cleaner
en_grezzo: "cleaner"
it: lo spazzino

jp: 街の平和と発展のために日夜坑道を掘り進む。技術も無しに力任せで採掘する姿はいっそ清々しい。坑道に住み着いた魔物に襲われるのは日常茶飯事。
jp_grezzo: "街の平和と発展のために日夜坑道を掘り進む。技術も無しに力任せで採掘する姿はいっそ清々しい。坑道に住み着いた魔物に襲われるのは日常茶飯事。"
en: He digs tunnels day and night for the peace and development of the town. It is refreshing to see him digging by force and without any skill.He is attacked by demons that live in the tunnels on a daily basis.
en_grezzo: "He digs tunnels day and night for the peace and development of the town. It is refreshing to see him digging by force and without any skill.He is attacked by demons that live in the tunnels on a daily basis."
it: Giorno e notte scava gallerie per la pace e la crescita della città. Vederlo scavare a forza di braccia, senza nessuna tecnica, mette quasi allegria. Che i mostri annidati nelle gallerie lo assalgano è cosa di tutti i giorni.

jp: 鉱夫
jp_grezzo: "鉱夫"
en: miner
en_grezzo: "miner"
it: il minatore

jp: 各地を巡りながら、奏でる音楽や歌声で生計を立てる演奏家。未熟な腕では石を投げられたりもするが、彼らはめげない。いっそう努力を重ねるのである。
jp_grezzo: "各地を巡りながら、奏でる音楽や歌声で生計を立てる演奏家。未熟な腕では石を投げられたりもするが、彼らはめげない。いっそう努力を重ねるのである。"
en: Performers who make a living from the music and singing they play while travelling from place to place. They are sometimes stoned for their inexperience, but they are not discouraged. They just work harder and harder.
en_grezzo: "Performers who make a living from the music and singing they play while travelling from place to place. They are sometimes stoned for their inexperience, but they are not discouraged. They just work harder and harder."
it: Musicisti che girano di posto in posto e campano con la musica che suonano e con la voce che cantano. Quando il braccio è acerbo si prendono anche qualche sassata, ma non si perdono d'animo: si impegnano ancora di più.

jp: 吟遊詩人
jp_grezzo: "吟遊詩人"
en: bard
en_grezzo: "bard"
it: il menestrello

jp: 男女の境なく「修道女」と統一されて呼ばれる。禁欲生活を送っているが、様々な欲が溢れかえる聖夜祭を無事に超えられる者は少ない。
jp_grezzo: "男女の境なく「修道女」と統一されて呼ばれる。禁欲生活を送っているが、様々な欲が溢れかえる聖夜祭を無事に超えられる者は少ない。"
en: Regardless of gender, they are uniformly referred to as 'nuns'. They lead a life of celibacy, but few of them make it past the Feast of the Holy Nights, which is overflowing with various desires.
en_grezzo: "Regardless of gender, they are uniformly referred to as 'nuns'. They lead a life of celibacy, but few of them make it past the Feast of the Holy Nights, which is overflowing with various desires."
it: Uomini e donne senza distinzione vengono chiamati tutti allo stesso modo, monache. Conducono una vita di castità, ma pochi arrivano in fondo alla festa della notte santa, dove i desideri di ogni sorta traboccano.

jp: 修道女
jp_grezzo: "修道女"
en: nun
en_grezzo: "nun"
it: la monaca

jp: 年末の祭りに舞い降りた聖なる獣であり、中の人など居ない。頭を噛まれるとその年は無病息災に過ごせるという迷信がある。ガチガチと歯を打ち鳴らすのがちょっと怖い。
jp_grezzo: "年末の祭りに舞い降りた聖なる獣であり、中の人など居ない。頭を噛まれるとその年は無病息災に過ごせるという迷信がある。ガチガチと歯を打ち鳴らすのがちょっと怖い。"
en: It is a sacred beast that descends on the end of year festivals and has no insides. There is a superstition that if you are bitten on the head, you will live a year without illness. The clattering of its teeth is a little scary, though.
en_grezzo: "It is a sacred beast that descends on the end of year festivals and has no insides. There is a superstition that if you are bitten on the head, you will live a year without illness. The clattering of its teeth is a little scary, though."
it: La bestia sacra che scende alla festa di fine anno, e dentro non c'è nessuno. C'è la superstizione che se ti morde la testa passi l'anno senza malattie. Il modo in cui batte i denti, però, mette un po' di paura.

jp: 聖獣
jp_grezzo: "聖獣"
en: holy beast
en_grezzo: "holy beast"
it: la bestia sacra

jp: クマの着ぐるみに身を包み、人々に改宗を勧めるアルバイト。成績に応じてボーナスが出るので、言いくるめやすそうな人を見かけるとすかさず声をかけてくる。
jp_grezzo: "クマの着ぐるみに身を包み、人々に改宗を勧めるアルバイト。成績に応じてボーナスが出るので、言いくるめやすそうな人を見かけるとすかさず声をかけてくる。"
en: Part-time worker who dresses up in a bear costume and encourages people to convert. He earns bonuses according to his performance, so whenever he sees someone he can easily persuade, he calls out to them.
en_grezzo: "Part-time worker who dresses up in a bear costume and encourages people to convert. He earns bonuses according to his performance, so whenever he sees someone he can easily persuade, he calls out to them."
it: Uno che lavora a ore, infilato in un costume da orso, e invita la gente a convertirsi. Il premio glielo danno in base ai risultati, e così appena vede qualcuno che sembra facile da convincere lo ferma all'istante.

jp: 『着ぐるみのバイト』
jp_grezzo: "『着ぐるみのバイト』"
en: part time worker
en_grezzo: "part time worker"
it: la mascotte a ore

jp: 癒しの女神『ジュア』を妄執するあまり狂ってしまった者の姿。その姿に癒しは欠片も無い。見る限り、本人たちは幸せなようだが…。
jp_grezzo: "癒しの女神『ジュア』を妄執するあまり狂ってしまった者の姿。その姿に癒しは欠片も無い。見る限り、本人たちは幸せなようだが…。"
en: The figure of a person who has gone mad with delusion about the healing goddess Jure. There is not a shred of healing in their appearance. As far as the eye can see, they are happy...
en_grezzo: "The figure of a person who has gone mad with delusion about the healing goddess Jure. There is not a shred of healing in their appearance. As far as the eye can see, they are happy..."
it: L'aspetto di chi è impazzito a furia di rimuginare sulla dea che guarisce, Jure. Di guarigione, in quell'aspetto, non c'è nemmeno un briciolo. A vederli, però, sembrano felici...

jp: ジュアの狂信者
jp_grezzo: "ジュアの狂信者"
en: Jure fanatic
en_grezzo: "Jure fanatic"
it: il fanatico di Jure

jp: 彼らが生まれた町で生きる為にはその手を汚すしかなかった。その生きかた以外を彼等は知らない。不用心な人々からくすねた金で今日も彼らは生きていく。
jp_grezzo: "彼らが生まれた町で生きる為にはその手を汚すしかなかった。その生きかた以外を彼等は知らない。不用心な人々からくすねた金で今日も彼らは生きていく。"
en: They had to get their hands dirty in order to live in the town of their birth. They know no other way of life.They live today on the money they skim off the backs of the unwary.
en_grezzo: "They had to get their hands dirty in order to live in the town of their birth. They know no other way of life.They live today on the money they skim off the backs of the unwary."
it: Per vivere nella città dove sono nati non hanno potuto che sporcarsi le mani. Un altro modo di vivere non lo conoscono. Anche oggi tirano avanti con i soldi sfilati a chi non sta attento.

jp: ならずもの
jp_grezzo: "ならずもの"
en: rogue
en_grezzo: "rogue"
it: la canaglia

jp: 気が狂うほど気持ちがいいマッサージを行う。普段は客に対して猫撫で声で話すが、客が金を持っていないとわかると態度を急変させる。
jp_grezzo: "気が狂うほど気持ちがいいマッサージを行う。普段は客に対して猫撫で声で話すが、客が金を持っていないとわかると態度を急変させる。"
en: Gives massages that feel so good that they drive you crazy. They usually speak to customers in a catcall voice, but their attitude changes abruptly when they realise that the customer doesn't have any money.
en_grezzo: "Gives massages that feel so good that they drive you crazy. They usually speak to customers in a catcall voice, but their attitude changes abruptly when they realise that the customer doesn't have any money."
it: Fa massaggi così piacevoli da far uscire di testa. Di solito parla ai clienti con la voce melliflua, ma appena capisce che il cliente non ha soldi cambia atteggiamento di colpo.

jp: 娼婦
jp_grezzo: "娼婦"
en: prostitute
en_grezzo: "prostitute"
it: la prostituta

jp: 捕らえられ囚われる者。積み上げた負のカルマを清算するのに要する時は数時間か数日か、或いは数年か。今日も独房で無実を訴える声が虚しく響き渡る。
jp_grezzo: "捕らえられ囚われる者。積み上げた負のカルマを清算するのに要する時は数時間か数日か、或いは数年か。今日も独房で無実を訴える声が虚しく響き渡る。"
en: Captives and prisoners. It takes hours, days or even years to clear the negative karma they have accumulated. Today, the voices of those pleading for their innocence echo in vain in their cells.
en_grezzo: "Captives and prisoners. It takes hours, days or even years to clear the negative karma they have accumulated. Today, the voices of those pleading for their innocence echo in vain in their cells."
it: Chi è stato catturato e tenuto rinchiuso. Per saldare il karma negativo che ha accumulato ci vogliono qualche ora, qualche giorno o forse qualche anno. Anche oggi, nelle celle, la voce di chi grida la propria innocenza risuona a vuoto.

jp: 囚人
jp_grezzo: "囚人"
en: prisoner
en_grezzo: "prisoner"
it: il prigioniero

jp: 彼らは「人生」というキャンパスに「生き様」と言う絵を描く。果たしてそれが傑作となるか、そしていつ完成するのかは彼ら次第である。
jp_grezzo: "彼らは「人生」というキャンパスに「生き様」と言う絵を描く。果たしてそれが傑作となるか、そしていつ完成するのかは彼ら次第である。"
en: They paint a picture of their 'way of life' on the canvas of 'life'. Whether it will be a masterpiece or not, and when it will be completed, is up to them.
en_grezzo: "They paint a picture of their 'way of life' on the canvas of 'life'. Whether it will be a masterpiece or not, and when it will be completed, is up to them."
it: Sulla tela che si chiama vita dipingono il quadro che si chiama modo di vivere. Se ne verrà fuori un capolavoro, e quando sarà finito, dipende soltanto da loro.

jp: 芸術家
jp_grezzo: "芸術家"
en: artist
en_grezzo: "artist"
it: l'artista

jp: 普段は刺激を求めて平民たちの生活を観察している。基本的に現金はあまり持ち歩かないが、裏では自身の性癖のために金を惜しみなく使う。
jp_grezzo: "普段は刺激を求めて平民たちの生活を観察している。基本的に現金はあまり持ち歩かないが、裏では自身の性癖のために金を惜しみなく使う。"
en: He usually observes the lives of commoners in search of excitement. Basically, he doesn't carry much cash, but behind the scenes he spends money lavishly for his own proclivities.
en_grezzo: "He usually observes the lives of commoners in search of excitement. Basically, he doesn't carry much cash, but behind the scenes he spends money lavishly for his own proclivities."
it: Di solito osserva la vita dei popolani in cerca di emozioni. Di contante in tasca ne porta poco, ma di nascosto spende senza risparmio per i propri gusti particolari.

jp: 貴族
jp_grezzo: "貴族"
en: noble
en_grezzo: "noble"
it: l'aristocratico

jp: 魔術士ギルドの構成員。古文書の解読を仕事としており、その知識で魔法を使う事も出来るが、研究ばかりしてるため荒事は得意ではない。
jp_grezzo: "魔術士ギルドの構成員。古文書の解読を仕事としており、その知識で魔法を使う事も出来るが、研究ばかりしてるため荒事は得意ではない。"
en: A member of the Mages' Guild. His job is to decipher ancient texts, and he can use his knowledge to do magic, but he is not good at rough work as he is always researching.
en_grezzo: "A member of the Mages' Guild. His job is to decipher ancient texts, and he can use his knowledge to do magic, but he is not good at rough work as he is always researching."
it: Un affiliato della Gilda dei Maghi. Il suo lavoro è decifrare i testi antichi, e con quel sapere sa anche usare la magia, ma siccome sta sempre a studiare non è capace di menare le mani.

jp: 魔術士ギルド
jp_grezzo: "魔術士ギルド"
en: mage guild member
en_grezzo: "mage guild member"
it: il membro della Gilda dei Maghi

jp: 裏の世界に生きる者達の集まり。彼らには彼らなりの流儀があり。厳しい掟が課せられている。ルールを守って付き合う限りは、彼らの技能は大きな助けとなるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "裏の世界に生きる者達の集まり。彼らには彼らなりの流儀があり。厳しい掟が課せられている。ルールを守って付き合う限りは、彼らの技能は大きな助けとなるだろう。"
en: A group of people who live in the underworld. They have their own way of doing things. They have strict rules. Their skills can be of great help as long as you keep to the rules.
en_grezzo: "A group of people who live in the underworld. They have their own way of doing things. They have strict rules. Their skills can be of great help as long as you keep to the rules."
it: Un giro di gente che vive nel mondo di sotto. Hanno un loro modo di fare, e leggi severe a cui sottostare. Finché stai alle regole e le rispetti, la loro abilità è un grande aiuto.

jp: 盗賊ギルド
jp_grezzo: "盗賊ギルド"
en: thief guild member
en_grezzo: "thief guild member"
it: il membro della Gilda dei Ladri

jp: 基本的に物事を深く考えるのが苦手。しかしそれ故に一切の迷いを持たず、戦いの中では頼りになる。ギルドマスターに憧れを抱くものが多い。
jp_grezzo: "基本的に物事を深く考えるのが苦手。しかしそれ故に一切の迷いを持たず、戦いの中では頼りになる。ギルドマスターに憧れを抱くものが多い。"
en: Basically, he is not good at thinking things deeply. However, that is why they have no doubts at all and are very reliable in battle. Many of them have admiration for their guildmaster.
en_grezzo: "Basically, he is not good at thinking things deeply. However, that is why they have no doubts at all and are very reliable in battle. Many of them have admiration for their guildmaster."
it: Ragionare a fondo sulle cose, di norma, non gli riesce. Proprio per questo, però, non ha un solo dubbio, e in battaglia ci si può contare. In molti guardano al maestro della gilda con ammirazione.

jp: 戦士ギルド
jp_grezzo: "戦士ギルド"
en: fighter guild member
en_grezzo: "fighter guild member"
it: il membro della Gilda dei Guerrieri

jp: 自身に訪れるであろう光り輝く未来を信じて疑わない姿はまさに子供と呼ぶにふさわしい。どれほどの時間が過ぎようとも、それを盲信し続けるかぎり彼等は子供なのである。
jp_grezzo: "自身に訪れるであろう光り輝く未来を信じて疑わない姿はまさに子供と呼ぶにふさわしい。どれほどの時間が過ぎようとも、それを盲信し続けるかぎり彼等は子供なのである。"
en: Their unquestioning faith in the bright future that will come their way is what we call a child. No matter how much time passes, they are children as long as they continue to believe in it blindly.
en_grezzo: "Their unquestioning faith in the bright future that will come their way is what we call a child. No matter how much time passes, they are children as long as they continue to believe in it blindly. "
it: Credere senza un dubbio nel futuro luminoso che di sicuro arriverà: è proprio questo che merita il nome di bambino. Per quanto tempo passi, finché continuano a crederci ciecamente, bambini restano.

jp: 街の子供
jp_grezzo: "街の子供"
en: town child
en_grezzo: "town child"
it: il bambino di città

jp: 歳を重ねた者だけではなく、若くして身体のみが急激に老化してしまった者も含まれる。目的もなく街を徘徊するだけの日々が続く。

it: Tipi strani, votati all'eredità e al sapere delle civiltà antiche, che armeggiano con le macchine conciati in modo bizzarro. A sentir loro, imitano gli eretici di Eyth Terre.

en: The perfect animal: edible and delicious meat, produces nutritional milk, and grows wool that can be used for clothing. Many escape their pens and snack on the neighboring fields.
en_grezzo: "The perfect animal: edible and delicious meat, produces nutritional milk, and grows wool that can be used for clothing. Many escape their pens and snack on the neighboring fields."
it: La carne si mangia, il latte nutre da matti e il pelo serve per i vestiti: non le manca proprio niente. Tante scappano dal recinto e vanno a rubare nei campi qui intorno.

en: A species of flying frog found all over North Tyris. They can \"swim\" through the air as easily as swimming through water, though how this functions is unknown. Since even children are strong enough to take one down, they're a popular snack.
en_grezzo: "A species of flying frog found all over North Tyris. They can \"swim\" through the air as easily as swimming through water, though how this functions is unknown. Since even children are strong enough to take one down, they're a popular snack."
it: Una rana migratrice selvatica che saltella per tutta Tyris. Nuota nell'aria come se nuotasse sott'acqua, ma con che principio non si sa. Ad abbatterla riesce anche un bambino, e per questo è uno spuntino molto amato.

en: Unemployed hooligans that wander about using blackmail and picking pockets in order to support themselves. They look strong and put up a brave front, but their true strength you can probably guess.
en_grezzo: "Unemployed hooligans that wander about using blackmail and picking pockets in order to support themselves. They look strong and put up a brave front, but their true strength you can probably guess."
it: Bighellona senza lavorare e si guadagna il pane con l'estorsione e con qualcosa che somiglia al borseggio. Fa il gradasso e sembra forte, ma su quanto valga davvero c'è poco da illudersi.

en: A small monster with the head of a dog. Though it's difficult to process and so isn't used very often, the ore \"cobalt\" is said to come from this monster.
en_grezzo: "A small monster with the head of a dog. Though it's difficult to process and so isn't used very often, the ore \"cobalt\" is said to come from this monster."
it: Un piccolo mostro con la testa da cane. Lavorarlo è difficile e quindi non lo si usa granché, ma dicono che il nome del minerale cobalto venga proprio da questa bestia.

en: Beasts with a human-like appearance. They are stupid and frail, and on their own are only as capable as human children, but they attack with numbers to compensate.

it: Una bestia dall'aspetto simile a quello dell'uomo. Sono sciocchi e deboli, e da soli valgono quanto un bambino umano, ma per rimediare attaccano in tanti.

jp_grezzo: "人に似た姿を持つ獣。イークの中でも厳しい鍛錬に耐えたもののみが戦士の称号を授かる。そのため戦士であることを誇りとしている。"
en: Beasts with a human-like appearance. Only those who have endured the most rigorous training among the Yeeks are awarded the title of warrior. For this reason, they are proud to be warriors.
en_grezzo: "Beasts with a human-like appearance. Only those who have endured the most rigorous training among the Yeeks are awarded the title of warrior. For this reason, they are proud to be warriors."
it: Una bestia dall'aspetto simile a quello dell'uomo. Fra gli yeek, soltanto chi ha retto un allenamento durissimo riceve il titolo di guerriero. Ed è per questo che di esserlo va fiero.

jp_grezzo: "他の同族と比べて遠くから攻撃する知性を持ったイーク。弓を扱おうと弦を引き続けた結果、同族の戦士程ではないが身体が鍛えられている。"
en: The yeek has the intelligence to attack from a distance compared to other members of his tribe. As a result of continually pulling the strings to handle the bow, his body has been trained, although not as well as the warriors of his own tribe.
en_grezzo: "The yeek has the intelligence to attack from a distance compared to other members of his tribe. As a result of continually pulling the strings to handle the bow, his body has been trained, although not as well as the warriors of his own tribe. "
it: Uno yeek che, rispetto agli altri della sua gente, ha l'intelligenza di attaccare da lontano. A furia di tendere la corda per maneggiare l'arco si è irrobustito, anche se non quanto i guerrieri dei suoi.

en_grezzo: "yeek archer"
it: lo yeek arciere

jp_grezzo: "産まれた時からマスターとなるべく定められた、エリート中のエリート。同族を率いる指揮能力に秀でており、数多くのイークを使役している。"
en: Elite of the elite, destined to become a master from birth. They excel in their ability to command and lead their own people, and they have commanded a large number of Yeeks.
en_grezzo: "Elite of the elite, destined to become a master from birth. They excel in their ability to command and lead their own people, and they have commanded a large number of Yeeks. "
it: Il migliore fra i migliori, destinato fin dalla nascita a diventare maestro. Eccelle nel comandare e nel guidare la propria gente, e ha ai suoi ordini un gran numero di yeek.

jp: イーク族の身体能力の低さを克服しようと選んだ手段は、自身の命を犠牲にした自爆だった。だが、簡単に起爆してしまい味方も巻き込んでしまう。
jp_grezzo: "イーク族の身体能力の低さを克服しようと選んだ手段は、自身の命を犠牲にした自爆だった。だが、簡単に起爆してしまい味方も巻き込んでしまう。"
en: The means they chose to overcome the low physical capabilities of the Yeeks was self-destruction at the cost of their own lives. However, it was easily detonated and their allies were also collateralised.

jp_grezzo: "東の国を追放された戦士の成れの果て。オチムシャと呼ばれる彼らは、家のため名誉のため戦場での華々しい死を望んでいるとされるが、本当は死ぬのがすごく怖いらしい。"
en: They are the result of warriors exiled from the East. Known as Ochimsha, they are said to want to die spectacularly on the battlefield for the sake of their home and honour, but they are actually very afraid of dying.
en_grezzo: "They are the result of warriors exiled from the East. Known as Ochimsha, they are said to want to die spectacularly on the battlefield for the sake of their home and honour, but they are actually very afraid of dying. "
it: Quel che resta dei guerrieri cacciati dal paese d'oriente. Li chiamano ochimusha, e si dice che desiderino una morte splendida sul campo, per la casata e per l'onore, ma in verità pare che di morire abbiano una paura tremenda.

it: Una roccia qualunque che è mutata ed è diventata un mostro. Ti guarda con un sorrisetto, ma basta un urto da niente perché esploda, e quindi conviene occuparsene da lontano e con prudenza.

en: Cloned human beings produced by terrorists exploiting relics of biochemical civilisations. The aim is to detonate them in crowded places. As the terrorists do not know how to use the relics well, they are all output in the same appearance. They are instinctively imprinted with the idea that risking their lives in an explosion is an art form.

As the terrorists do not know how to use the relics well, they are all output in the same appearance. it: Cloni umani prodotti dai terroristi con un uso storto dei resti della civiltà biochimica. Lo scopo è farli esplodere in mezzo alla folla. Siccome i terroristi non hanno capito bene come si usano quei resti, escono tutti con lo stesso aspetto. Nell'istinto gli hanno impresso che giocarsi la vita in un'esplosione sia arte.

en: Absolute charisma of the yeek world. Highly intelligent, he unites the entire tribe. He plans to gather his friends and plunder Yowyn's crops.

it: Il carisma assoluto del mondo degli yeek. Ha un'intelligenza alta e tiene unita l'intera stirpe. Sta tramando di radunare i suoi e di razziare i raccolti di Yowyn.

en: Those who have fallen under the spell of the hot springs and continue to bathe in them like a curse. Their whole body is already soaked. If you try to ask about the charms of hot springs, you will be told endless maniacal stories, so it's best not to try.

it: Gente presa dal fascino delle terme, che continua a stare a mollo come sotto una maledizione. Il corpo ce l'hanno già tutto raggrinzito dall'acqua. Se ti viene in mente di chiedere che cosa abbiano di bello le terme ti tocca un discorso infinito da fanatici, e allora meglio lasciar perdere.

en: A small creature that lives in soil, and thus appears in many places. Though it doesn't use it to attack, the creature does contain poison, so eating it will make you sick.
en_grezzo: "A small creature that lives in soil, and thus appears in many places. Though it doesn't use it to attack, the creature does contain poison, so eating it will make you sick."
it: Vive volentieri dove c'è molta terra, e lo si incontra nelle zone più diverse. Per attaccare non lo usa, ma il veleno ce l'ha, e a mangiarlo viene la nausea.

it: Un fungo che cresce nutrendosi dei cadaveri. L'etere lo ha fatto mutare all'improvviso e diventare enorme. Anche le spore sono diventate enormi, e gli servono per attaccare.

en: A mycelium that has taken on the power of chaos, it uses its spores to target and slowly weaken its enemies. Its dangerous spores have the power to inflict various kinds of suffering.

it: Un fungo che ha assorbito la forza del caos e che, con le spore, prende di mira il nemico e lo indebolisce piano piano. Quelle spore pericolose hanno il potere di infliggere sofferenze di ogni sorta.
