jp: 街で暮らす人々。子供の誕生日を祝ったり、パーティーに行ったり、人の物を欲しがったり、モンスターに襲われたりと忙しい日々を送っている。
jp_grezzo: "街で暮らす人々。子供の誕生日を祝ったり、パーティーに行ったり、人の物を欲しがったり、モンスターに襲われたりと忙しい日々を送っている。"
en: People who live in a city. They'll keep you busy by asking you to provide them birthday gifts, performing for parties, getting things from other people, and protecting the town from monsters.
en_grezzo: "People who live in a city. They'll keep you busy by asking you to provide them birthday gifts, performing for parties, getting things from other people, and protecting the town from monsters."
it: Gente che vive in città. Festeggia il compleanno dei figli, va alle feste, si mette in testa la roba degli altri, viene assalita dai mostri: sono giornate piene.

jp: どこの町にもいる、なんら変わったところの無い一般市民。彼らは一般に光物を収集することを好むが、同時に食べ切れなくて腐ってしまった食料を捨てきれずに持ち歩く一面も持つ。
jp_grezzo: "どこの町にもいる、なんら変わったところの無い一般市民。彼らは一般に光物を収集することを好むが、同時に食べ切れなくて腐ってしまった食料を捨てきれずに持ち歩く一面も持つ。"
en: They are ordinary citizens in every town, who are not different in any way. They generally like to collect light objects, but at the same time they have a side that carries around uneaten and rotten food that they can't throw away.
en_grezzo: "They are ordinary citizens in every town, who are not different in any way. They generally like to collect light objects, but at the same time they have a side that carries around uneaten and rotten food that they can't throw away. "
it: Cittadini comuni, che si trovano in qualunque paese e non hanno niente di diverso dagli altri. In genere amano collezionare le cose che luccicano, ma insieme hanno anche il vizio di portarsi dietro il cibo che non sono riusciti a finire e che è marcito, senza decidersi a buttarlo.

jp: エイス・テールの遺産とも言われる機械で出来た巨大な建築物、アクリ・テオラに暮らす人々。人工的に整えられた快適な環境で過ごし、機械信仰が盛んに行われている。
jp_grezzo: "エイス・テールの遺産とも言われる機械で出来た巨大な建築物、アクリ・テオラに暮らす人々。人工的に整えられた快適な環境で過ごし、機械信仰が盛んに行われている。"
en: People live in Cyber Dome, a huge structure made of machines, which is said to be the legacy of Eyth Terre. They live in an artificially prepared and comfortable environment and have a thriving machine religion.
en_grezzo: "People live in Cyber Dome, a huge structure made of machines, which is said to be the legacy of Eyth Terre. They live in an artificially prepared and comfortable environment and have a thriving machine religion. "
it: Gente che vive nella Cupola Cibernetica, l'enorme costruzione fatta di macchine che dicono sia un lascito di Eyth Terre. Passano le giornate in un ambiente comodo, regolato per via artificiale, e il culto della macchina è molto praticato.

jp: サイバードームの住人
jp_grezzo: "サイバードームの住人"
en: citizen of cyber dome
en_grezzo: "citizen of cyber dome"
it: l'abitante della cupola cibernetica

jp: ヴェルニースの南西の森の中に存在する怪しげな建物に住む人々。一説によるとそこは旧文明の遺産とも言うべき存在であり、とある神の祝福を受けているとかいないとか。
jp_grezzo: "ヴェルニースの南西の森の中に存在する怪しげな建物に住む人々。一説によるとそこは旧文明の遺産とも言うべき存在であり、とある神の祝福を受けているとかいないとか。"
en: People live in a mysterious building that exists in the forest south-west of Vernis. According to one theory, it is a legacy of the old civilisation and may or may not have been blessed by a certain god.
en_grezzo: "People live in a mysterious building that exists in the forest south-west of Vernis. According to one theory, it is a legacy of the old civilisation and may or may not have been blessed by a certain god. "
it: Gente che vive in un edificio sospetto in mezzo al bosco a sud-ovest di Vernis. Secondo una certa teoria è un lascito della vecchia civiltà, e forse ha ricevuto la benedizione di una certa divinità, o forse no.

jp: 彼らが取り扱う商品は、各種不動産や遺産相続の権利書から、果ては銃器に至るまで多岐にわたる。まさに揺り籠から墓場までカバーしていると言えよう。
jp_grezzo: "彼らが取り扱う商品は、各種不動産や遺産相続の権利書から、果ては銃器に至るまで多岐にわたる。まさに揺り籠から墓場までカバーしていると言えよう。"
en: The products they handle range from various types of property and inheritance rights to firearms. It can be said that they cover everything from the cradle to the grave.
en_grezzo: "The products they handle range from various types of property and inheritance rights to firearms. It can be said that they cover everything from the cradle to the grave. "
it: La merce che tratta va dai beni immobili di ogni sorta e dai titoli di eredità fino, in fondo, alle armi da fuoco. Si può proprio dire che copra tutto, dalla culla alla tomba.

jp: セールスマン
jp_grezzo: "セールスマン"
en: sales person
en_grezzo: "sales person"
it: l'agente di commercio

jp: 海を愛し、船を繰って異国を渡り行く仕事人。海は海賊や危険な魔物が多いくせにやりすごすことも難しく、水夫にとって地上の港町は安らぎの場所らしい。
jp_grezzo: "海を愛し、船を繰って異国を渡り行く仕事人。海は海賊や危険な魔物が多いくせにやりすごすことも難しく、水夫にとって地上の港町は安らぎの場所らしい。"
en: A man of business who loves the sea and sailing his ship across foreign lands. The sea is full of pirates and dangerous monsters, but it is also difficult to get around them, and it is said that port towns on the ground are a place of peace for sailors.
en_grezzo: "A man of business who loves the sea and sailing his ship across foreign lands. The sea is full of pirates and dangerous monsters, but it is also difficult to get around them, and it is said that port towns on the ground are a place of peace for sailors. "
it: Un uomo di mestiere che ama il mare e che, manovrando la nave, passa da un paese straniero all'altro. Il mare è pieno di pirati e di mostri pericolosi, e scansarli non è facile: per un marinaio pare che le città portuali sulla terraferma siano il posto della quiete.

jp: 水夫
jp_grezzo: "水夫"
en: sailor
en_grezzo: "sailor"
it: il marinaio

jp: 海に生き、波風を浴び、命も同等である船を駆って各国を渡り行く猛者。熟練しても予測の難しいエーテルの風により船とともに海の藻屑となるケースが多い。
jp_grezzo: "海に生き、波風を浴び、命も同等である船を駆って各国を渡り行く猛者。熟練しても予測の難しいエーテルの風により船とともに海の藻屑となるケースが多い。"
en: A fierce warrior who lives on the sea, bathed in waves and winds, and travels across countries in a ship whose life is equal to his own. Even the most skilled of sailors often end up with their ships in the sea due to the ether winds, which are difficult to predict.
en_grezzo: "A fierce warrior who lives on the sea, bathed in waves and winds, and travels across countries in a ship whose life is equal to his own. Even the most skilled of sailors often end up with their ships in the sea due to the ether winds, which are difficult to predict. "
it: Un fiero che vive sul mare, si prende in faccia onde e vento e passa da un paese all'altro guidando una nave che vale quanto la sua vita. Per quanto sia esperto, capita spesso che il vento d'etere, difficile da prevedere, se lo porti in fondo al mare insieme alla nave.

jp: 船長
jp_grezzo: "船長"
en: captain
en_grezzo: "captain"
it: il capitano

jp: 慈悲深く慎み深いジャビ王の妃。夫のことを深く愛しており、パルミア国内では理想的な夫婦としても有名。物腰は柔らかいが、賊に対しては見下すような態度をとることも。
jp_grezzo: "慈悲深く慎み深いジャビ王の妃。夫のことを深く愛しており、パルミア国内では理想的な夫婦としても有名。物腰は柔らかいが、賊に対しては見下すような態度をとることも。"
en: Queen of the benevolent and modest King Jabi. She is deeply in love with her husband and is well known in Palmia as the ideal couple. She is soft-spoken, but can be condescending towards bandits.
en_grezzo: "Queen of the benevolent and modest King Jabi. She is deeply in love with her husband and is well known in Palmia as the ideal couple. She is soft-spoken, but can be condescending towards bandits."
it: La sposa di re Xabi, uomo pieno di misericordia e di riserbo. Ama il marito profondamente, e in tutta Palmia sono famosi come la coppia ideale. I modi sono gentili, ma con i briganti sa prendere un'aria di disprezzo.

jp: パルミア王妃『スターシャ』
jp_grezzo: "パルミア王妃『スターシャ』"
en: <Stersha> the queen of Palmia
en_grezzo: "<Stersha> the queen of Palmia"
it: <Stersha> la regina di Palmia

jp: 聡明なパルミアの王。民を思う心を強く持って善政を布くが、それゆえ自国民を危険に晒す危険性のある選択肢に対しては、必要以上に慎重になり過ぎるきらいがある。
jp_grezzo: "聡明なパルミアの王。民を思う心を強く持って善政を布くが、それゆえ自国民を危険に晒す危険性のある選択肢に対しては、必要以上に慎重になり過ぎるきらいがある。"
en: Wise king of Palmia. He is a benevolent ruler with a strong sense of duty to his people, but he tends to be more cautious than necessary about choices that might endanger his own people.
en_grezzo: "Wise king of Palmia. He is a benevolent ruler with a strong sense of duty to his people, but he tends to be more cautious than necessary about choices that might endanger his own people. "
it: Il saggio re di Palmia. Ha a cuore il suo popolo e governa con giustizia, ma proprio per questo, davanti a una scelta che rischi di esporre i suoi al pericolo, tende a essere prudente più del necessario.

jp: パルミア王『ジャビ』
jp_grezzo: "パルミア王『ジャビ』"
en: <Xabi> the king of Palmia
en_grezzo: "<Xabi> the king of Palmia"
it: <Xabi> il re di Palmia

jp: かつては白い肌の美しいエレアのような見た目の種族だった。邪悪な存在に堕落させられて現在の姿になったと言われている。
jp_grezzo: "かつては白い肌の美しいエレアのような見た目の種族だった。邪悪な存在に堕落させられて現在の姿になったと言われている。"
en: At one time, these were a beautiful pale-skinned tribe of people similar to the Elea. It is said that their current appearance is due to being corrupted by wicked thoughts.
en_grezzo: "At one time, these were a beautiful pale-skinned tribe of people similar to the Elea. It is said that their current appearance is due to being corrupted by wicked thoughts."
it: Un tempo erano una stirpe dalla pelle bianca e dall'aspetto bello, simile a quello degli Elea. Si dice che una presenza malvagia li abbia corrotti e ridotti come sono adesso.

jp: オーク
jp_grezzo: "オーク"
en: orc
en_grezzo: "orc"
it: l'orco

jp: 硬い鱗の肌を持つ竜人の戦士。武器や防具を扱う知性を持ち、独自の文化を築いているが、好戦的で他種族との交流はあまり無い。
jp_grezzo: "硬い鱗の肌を持つ竜人の戦士。武器や防具を扱う知性を持ち、独自の文化を築いているが、好戦的で他種族との交流はあまり無い。"
en: A dragonborn warrior with hard scaly skin. They have the intelligence to handle weapons and armour and have developed their own culture, but are belligerent and do not interact much with other races.
en_grezzo: "A dragonborn warrior with hard scaly skin. They have the intelligence to handle weapons and armour and have developed their own culture, but are belligerent and do not interact much with other races. "
it: Un guerriero uomo lucertola dalla pelle coperta di scaglie dure. Ha l'intelligenza per maneggiare armi e armature e si è costruito una cultura sua, ma è bellicoso e con le altre stirpi non ha molti scambi.

jp: リザードマン
jp_grezzo: "リザードマン"
en: lizard man
en_grezzo: "lizard man"
it: l'uomo lucertola

jp: すさまじい筋肉と体力を誇る牛人。自慢の体力にものを言わせ、手にした獲物を振るうことで幾人もの冒険者を挽き肉にしてきた。
jp_grezzo: "すさまじい筋肉と体力を誇る牛人。自慢の体力にものを言わせ、手にした獲物を振るうことで幾人もの冒険者を挽き肉にしてきた。"
en: A bullfighter with tremendous muscle and strength. He has turned many adventurers into ground meat by using his physical strength to wield the prey in his hands.
en_grezzo: "A bullfighter with tremendous muscle and strength. He has turned many adventurers into ground meat by using his physical strength to wield the prey in his hands. "
it: Un uomo toro che vanta muscoli e vigore spaventosi. Facendo parlare quel fisico di cui va fiero, con l'arma che si ritrova in mano ha ridotto a carne trita più di un avventuriero.

jp: ミノタウロス
jp_grezzo: "ミノタウロス"
en: minotaur
en_grezzo: "minotaur"
it: il minotauro

jp: 牛頭ながら必死に勉強し、ファイアボルトを始めとする簡単な魔法を習得した。呪いの言葉は頭のいい冒険者に対する嫉妬らしい。
jp_grezzo: "牛頭ながら必死に勉強し、ファイアボルトを始めとする簡単な魔法を習得した。呪いの言葉は頭のいい冒険者に対する嫉妬らしい。"
en: Despite being a cow-head, he studied hard and learnt simple magic, including firebolt. His curse word seems to be jealousy of smart adventurers.
en_grezzo: "Despite being a cow-head, he studied hard and learnt simple magic, including firebolt. His curse word seems to be jealousy of smart adventurers. "
it: Con una testa da bue si è messo a studiare con tutte le forze e ha imparato qualche magia semplice, a cominciare dalla saetta di fuoco. Le parolacce che gli escono pare siano invidia verso gli avventurieri intelligenti.

jp: ミノタウロスの術士
jp_grezzo: "ミノタウロスの術士"
en: minotaur magician
en_grezzo: "minotaur magician"
it: il minotauro mago

jp: 武器を使わずに己のコブシのみで戦えるまでに至った闘士。しかし愛用の斧がないと落ち着かないので結局いつも携行している。
jp_grezzo: "武器を使わずに己のコブシのみで戦えるまでに至った闘士。しかし愛用の斧がないと落ち着かないので結局いつも携行している。"
en: A fighter who has reached the point where he can fight without weapons, using only his knob. However, he is uncomfortable without his favourite axe, which he carries with him at all times.
en_grezzo: "A fighter who has reached the point where he can fight without weapons, using only his knob. However, he is uncomfortable without his favourite axe, which he carries with him at all times. "
it: Un lottatore arrivato al punto di sapersi battere con i soli pugni, senza armi. Solo che senza l'ascia a cui è affezionato non sta tranquillo, e alla fine se la porta sempre dietro.

jp: ミノタウロスの闘士
jp_grezzo: "ミノタウロスの闘士"
en: minotaur boxer
en_grezzo: "minotaur boxer"
it: il minotauro pugile

jp: 凄まじい筋肉と体力を誇る牛人の戦士。戦士として修練を重ねたミノタウロスの自由自在に振るわれる鈍器は、唸り声を上げながら敵を粉砕する。
jp_grezzo: "凄まじい筋肉と体力を誇る牛人の戦士。戦士として修練を重ねたミノタウロスの自由自在に振るわれる鈍器は、唸り声を上げながら敵を粉砕する。"
en: A bullfighter who boasts tremendous muscle and physical strength. Trained as warriors, the freely wielded blunt weapons of the minotaurs crush their enemies with a roar.
en_grezzo: "A bullfighter who boasts tremendous muscle and physical strength. Trained as warriors, the freely wielded blunt weapons of the minotaurs crush their enemies with a roar. "
it: Un guerriero uomo toro che vanta muscoli e vigore spaventosi. La mazza che un minotauro addestrato come guerriero rigira a piacimento fa a pezzi il nemico con un boato.

jp: ミノタウロスの戦士
jp_grezzo: "ミノタウロスの戦士"
en: minotaur king
en_grezzo: "minotaur king"
it: il minotauro re

jp: 野蛮なミノタウロスたちを束ねる王。屈強な体格と恐るべき破壊力の斧で、敵の肉体と戦う意志を完膚なきまでに破壊する。王都への侵攻を企てているが、自分の巣で迷子になっており外に出られない。
jp_grezzo: "野蛮なミノタウロスたちを束ねる王。屈強な体格と恐るべき破壊力の斧で、敵の肉体と戦う意志を完膚なきまでに破壊する。王都への侵攻を企てているが、自分の巣で迷子になっており外に出られない。"
en: King who unites the savage minotaurs. With his mighty physique and fearsome destructive axe, he utterly destroys the bodies and will to fight of his enemies. He plans to invade the royal capital, but is lost in his own lair and unable to get out.
en_grezzo: "King who unites the savage minotaurs. With his mighty physique and fearsome destructive axe, he utterly destroys the bodies and will to fight of his enemies. He plans to invade the royal capital, but is lost in his own lair and unable to get out."
it: Il re che tiene insieme i minotauri selvaggi. Con quel fisico possente e con l'ascia dalla potenza distruttiva spaventosa annienta il corpo del nemico e la sua voglia di combattere. Sta preparando l'assalto alla capitale, ma nella propria tana si è perso e non riesce a uscire.

jp: ミノタウロスの王『ウンガガ』
jp_grezzo: "ミノタウロスの王『ウンガガ』"
en: <Ungaga> the minotaur king
en_grezzo: "<Ungaga> the minotaur king"
it: <Ungaga> il re dei minotauri

jp: 巨大な体躯を持つ亜人の一種。再生力の高さが有名で、小さな傷ならすぐ治る。その秘密は特殊な血液にあると言われている。
jp_grezzo: "巨大な体躯を持つ亜人の一種。再生力の高さが有名で、小さな傷ならすぐ治る。その秘密は特殊な血液にあると言われている。"
en: A type of subhuman with a gigantic physique. They are famous for their regenerative powers and can quickly heal small wounds. The secret is said to lie in its special blood.
en_grezzo: "A type of subhuman with a gigantic physique. They are famous for their regenerative powers and can quickly heal small wounds. The secret is said to lie in its special blood."
it: Una specie affine all'uomo, dal corpo gigantesco. È famoso per la capacità di rigenerarsi: le ferite piccole gli si rimarginano subito. Il segreto, dicono, sta in un sangue speciale.

jp: トロール
jp_grezzo: "トロール"
en: troll
en_grezzo: "troll"
it: il troll

jp: ネフィアで暮らすエレアの民。迫害され町を追い出されたため、ネフィアの外からやってくる人物に対して恨みを抱いている。武装はネフィアで暮らすため仕方なくしているそうだ。
jp_grezzo: "ネフィアで暮らすエレアの民。迫害され町を追い出されたため、ネフィアの外からやってくる人物に対して恨みを抱いている。武装はネフィアで暮らすため仕方なくしているそうだ。"
en: An Elea who lives within ruins of Nefia. Because they were persecuted and exiled from their villages, they bear a grudge against those who enter the ruins. Their armaments are a natural consequence of having to live within the ruins.
en_grezzo: "An Elea who lives within ruins of Nefia. Because they were persecuted and exiled from their villages, they bear a grudge against those who enter the ruins. Their armaments are a natural consequence of having to live within the ruins."
it: Un Elea che vive nelle Nefia. Perseguitati e cacciati dalle città, portano rancore a chi arriva da fuori. Le armi, a quanto pare, se le porta per forza, perché nelle Nefia bisogna pur viverci.

jp: エレアの戦士
jp_grezzo: "エレアの戦士"
en: warrior of Elea
en_grezzo: "warrior of Elea"
it: il guerriero di Elea

jp: ネフィアで暮らすエレアの民。迫害され町を追い出されたため、仕方なく雨風をしのげるネフィアで暮らしている。警戒心が強く、見慣れない相手はエレアだろうと攻撃する。
jp_grezzo: "ネフィアで暮らすエレアの民。迫害され町を追い出されたため、仕方なく雨風をしのげるネフィアで暮らしている。警戒心が強く、見慣れない相手はエレアだろうと攻撃する。"
en: Elea folks living inside Nefia. Persecuted and forced out of their town, they have no choice but to live in Nefia, where they can shelter from the wind and rain. They are very wary and will attack anyone unfamiliar to them, even if they are Elea.
en_grezzo: "Elea folks living inside Nefia. Persecuted and forced out of their town, they have no choice but to live in Nefia, where they can shelter from the wind and rain. They are very wary and will attack anyone unfamiliar to them, even if they are Elea."
it: Un Elea che vive nelle Nefia. Perseguitati e cacciati dalle città, non hanno altra scelta che vivere nelle Nefia, dove almeno ci si ripara dal vento e dalla pioggia. Sono molto diffidenti, e chi non conoscono lo attaccano anche se è un Elea.

jp: エレアの魔術士
jp_grezzo: "エレアの魔術士"
en: wizard of Elea
en_grezzo: "wizard of Elea"
it: il mago di Elea

jp: 古の火の神の欠片を宿した好戦的な魔物。多手それぞれに武器を持ち、狂ったように敵対者を切り刻む。手に意識を集中しすぎて足元がお留守になることも。
jp_grezzo: "古の火の神の欠片を宿した好戦的な魔物。多手それぞれに武器を持ち、狂ったように敵対者を切り刻む。手に意識を集中しすぎて足元がお留守になることも。"
en: A belligerent demon that bears the shards of an ancient fire god. It holds a weapon in each of its many hands, and madly chops up its opponents. Sometimes concentrates too much on his hands, leaving his feet unattended.
en_grezzo: "A belligerent demon that bears the shards of an ancient fire god. It holds a weapon in each of its many hands, and madly chops up its opponents. Sometimes concentrates too much on his hands, leaving his feet unattended."
it: Un mostro bellicoso in cui alberga il frammento dell'antico dio del fuoco. Tiene un'arma in ciascuna delle sue molte mani e fa a pezzi chi gli si oppone come un pazzo. A volte concentra troppo l'attenzione sulle mani e si dimentica dei piedi.

jp: 阿修羅
jp_grezzo: "阿修羅"
en: asura
en_grezzo: "asura"
it: l'asura

jp: 古の太陽の神の欠片を宿した魔物。この太陽神の祭祀が、現在のジュア祭に影響を与えたと唱える歴史家もいる。なぜ緑色なのかはその歴史家にもわからないそうだが。
jp_grezzo: "古の太陽の神の欠片を宿した魔物。この太陽神の祭祀が、現在のジュア祭に影響を与えたと唱える歴史家もいる。なぜ緑色なのかはその歴史家にもわからないそうだが。"
en: A demon that inhabits a piece of the ancient sun god. Some historians claim that the rituals of this sun god influenced the present day Jua festival. Why it is green, though, is said to be unknown to those historians.
en_grezzo: "A demon that inhabits a piece of the ancient sun god. Some historians claim that the rituals of this sun god influenced the present day Jua festival. Why it is green, though, is said to be unknown to those historians."
it: Un mostro in cui alberga il frammento dell'antico dio del sole. C'è chi, fra gli storici, sostiene che il culto di questo dio del sole abbia influenzato la festa di Jure di oggi. Perché però sia verde, pare che nemmeno quegli storici lo sappiano.

jp: ミトラ
jp_grezzo: "ミトラ"
en: mitra
en_grezzo: "mitra"
it: il Mitra

jp: 古の天空と秩序の神の欠片を宿した魔物。水を統べる能力も失われて久しく、この異形は目前の敵を物理的に殲滅するだけに、美しい腕を旋回させる。
jp_grezzo: "古の天空と秩序の神の欠片を宿した魔物。水を統べる能力も失われて久しく、この異形は目前の敵を物理的に殲滅するだけに、美しい腕を旋回させる。"
en: A demon that bears the fragments of an ancient god of sky and order. The ability to govern the waters has long since been lost, and this variant swivels its beautiful arms only to physically annihilate the enemy in front of it.
en_grezzo: "A demon that bears the fragments of an ancient god of sky and order. The ability to govern the waters has long since been lost, and this variant swivels its beautiful arms only to physically annihilate the enemy in front of it. "
it: Un mostro in cui albergano i frammenti dell'antico dio del cielo e dell'ordine. Il potere di governare le acque l'ha perso da un pezzo, e questa creatura deforme fa roteare le sue belle braccia soltanto per annientare fisicamente il nemico che ha davanti.

jp: ヴァルナ
jp_grezzo: "ヴァルナ"
en: varuna
en_grezzo: "varuna"
it: il varuna

jp_grezzo: "精霊と心を通わせ、神々の力の輪廻をひもとき生きる識者。厳然たる基礎事実の積み重ねを重視する科学者と対立する事が多い。"
en: A intellectual who communicates with spirits and lives through the circle of the gods' power. He is often at odds with scientists who emphasise the accumulation of rigorous basic facts.
en_grezzo: "A intellectual who communicates with spirits and lives through the circle of the gods' power. He is often at odds with scientists who emphasise the accumulation of rigorous basic facts. "
it: Un sapiente che comunica con gli spiriti e vive dipanando il ciclo eterno della forza delle divinità. Con gli scienziati, che tengono all'accumulo di fatti solidi e di base, si trova spesso in contrasto.

jp: 魔術士
jp_grezzo: "魔術士"
en: wizard
en_grezzo: "wizard"
it: il mago

jp: 己の身体を鍛錬し、常人に抗し得ない活力で生活する者達。戦闘力に特化し、主に戦乱下において真価を発揮するため、平時には軍人、教官や、力仕事に就く事が多い。
jp_grezzo: "己の身体を鍛錬し、常人に抗し得ない活力で生活する者達。戦闘力に特化し、主に戦乱下において真価を発揮するため、平時には軍人、教官や、力仕事に就く事が多い。"
en: They are those who train their bodies and live with a vitality that ordinary people cannot resist. As they specialise in combat and mainly show their true value in times of war, they are often employed as soldiers, instructors or in hard work in times of peace.
en_grezzo: "They are those who train their bodies and live with a vitality that ordinary people cannot resist. As they specialise in combat and mainly show their true value in times of war, they are often employed as soldiers, instructors or in hard work in times of peace. "
it: Gente che tempra il proprio corpo e vive con un vigore a cui una persona comune non può opporsi. Sono specializzati nel combattimento e danno il meglio soprattutto in tempo di guerra, e così in tempo di pace fanno spesso i soldati, gli istruttori o i lavori di fatica.

jp: 戦士
jp_grezzo: "戦士"
en: warrior
en_grezzo: "warrior"
it: il guerriero

jp: 土地の魔力を糧に成長した野菜に似たモンスター。多分に魔力を含んだ彼らの肉には冒険者の魔力を僅かながら刺激する効果がある。音属性の魔法でもある悲鳴に注意。
jp_grezzo: "土地の魔力を糧に成長した野菜に似たモンスター。多分に魔力を含んだ彼らの肉には冒険者の魔力を僅かながら刺激する効果がある。音属性の魔法でもある悲鳴に注意。"
en: A monster, resembling a vegetable, that grows by feeding on magical energy within the soil. Their flesh contains a large amount of magical energy, and is capable of stimulating the magical powers of those who consume it. Be wary of its terrifying screams, which are magic with the attribute of sound.
en_grezzo: "A monster, resembling a vegetable, that grows by feeding on magical energy within the soil. Their flesh contains a large amount of magical energy, and is capable of stimulating the magical powers of those who consume it. Be wary of its terrifying screams, which are magic with the attribute of sound."
it: Un mostro simile a un ortaggio, cresciuto nutrendosi della forza magica della terra. La sua carne, che di forza magica ne contiene parecchia, stimola un poco quella dell'avventuriero. Attenzione all'urlo, che è anche una magia dell'attributo suono.

jp: マンドレイク
jp_grezzo: "マンドレイク"
en: mandrake
en_grezzo: "mandrake"
it: la mandragora

jp: 街の子供の憧れな昆虫。乱獲によって大昔に野生のかぶと虫は絶滅したが、品種改良された個体が脱走し野生化している。越冬し、寿命も長い。
jp_grezzo: "街の子供の憧れな昆虫。乱獲によって大昔に野生のかぶと虫は絶滅したが、品種改良された個体が脱走し野生化している。越冬し、寿命も長い。"
en: Insects that are the dream of every child in the city. Wild beetles died out a long time ago due to overhunting, but bred individuals have escaped and are now in the wild. They survive over winter and have a long lifespan.
en_grezzo: "Insects that are the dream of every child in the city. Wild beetles died out a long time ago due to overhunting, but bred individuals have escaped and are now in the wild. They survive over winter and have a long lifespan."
it: L'insetto che tutti i bambini di città sognano. Quelli selvatici si sono estinti tanto tempo fa per la caccia sfrenata, ma certi esemplari selezionati sono scappati e sono tornati allo stato brado. Passa l'inverno e vive a lungo.

jp: かぶと虫
jp_grezzo: "かぶと虫"
en: beetle
en_grezzo: "beetle"
it: lo scarabeo

jp: オーク達の中でも特に勇猛で好戦的な者達。オークは手先が器用で機械にも興味を示すが、武器等の破壊をもたらす物以外を一切作ろうとしない。
jp_grezzo: "オーク達の中でも特に勇猛で好戦的な者達。オークは手先が器用で機械にも興味を示すが、武器等の破壊をもたらす物以外を一切作ろうとしない。"
en: Orcs are a tribe of particularly brave and warlike people. Orcs are very skillful with their hands and show interest in machinery, but they don't try to make anything other than weapons.
en_grezzo: "Orcs are a tribe of particularly brave and warlike people. Orcs are very skillful with their hands and show interest in machinery, but they don't try to make anything other than weapons."
it: Fra gli orchi, quelli particolarmente coraggiosi e bellicosi. Gli orchi hanno le mani buone e si interessano anche alle macchine, ma di costruire qualcosa che non porti distruzione, come le armi, non ne vogliono sapere.

jp: オークの戦士
jp_grezzo: "オークの戦士"
en: orc warrior
en_grezzo: "orc warrior"
it: l'orco guerriero

jp: オーク族の歴戦の勇者。オークは決して愚かな存在では無いのだが鈍感で勝手なため、隊長となって部隊を纏めようとする者は非常に珍しい。
jp_grezzo: "オーク族の歴戦の勇者。オークは決して愚かな存在では無いのだが鈍感で勝手なため、隊長となって部隊を纏めようとする者は非常に珍しい。"
en: A brave warrior of the Orc tribe who has fought in many battles. Orcs are not stupid, but they are insensitive and self-indulgent, so it is very rare for them to become captains and try to unite their troops.
en_grezzo: "A brave warrior of the Orc tribe who has fought in many battles. Orcs are not stupid, but they are insensitive and self-indulgent, so it is very rare for them to become captains and try to unite their troops. "
it: Un valoroso della stirpe degli orchi, con molte battaglie alle spalle. Gli orchi non sono affatto stupidi, ma sono duri di sentimenti e fanno di testa loro, e perciò è rarissimo che uno diventi capitano e provi a tenere insieme un reparto.

jp: オークの隊長『ゴダ』
jp_grezzo: "オークの隊長『ゴダ』"
en: <Goda> the captain of orc
en_grezzo: "<Goda> the captain of orc"
it: <Goda> il capitano degli orchi

jp: 埋葬された遺体に残されたマナが周囲の魔力に反応し、取り込むべく遺体を動かしている。稀に生前の意識が残っている個体も存在する。
jp_grezzo: "埋葬された遺体に残されたマナが周囲の魔力に反応し、取り込むべく遺体を動かしている。稀に生前の意識が残っている個体も存在する。"
en: A re-animated corpse brought to life by a reaction between mana left in its body and the mana in its surroundings. It's rare to find one that retains any memories of its life.
en_grezzo: "A re-animated corpse brought to life by a reaction between mana left in its body and the mana in its surroundings. It's rare to find one that retains any memories of its life."
it: Il mana rimasto nel corpo sepolto reagisce alla forza magica che ha intorno, e per assorbirla muove il cadavere. Di rado se ne trova uno che si porti dietro la coscienza di quando era vivo.

jp: ゾンビ
jp_grezzo: "ゾンビ"
en: zombie
en_grezzo: "zombie"
it: lo zombi

jp: 野外で良く見かける野生動物。素早い動きでひらりと身をかわす。超音波で周囲の状況がわかるため、盲目状態にならない。よく裏切るやつ、というイメージのせいで迷惑している。
jp_grezzo: "野外で良く見かける野生動物。素早い動きでひらりと身をかわす。超音波で周囲の状況がわかるため、盲目状態にならない。よく裏切るやつ、というイメージのせいで迷惑している。"
en: Wild animals often seen in the open. Dodges and dodges with quick movements. They use ultrasound to understand their surroundings, so they are not blind. They are inconvenienced by the inaccurate vision.
en_grezzo: "Wild animals often seen in the open. Dodges and dodges with quick movements. They use ultrasound to understand their surroundings, so they are not blind. They are inconvenienced by the inaccurate vision."
it: Un animale selvatico che si incontra spesso all'aperto. Con movimenti rapidi scarta e schiva. Grazie agli ultrasuoni sa che cosa gli sta intorno, e per questo non resta mai accecato. Gli dà fastidio la fama di essere uno che tradisce.

jp: コウモリ
jp_grezzo: "コウモリ"
en: bat
en_grezzo: "bat"
it: il pipistrello

jp: コウモリの中でも吸血を行う種類の総称。ただしあまりお腹が膨れないため、吸血はおやつ感覚でしかないらしい。集団で獲物に群がり、血を吸い尽くしてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "コウモリの中でも吸血を行う種類の総称。ただしあまりお腹が膨れないため、吸血はおやつ感覚でしかないらしい。集団で獲物に群がり、血を吸い尽くしてしまう。"
en: A generic name for a species of bat that sucks blood. However, as their stomachs do not swell much, blood sucking is said to be only a snack. They swarm over their prey in groups and suck all the blood.
en_grezzo: "A generic name for a species of bat that sucks blood. However, as their stomachs do not swell much, blood sucking is said to be only a snack. They swarm over their prey in groups and suck all the blood."
it: Il nome che raccoglie le specie di pipistrello che succhiano il sangue. La pancia però non gli si riempie granché, e pare che il sangue sia poco più di uno spuntino. Si ammassano in gruppo sulla preda e le succhiano tutto il sangue.

jp: 吸血コウモリ
jp_grezzo: "吸血コウモリ"
en: vampire bat
en_grezzo: "vampire bat"
it: il pipistrello vampiro

jp: 竜のような翼を持つ戦闘能力の高い蝙蝠。その素早さに魅入られ、なんとかして乗馬しようとする者もいるという。ワイバーンに遭遇すると張り合おうとする習性がある。
jp_grezzo: "竜のような翼を持つ戦闘能力の高い蝙蝠。その素早さに魅入られ、なんとかして乗馬しようとする者もいるという。ワイバーンに遭遇すると張り合おうとする習性がある。"
en: A highly skilled bat with dragon-like wings. Some are said to be fascinated by its swiftness and try to ride it somehow. They have a habit of trying to compete with wyverns when they encounter them.
en_grezzo: "A highly skilled bat with dragon-like wings. Some are said to be fascinated by its swiftness and try to ride it somehow. They have a habit of trying to compete with wyverns when they encounter them."
it: Un pipistrello con le ali da drago e una buona capacità di combattere. C'è chi, incantato da quella rapidità, cerca in qualche modo di montarci sopra. Quando incontra una viverna ha l'abitudine di volersi misurare con lei.

jp: ドラゴンバット
jp_grezzo: "ドラゴンバット"
en: dragon bat
en_grezzo: "dragon bat"
it: il pipistrello drago

jp: 美しい炎の花を咲かせたエント。動きはやや遅いものの高い生命力を誇り、その巨大な枝を振るう一撃はとても強烈である。
jp_grezzo: "美しい炎の花を咲かせたエント。動きはやや遅いものの高い生命力を誇り、その巨大な枝を振るう一撃はとても強烈である。"
en: Ent with beautiful flame flowers. Although it moves rather slowly, it boasts high vitality and the strikes it delivers with its huge branches are very powerful.
en_grezzo: "Ent with beautiful flame flowers. Although it moves rather slowly, it boasts high vitality and the strikes it delivers with its huge branches are very powerful. "
it: Un Ent che ha aperto bellissimi fiori di fiamma. Si muove piuttosto lento, ma vanta una gran forza vitale, e il colpo che sferra con quei rami enormi è violentissimo.

jp: 火炎樹
jp_grezzo: "火炎樹"
en: fire ent
en_grezzo: "fire ent"
it: l'ent di fuoco

jp: 美しい氷の花を咲かせたエント。冷気に包まれた幹や枝は水晶のように輝いており、観賞用として貴族の間で人気が高い。
jp_grezzo: "美しい氷の花を咲かせたエント。冷気に包まれた幹や枝は水晶のように輝いており、観賞用として貴族の間で人気が高い。"
en: Ent with beautiful ice flowers. The trunks and branches, surrounded by cold air, shine like crystals and are popular among the nobility as ornamental plants.
en_grezzo: "Ent with beautiful ice flowers. The trunks and branches, surrounded by cold air, shine like crystals and are popular among the nobility as ornamental plants. "
it: Un Ent che ha aperto bellissimi fiori di ghiaccio. Il tronco e i rami, avvolti nel gelo, brillano come cristallo, e fra i nobili sono molto ricercati come ornamento.

jp: 氷結樹
jp_grezzo: "氷結樹"
en: ice ent
en_grezzo: "ice ent"
it: l'ent di ghiaccio

jp: 生前は魔術士だった者が死してなお現世にしがみつこうとした成れの果て。理性の残っていない者は人に害をもたらす仇敵となる。
jp_grezzo: "生前は魔術士だった者が死してなお現世にしがみつこうとした成れの果て。理性の残っていない者は人に害をもたらす仇敵となる。"
en: The result of those who were mages in life and tried to cling to this world even after death. Those who have no reason left become avengers who bring harm to others.
en_grezzo: "The result of those who were mages in life and tried to cling to this world even after death. Those who have no reason left become avengers who bring harm to others. "
it: Quel che resta di chi in vita era un mago e, anche da morto, ha voluto restare aggrappato a questo mondo. Chi non ha più un briciolo di ragione diventa un nemico che porta danno agli uomini.

jp: リッチ
jp_grezzo: "リッチ"
en: lich
en_grezzo: "lich"
it: il lich

jp: 肉体を失い霊体化が進んできたリッチ。長き時の中で永遠を求めた過去の記憶は既に磨耗してしまっており、道行く生者を同じ存在に落とそうとする魔物と化している。
jp_grezzo: "肉体を失い霊体化が進んできたリッチ。長き時の中で永遠を求めた過去の記憶は既に磨耗してしまっており、道行く生者を同じ存在に落とそうとする魔物と化している。"
en: Lich, who has lost his physical body and has been transformed into a spirit body. The memories of the past, which sought eternity in the long passage of time, have already worn away, and he has become a monster who tries to reduce the living in his path to the same existence.
en_grezzo: "Lich, who has lost his physical body and has been transformed into a spirit body. The memories of the past, which sought eternity in the long passage of time, have already worn away, and he has become a monster who tries to reduce the living in his path to the same existence. "
it: Un lich che ha perso il corpo e si è fatto via via spirito. Il ricordo di quando, nel lungo scorrere del tempo, cercava l'eternità si è ormai consumato, e si è ridotto a un mostro che vuole portare alla propria condizione i vivi che incontra.

jp: マスターリッチ
jp_grezzo: "マスターリッチ"
en: master lich
en_grezzo: "master lich"
it: il lich maestro

jp: 肉体が崩れ落ち半霊の存在となったリッチ。久遠の年月を彷徨い続けた結果、驚異的な魔力と引き換えに本能のみで生者を殺害しようとする悪霊となった。
jp_grezzo: "肉体が崩れ落ち半霊の存在となったリッチ。久遠の年月を彷徨い続けた結果、驚異的な魔力と引き換えに本能のみで生者を殺害しようとする悪霊となった。"
en: Lich, whose physical body collapsed and he became a half-spirit. As a result of his wandering through the ages, he became an evil spirit that tries to kill the living with only his instincts in exchange for his amazing magical powers.
en_grezzo: "Lich, whose physical body collapsed and he became a half-spirit. As a result of his wandering through the ages, he became an evil spirit that tries to kill the living with only his instincts in exchange for his amazing magical powers. "
it: Un lich il cui corpo si è sgretolato e che è diventato mezzo spirito. A furia di vagare per età intere è diventato uno spirito maligno che, in cambio di una forza magica prodigiosa, cerca di uccidere i vivi per solo istinto.

jp: デミリッチ
jp_grezzo: "デミリッチ"
en: demi lich
en_grezzo: "demi lich"
it: il lich minore

jp: 死に通ずる冥界の魔物。生きることが罪であるという生者と相いれない価値観を持ち、相手を強制的に殺害する恐ろしい呪いで一方的に刑を執行する。
jp_grezzo: "死に通ずる冥界の魔物。生きることが罪であるという生者と相いれない価値観を持ち、相手を強制的に殺害する恐ろしい呪いで一方的に刑を執行する。"
en: A monster of the underworld that is connected to death. It has values that are incompatible with those of the living, which state that to live is a sin, and unilaterally executes sentences with a terrible curse that forcibly kills its opponents.
en_grezzo: "A monster of the underworld that is connected to death. It has values that are incompatible with those of the living, which state that to live is a sin, and unilaterally executes sentences with a terrible curse that forcibly kills its opponents. "
it: Un mostro dell'oltretomba che porta alla morte. Ha valori che con quelli dei vivi non stanno insieme, e cioè che vivere sia una colpa, ed esegue la sentenza da solo, con una maledizione tremenda che uccide per forza chi ha davanti.

jp: 死刑執行人
jp_grezzo: "死刑執行人"
en: executioner
en_grezzo: "executioner"
it: il boia

jp: 死に通ずる冥界の魔物。生者と死者の数の帳尻を合わせるために、彼らは死神の命令で死の宣告を行う。たいていは本来迎えるはずの死ではないため、返り討ちにすればなかったことにできる。
jp_grezzo: "死に通ずる冥界の魔物。生者と死者の数の帳尻を合わせるために、彼らは死神の命令で死の宣告を行う。たいていは本来迎えるはずの死ではないため、返り討ちにすればなかったことにできる。"
en: A monster of the underworld that is connected to death. In order to balance the numbers of the living and the dead, they are ordered by the god of death to declare death sentences. Most of the time, the death is not the death that should have come, so it can be pretended that it never happened if the victim survives.
en_grezzo: "A monster of the underworld that is connected to death. In order to balance the numbers of the living and the dead, they are ordered by the god of death to declare death sentences. Most of the time, the death is not the death that should have come, so it can be pretended that it never happened if the victim survives."
it: Un mostro dell'oltretomba che porta alla morte. Per far tornare i conti fra il numero dei vivi e quello dei morti, pronunciano la condanna per ordine della Morte. Quasi sempre non è la morte che sarebbe davvero toccata, e quindi, se lo si respinge, la cosa si può cancellare.

jp: 死神の使い
jp_grezzo: "死神の使い"
en: messenger of death
en_grezzo: "messenger of death"
it: il messo della morte

jp: 獲物を狩ることに特化している犬。犬は縄張り意識が強いために、自分より強いレベルの犬がいる場所には住み着くことはない。
jp_grezzo: "獲物を狩ることに特化している犬。犬は縄張り意識が強いために、自分より強いレベルの犬がいる場所には住み着くことはない。"
en: Dogs specialize in hunting prey. Because dogs are territorial, they will not settle in areas where there are dogs on a stronger level than themselves.
en_grezzo: "Dogs specialize in hunting prey. Because dogs are territorial, they will not settle in areas where there are dogs on a stronger level than themselves."
it: Un cane specializzato nel dare la caccia alla preda. I cani hanno un forte senso del territorio, e non si stabiliscono dove c'è un cane di livello più forte del loro.

jp: 猟犬
jp_grezzo: "猟犬"
en: hound
en_grezzo: "hound"
it: il segugio

en: Its venom is so strong that it can kill large animals and even snakes of the same species. Its majestic appearance gives it the air of a king, but its character is surprisingly timid. Some adventurers try to develop a resistance to its venom by eating it whole.
en_grezzo: "Its venom is so strong that it can kill large animals and even snakes of the same species. Its majestic appearance gives it the air of a king, but its character is surprisingly timid. Some adventurers try to develop a resistance to its venom by eating it whole."
it: Ha un veleno tanto forte da uccidere animali di grossa taglia e perfino serpenti della sua stessa specie. L'aspetto maestoso gli dà un'aria da re, ma il carattere è sorprendentemente pauroso. C'è qualche avventuriero che se lo mangia col veleno e tutto, per farsi resistente.

jp: キングコブラ
jp_grezzo: "キングコブラ"
en: king cobra
en_grezzo: "king cobra"
it: il cobra reale

jp: 進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種。ドラゴンとは比べ物にならないほど弱いが、その強さを侮ってはいけない。ストレスを感じると火の混じった溜息を吐く。
jp_grezzo: "進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種。ドラゴンとは比べ物にならないほど弱いが、その強さを侮ってはいけない。ストレスを感じると火の混じった溜息を吐く。"
en: A subspecies of dragon born during its evolutionary process. It is incomparably weaker than dragons, but its strength should not be underestimated. When stressed, they breathe out a sigh mixed with fire.
en_grezzo: "A subspecies of dragon born during its evolutionary process. It is incomparably weaker than dragons, but its strength should not be underestimated. When stressed, they breathe out a sigh mixed with fire."
it: Una sottospecie di drago nata lungo il cammino dell'evoluzione. Con un drago non regge il confronto, ma non bisogna sottovalutare la sua forza. Quando è sotto tensione manda fuori un sospiro misto a fuoco.

jp: ファイアドレイク
jp_grezzo: "ファイアドレイク"
en: fire drake
en_grezzo: "fire drake"
it: il draco di fuoco

jp: 進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種。アイスドレイク一匹よりもアイスハウンドの群れの方が恐ろしいとされていることに憤りを感じている。
jp_grezzo: "進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種。アイスドレイク一匹よりもアイスハウンドの群れの方が恐ろしいとされていることに憤りを感じている。"
en: A subspecies of dragon born during its evolutionary process. They resent the fact that a pack of icehounds is considered more fearsome than a single ice drake.
en_grezzo: "A subspecies of dragon born during its evolutionary process. They resent the fact that a pack of icehounds is considered more fearsome than a single ice drake."
it: Una sottospecie di drago nata lungo il cammino dell'evoluzione. Gli rode che un branco di segugi di ghiaccio venga considerato più temibile di un draco di ghiaccio da solo.

jp: アイスドレイク
jp_grezzo: "アイスドレイク"
en: ice drake
en_grezzo: "ice drake"
it: il draco di ghiaccio

jp: マミー系の最下位種。主に罪人や市民の死体が放置され、劣悪な環境で偶然ミイラ化したものを指す。特に役職を持たず生者を見境無く襲う。
jp_grezzo: "マミー系の最下位種。主に罪人や市民の死体が放置され、劣悪な環境で偶然ミイラ化したものを指す。特に役職を持たず生者を見境無く襲う。"
en: Lowest class of mummy species. Mainly refers to the corpses of criminals and citizens who have been left to rot and accidentally mummified in poor conditions. They have no particular position and attack the living without regard.
en_grezzo: "Lowest class of mummy species. Mainly refers to the corpses of criminals and citizens who have been left to rot and accidentally mummified in poor conditions. They have no particular position and attack the living without regard."
it: La specie più bassa fra le mummie. Indica soprattutto i cadaveri di criminali e di cittadini lasciati lì, che si sono mummificati per caso in un ambiente pessimo. Non hanno nessun compito e assalgono i vivi senza distinzione.

jp: レッサーマミー
jp_grezzo: "レッサーマミー"
en: lesser mummy
en_grezzo: "lesser mummy"
it: la mummia minore

jp: かつて栄えた王国で兵士だったもの。生前から身に着けていた武器と技を駆使し、侵入者の行く手を阻む。群れで行動することが多い。
jp_grezzo: "かつて栄えた王国で兵士だったもの。生前から身に着けていた武器と技を駆使し、侵入者の行く手を阻む。群れで行動することが多い。"
en: A former soldier in a once prosperous kingdom. He uses the weapons and skills he acquired during his life to block the way of intruders. They often work in packs.
en_grezzo: "A former soldier in a once prosperous kingdom. He uses the weapons and skills he acquired during his life to block the way of intruders. They often work in packs."
it: Uno che fu soldato in un regno un tempo fiorente. Usa le armi e le tecniche che aveva da vivo e sbarra la strada agli intrusi. Spesso si muovono in gruppo.

jp: マミー
jp_grezzo: "マミー"
en: mummy
en_grezzo: "mummy"
it: la mummia

jp: マミー系の上位種。主に兵士を王の護衛役として人為的にミイラ化したものを指す。下位のマミーを従えて遺跡荒らしを追い詰める。
jp_grezzo: "マミー系の上位種。主に兵士を王の護衛役として人為的にミイラ化したものを指す。下位のマミーを従えて遺跡荒らしを追い詰める。"
en: A higher species of mummy type. Refers mainly to soldiers artificially mummified to act as guards for the king. They hunt down thiefs with lower-ranked mummies in tow.
en_grezzo: "A higher species of mummy type. Refers mainly to soldiers artificially mummified to act as guards for the king. They hunt down thiefs with lower-ranked mummies in tow."
it: La specie superiore fra le mummie. Indica soprattutto i soldati mummificati apposta per fare da guardia al re. Si porta dietro le mummie di rango più basso e mette alle strette chi saccheggia le rovine.

jp: グレイターマミー
jp_grezzo: "グレイターマミー"
en: greater mummy
en_grezzo: "greater mummy"
it: la mummia maggiore

jp: 禁術により生ける屍と化してまで現世を生きる古代の王。時折間抜けな遺跡荒らしを招待状でおびき寄せ、ピラミッドを守る兵士を補充している。
jp_grezzo: "禁術により生ける屍と化してまで現世を生きる古代の王。時折間抜けな遺跡荒らしを招待状でおびき寄せ、ピラミッドを守る兵士を補充している。"
en: An ancient king who lives in this world until the forbidden arts turn him into a living corpse. He occasionally lures dumb grave robbers with invitations and replenishes the soldiers guarding the pyramids.
en_grezzo: "An ancient king who lives in this world until the forbidden arts turn him into a living corpse. He occasionally lures dumb grave robbers with invitations and replenishes the soldiers guarding the pyramids."
it: Un re antico che, per restare a vivere in questo mondo, con un'arte proibita si è ridotto a cadavere che cammina. Ogni tanto attira con un invito qualche sciocco che saccheggia le rovine, e così rimpiazza i soldati che sorvegliano la piramide.

jp: ピラミッドの主『ツェン』
jp_grezzo: "ピラミッドの主『ツェン』"
en: <Tuwen> the master of the pyramid
en_grezzo: "<Tuwen> the master of the pyramid"
it: <Tuwen> il signore della piramide

jp: 古の昔に栄えた一文明、貴の者たちが安置された棺の周囲にダミーとして配置されたもののなれの果て。入れられた死体が棺と融合してしまっている。
jp_grezzo: "古の昔に栄えた一文明、貴の者たちが安置された棺の周囲にダミーとして配置されたもののなれの果て。入れられた死体が棺と融合してしまっている。"
en: The end result of a civilisation that flourished in ancient times, where noblemen were placed as dummies around a coffin in which they were enshrined. The corpse in which they were placed has fused with the coffin.
en_grezzo: "The end result of a civilisation that flourished in ancient times, where noblemen were placed as dummies around a coffin in which they were enshrined. The corpse in which they were placed has fused with the coffin."
it: Quel che resta dei sarcofagi che, in una civiltà fiorita nell'antichità, venivano messi come esca intorno a quello dove riposavano i nobili. Il cadavere che ci avevano messo dentro si è fuso con il sarcofago.

jp: 古代の棺
jp_grezzo: "古代の棺"
en: ancient coffin
en_grezzo: "ancient coffin"
it: il sarcofago antico

jp: 群れを作って人を襲う小人。彼らは独自の言語を話し地下にゴブリンだけの社会を築いている。トロールとは言葉が通じないもののウマが合うらしく、仲が良い。
jp_grezzo: "群れを作って人を襲う小人。彼らは独自の言語を話し地下にゴブリンだけの社会を築いている。トロールとは言葉が通じないもののウマが合うらしく、仲が良い。"
en: Goblins attack people in swarms. They speak their own language and have established an underground goblin-only society. Although they do not speak the same language as trolls, they seem to get on well with them.
en_grezzo: "Goblins attack people in swarms. They speak their own language and have established an underground goblin-only society. Although they do not speak the same language as trolls, they seem to get on well with them."
it: Un piccolo essere che assale gli uomini in gruppo. Parlano una lingua tutta loro e sottoterra si sono costruiti una società di soli goblin. Con i troll non si capiscono a parole, eppure pare che vadano d'accordo e stiano in buoni rapporti.

jp: ゴブリン
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリン"
en: goblin
en_grezzo: "goblin"
it: il goblin

jp: ゴブリン族の中で近接戦闘の訓練を積んだ者。心眼で的確に急所を狙う上、その筋骨隆々の体は見た目以上に力を発揮する。
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリン族の中で近接戦闘の訓練を積んだ者。心眼で的確に急所を狙う上、その筋骨隆々の体は見た目以上に力を発揮する。"
en: Trained in melee combat among the goblin tribe. He uses his eye of mind to accurately aim for the vital spot, and his muscular body shows more strength than it appears.
en_grezzo: "Trained in melee combat among the goblin tribe. He uses his eye of mind to accurately aim for the vital spot, and his muscular body shows more strength than it appears."
it: Fra i goblin, quelli che si sono addestrati al corpo a corpo. Con l'occhio della mente punta il punto debole con precisione, e quel corpo tutto muscoli tira fuori più forza di quanta ne dia a vedere.

jp: ゴブリンの戦士
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリンの戦士"
en: goblin warrior
en_grezzo: "goblin warrior"
it: il goblin guerriero

jp: ゴブリン族の呪術師。この魔物が発見されたとき、ゴブリンにも精霊や神などを信仰する慣習があるということに世界は驚愕した。一応、人間たちの見よう見まねであることが後に判明したのだが。
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリン族の呪術師。この魔物が発見されたとき、ゴブリンにも精霊や神などを信仰する慣習があるということに世界は驚愕した。一応、人間たちの見よう見まねであることが後に判明したのだが。"
en: Goblin tribe sorcerer. When this monster was discovered, the world was astonished to learn that goblins also had a practice of believing in spirits and gods. It was later discovered that they were, in a manner of speaking, imitating the humans.
en_grezzo: "Goblin tribe sorcerer. When this monster was discovered, the world was astonished to learn that goblins also had a practice of believing in spirits and gods. It was later discovered that they were, in a manner of speaking, imitating the humans."
it: Lo stregone della stirpe dei goblin. Quando questo mostro fu scoperto, il mondo restò sbalordito che anche i goblin avessero l'usanza di venerare gli spiriti e le divinità. Poi si scoprì che, in fondo, non facevano che scimmiottare gli uomini.

jp: ゴブリンシャーマン
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリンシャーマン"
en: goblin shaman
en_grezzo: "goblin shaman"
it: il goblin sciamano

jp: ゴブリン族の中で魔力に長けた者。地味ながら魔法の矢で獲物の確実に追い詰めて行く、縁の下の力持ち。魔法が使えることを鼻にかけているフシがある。
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリン族の中で魔力に長けた者。地味ながら魔法の矢で獲物の確実に追い詰めて行く、縁の下の力持ち。魔法が使えることを鼻にかけているフシがある。"
en: A goblin tribe member who is skilled in magic. He is a simple but powerful man behind the scenes who uses magic arrows to hunt down his prey with confidence. He seems to have a nose to taking advantage of his magical abilities.
en_grezzo: "A goblin tribe member who is skilled in magic. He is a simple but powerful man behind the scenes who uses magic arrows to hunt down his prey with confidence. He seems to have a nose to taking advantage of his magical abilities."
it: Fra i goblin, quello portato per la forza magica. Senza dare nell'occhio mette la preda alle strette con la freccia magica, un colpo dopo l'altro: è la forza che lavora dietro le quinte. Pare che di saper usare la magia se ne vanti un po' troppo.

jp: ゴブリンの魔法使い
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリンの魔法使い"
en: goblin wizard
en_grezzo: "goblin wizard"
it: il goblin mago

jp: 現在は何処かに封印されているという赤き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝するようになった者。ローブに隠された貌は元の容を留めぬ程に焼け爛れている。
jp_grezzo: "現在は何処かに封印されているという赤き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝するようになった者。ローブに隠された貌は元の容を留めぬ程に焼け爛れている。"
en: A person who has become fascinated by and worships the red devil, which is now sealed away somewhere. His face, hidden by his dressing gown, is so burnt that it has lost all trace of its original appearance.
en_grezzo: "A person who has become fascinated by and worships the red devil, which is now sealed away somewhere. His face, hidden by his dressing gown, is so burnt that it has lost all trace of its original appearance. "
it: Uno a cui il demone rosso, che adesso dicono sigillato da qualche parte, ha rapito il cuore e che ha finito per adorarlo. Il volto nascosto sotto la veste è bruciato al punto da non conservare più niente della forma di prima.

jp: 赤の洗礼者
jp_grezzo: "赤の洗礼者"
en: red baptist
en_grezzo: "red baptist"
it: il battezzatore rosso

jp: 現在は何処かに封印されているという青き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝するようになった者。ローブに隠された貌はおぞましく凍り付き、眼球全体が碧く濁っている。
jp_grezzo: "現在は何処かに封印されているという青き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝するようになった者。ローブに隠された貌はおぞましく凍り付き、眼球全体が碧く濁っている。"
en: A person who has become enthralled by and worships the blue devil, which is now sealed away somewhere. His face, hidden by a dressing gown, is horribly frozen and his eyeballs are entirely clouded with blue.
en_grezzo: "A person who has become enthralled by and worships the blue devil, which is now sealed away somewhere. His face, hidden by a dressing gown, is horribly frozen and his eyeballs are entirely clouded with blue. "
it: Uno a cui il demone blu, che adesso dicono sigillato da qualche parte, ha rapito il cuore e che ha finito per adorarlo. Il volto nascosto sotto la veste è congelato in modo orribile, e il bulbo degli occhi è tutto torbido di azzurro.

jp: 青の洗礼者
jp_grezzo: "青の洗礼者"
en: blue baptist
en_grezzo: "blue baptist"
it: il battezzatore blu

jp: 人に飼い慣らされた熊。芸も覚えているが披露する機会を与えられる者は少ない。捨てられた者は野生化し、群れで人を襲う。
jp_grezzo: "人に飼い慣らされた熊。芸も覚えているが披露する機会を与えられる者は少ない。捨てられた者は野生化し、群れで人を襲う。"
en: A bear that has been tamed by people. They learn tricks, but few are given the opportunity to perform them. Those that are abandoned become wild and attack people in packs.
en_grezzo: "A bear that has been tamed by people. They learn tricks, but few are given the opportunity to perform them. Those that are abandoned become wild and attack people in packs."
it: Un orso addomesticato dagli uomini. Impara anche i numeri da spettacolo, ma pochi hanno l'occasione di mostrarli. Quelli che vengono abbandonati tornano selvatici e assalgono la gente in branco.

jp: ブラウンベア
jp_grezzo: "ブラウンベア"
en: brown bear
en_grezzo: "brown bear"
it: l'orso bruno

jp: 特に人間を好んで襲う狂暴な熊。別名はハイイログマであり、その名の通り体毛は灰色なのだが、たまに返り血で毛が赤く染まっている個体もいるようだ。
jp_grezzo: "特に人間を好んで襲う狂暴な熊。別名はハイイログマであり、その名の通り体毛は灰色なのだが、たまに返り血で毛が赤く染まっている個体もいるようだ。"
en: A rabid bear that particularly likes to attack humans. It is also known as the hylog bear, and as its name suggests, its body hair is grey, but occasionally some individuals seem to have their fur stained red by returned blood.
en_grezzo: "A rabid bear that particularly likes to attack humans. It is also known as the hylog bear, and as its name suggests, its body hair is grey, but occasionally some individuals seem to have their fur stained red by returned blood. "
it: Un orso feroce che ha una particolare preferenza per gli uomini. L'altro suo nome è orso grigio, e come dice il nome ha il pelo grigio, ma ogni tanto pare ci sia qualche esemplare che ce l'ha tinto di rosso dal sangue schizzato addosso.

jp: グリズリー
jp_grezzo: "グリズリー"
en: grizzly
en_grezzo: "grizzly"
it: il grizzly

jp: レム・イド時代に遺伝子復元技術によって復活したとされる、超古代生物。その肉は大昔から人間たちの糧となっていた。現在でもマンモスの肉は御馳走とされている。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イド時代に遺伝子復元技術によって復活したとされる、超古代生物。その肉は大昔から人間たちの糧となっていた。現在でもマンモスの肉は御馳走とされている。"
en: A super-ancient creature that is believed to have been revived by genetic restoration technology during the Remido era. Its meat has fed humans since ancient times. Even today, mammoth meat is considered a delicacy.
en_grezzo: "A super-ancient creature that is believed to have been revived by genetic restoration technology during the Remido era. Its meat has fed humans since ancient times. Even today, mammoth meat is considered a delicacy."
it: Una creatura antichissima che, dicono, fu riportata in vita al tempo di Rehm-Ido con la tecnica che ricostruisce i geni. La sua carne è stata cibo per gli uomini fin dai tempi remoti, e ancora oggi la carne di mammut è considerata una leccornia.

jp: マンモス
jp_grezzo: "マンモス"
en: Mammoth
en_grezzo: "Mammoth"
it: il mammut

jp: 斃れた戦士の無念が、打ち捨てられた鎧に宿り彷徨うようになった。誰かに破壊されない限り、果たせなかった敵を探し続ける。中身が空っぽなせいか、満たされないんだとか。
jp_grezzo: "斃れた戦士の無念が、打ち捨てられた鎧に宿り彷徨うようになった。誰かに破壊されない限り、果たせなかった敵を探し続ける。中身が空っぽなせいか、満たされないんだとか。"
en: The remorse of the dead warriors began to wander about in their cast-off armour. Unless someone destroys them, they continue to search for the enemy they could not defeat. They are not satisfied because they are empty inside.
en_grezzo: "The remorse of the dead warriors began to wander about in their cast-off armour. Unless someone destroys them, they continue to search for the enemy they could not defeat. They are not satisfied because they are empty inside."
it: Il rimpianto di un guerriero caduto si è annidato nell'armatura buttata via e ha cominciato a vagare. Se qualcuno non la distrugge continua a cercare il nemico che non è riuscita a battere. Sarà perché dentro è vuota, ma non si sente mai sazia.

jp: リビングアーマー
jp_grezzo: "リビングアーマー"
en: living armor
en_grezzo: "living armor"
it: l'armatura vivente

jp: 斃れた戦士の邪念が主無き重層鎧に乗り移り、生命あるもの全てを敵とみなし、暴走した。打ち果たされた後も次の器を探して彷徨うことだろう。
jp_grezzo: "斃れた戦士の邪念が主無き重層鎧に乗り移り、生命あるもの全てを敵とみなし、暴走した。打ち果たされた後も次の器を探して彷徨うことだろう。"
en: The evil spirit of the dead warrior has taken over the masterless heavy-layered armour and has run amok, regarding everything that lives as an enemy. After being vanquished, they will continue to wander in search of the next vessel.
en_grezzo: "The evil spirit of the dead warrior has taken over the masterless heavy-layered armour and has run amok, regarding everything that lives as an enemy. After being vanquished, they will continue to wander in search of the next vessel. "
it: Il pensiero malvagio di un guerriero caduto è passato in un'armatura pesante rimasta senza padrone e si è scatenato, prendendo per nemico tutto quello che vive. Anche dopo essere stata abbattuta continuerà a vagare in cerca del prossimo contenitore.

jp: 鉄塊
jp_grezzo: "鉄塊"
en: steel mass
en_grezzo: "steel mass"
it: la massa d'acciaio

jp: 古代の英雄の思念が投影された美しい鎧。己を凌駕する力の持ち主に出会うまで、戦いの愉悦に溺れ走り続ける。金でできているわけではないので鎧として見た時の価値はそこまで高くない。
jp_grezzo: "古代の英雄の思念が投影された美しい鎧。己を凌駕する力の持ち主に出会うまで、戦いの愉悦に溺れ走り続ける。金でできているわけではないので鎧として見た時の価値はそこまで高くない。"
en: A beautiful armour, projected with the thoughts of ancient heroes. It keeps running, drowning in the joys of battle, until it meets the owner of a power that surpasses its own. It is not made of gold, so its value as an armour is not that high.
en_grezzo: "A beautiful armour, projected with the thoughts of ancient heroes. It keeps running, drowning in the joys of battle, until it meets the owner of a power that surpasses its own. It is not made of gold, so its value as an armour is not that high."
it: Una bellissima armatura in cui si è proiettato il pensiero di un eroe antico. Corre e corre, ubriaca del piacere della battaglia, finché non incontra qualcuno con una forza che supera la sua. D'oro però non è fatta, e come armatura non vale poi molto.

jp: ゴールデンアーマー
jp_grezzo: "ゴールデンアーマー"
en: golden armor
en_grezzo: "golden armor"
it: l'armatura dorata

it: Un grande pezzo che ha la forma di un re. Ha truppe inesauribili e domina il campo di battaglia con una gran quantità di pezzi. Ha l'aspetto di un re, ma pare che il comando ce l'abbia qualcun altro.

jp_grezzo: "＜キング＞"
