en_grezzo: "<King>"
it: <Re>

jp: 戦士としての能力を、戦争に加わることで活用する流浪の武人。信念を以て活動する者もいるが、多くは賃金を得るため、立場を流転させ暮らしている。
jp_grezzo: "戦士としての能力を、戦争に加わることで活用する流浪の武人。信念を以て活動する者もいるが、多くは賃金を得るため、立場を流転させ暮らしている。"
en: Nomadic warriors who utilise their abilities as warriors by taking part in wars. Some operate out of conviction, but many live from one position to another in order to earn wages.
en_grezzo: "Nomadic warriors who utilise their abilities as warriors by taking part in wars. Some operate out of conviction, but many live from one position to another in order to earn wages."
it: Un uomo d'arme errante che mette a frutto le proprie doti di guerriero prendendo parte alle guerre. C'è chi agisce per convinzione, ma i più cambiano bandiera di continuo, e vivono per il salario.

jp: 傭兵戦士
jp_grezzo: "傭兵戦士"
en: mercenary warrior
en_grezzo: "mercenary warrior"
it: il guerriero mercenario

jp: 射手としての腕前を、抗争に加担する事で生活の糧とする武人。戦況次第で逃走し易いため、しぶとく生き延びる者も多い。
jp_grezzo: "射手としての腕前を、抗争に加担する事で生活の糧とする武人。戦況次第で逃走し易いため、しぶとく生き延びる者も多い。"
en: Archers who use their skills as archers to make a living by taking part in conflicts. Many of them survive, as it is easy for them to flee depending on the war situation.
en_grezzo: "Archers who use their skills as archers to make a living by taking part in conflicts. Many of them survive, as it is easy for them to flee depending on the war situation."
it: Un uomo d'arme che si guadagna da vivere mettendo la propria bravura di arciere al servizio delle contese. A seconda di come va la battaglia gli è facile scappare, e per questo in molti sopravvivono a lungo.

jp: 傭兵射手
jp_grezzo: "傭兵射手"
en: mercenary archer
en_grezzo: "mercenary archer"
it: l'arciere mercenario

jp: 魔術士としての知識を、戦に適用させる事で生計を立てている。戦況に対応するため、術士と戦士両方の能力を用いて戦う傾向がある。
jp_grezzo: "魔術士としての知識を、戦に適用させる事で生計を立てている。戦況に対応するため、術士と戦士両方の能力を用いて戦う傾向がある。"
en: He makes his living by applying his knowledge as a mage to warfare. He tends to fight using both his skills as a sorcerer and a warrior in order to adapt to the war situation.
en_grezzo: "He makes his living by applying his knowledge as a mage to warfare. He tends to fight using both his skills as a sorcerer and a warrior in order to adapt to the war situation."
it: Si guadagna da vivere applicando alla guerra il suo sapere di mago. Per adattarsi a come va la battaglia tende a combattere usando insieme le doti dello stregone e quelle del guerriero.

jp: 傭兵魔術士
jp_grezzo: "傭兵魔術士"
en: mercenary wizard
en_grezzo: "mercenary wizard"
it: il mago mercenario

jp: 行商人を襲い、商品を奪うことを生業としているならず者達の親分。奪った積荷を売り捌く為に持ち歩いており、襲い掛かった冒険者達に、逆に稼ぎを奪われることも。
jp_grezzo: "行商人を襲い、商品を奪うことを生業としているならず者達の親分。奪った積荷を売り捌く為に持ち歩いており、襲い掛かった冒険者達に、逆に稼ぎを奪われることも。"
en: A leader of a gang of ruffians who make their living by attacking peddlers and robbing them of their goods. They carry their stolen cargo around with them to sell it, and sometimes the adventurers who attack them take their earnings.
en_grezzo: "A leader of a gang of ruffians who make their living by attacking peddlers and robbing them of their goods. They carry their stolen cargo around with them to sell it, and sometimes the adventurers who attack them take their earnings."
it: Il capo di una banda di malviventi che campa assalendo i mercanti ambulanti e portando via la merce. Si porta dietro il carico rubato per rivenderlo, e ogni tanto sono gli avventurieri che lo assalgono a portargli via il guadagno.

jp: 盗賊団の頭領
jp_grezzo: "盗賊団の頭領"
en: rogue boss
en_grezzo: "rogue boss"
it: il capo della banda

jp: 盗賊団に金で雇われている、傭兵崩れ。古くからの慣習でセンセイと呼ばれることもあるとか。用心棒という響きにどこか魅力的なものがあるからかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "盗賊団に金で雇われている、傭兵崩れ。古くからの慣習でセンセイと呼ばれることもあるとか。用心棒という響きにどこか魅力的なものがあるからかもしれない。"
en: A mercenary crackpot, employed by a band of thieves for money. They are sometimes called senshi, according to an old custom. This may be because there is something appealing about the sound of 'bouncer'.
en_grezzo: "A mercenary crackpot, employed by a band of thieves for money. They are sometimes called senshi, according to an old custom. This may be because there is something appealing about the sound of 'bouncer'."
it: Un mercenario finito male, assoldato con del denaro da una banda di ladri. Per una vecchia usanza c'è chi lo chiama maestro. Sarà perché la parola guardaspalle ha in sé qualcosa di attraente.

jp: 盗賊団の用心棒
jp_grezzo: "盗賊団の用心棒"
en: rogue warrior
en_grezzo: "rogue warrior"
it: il guardaspalle della banda

jp: ド近眼のためなるべく接近して発砲しようとするヒットマン。一応その腕は本物で、凄まじい早さで銃を連射してくる強者も中にはいる。
jp_grezzo: "ド近眼のためなるべく接近して発砲しようとするヒットマン。一応その腕は本物で、凄まじい早さで銃を連射してくる強者も中にはいる。"
en: Hitmen who try to get as close as possible to fire due to their short-sightedness. Some of them are very good at it and fire their guns in rapid succession.
en_grezzo: "Hitmen who try to get as close as possible to fire due to their short-sightedness. Some of them are very good at it and fire their guns in rapid succession."
it: Un sicario che, essendo miope da non dirsi, cerca di sparare il più da vicino possibile. Il mestiere però lo sa, e fra loro c'è anche qualcuno che spara raffiche a una velocità spaventosa.

jp: 盗賊団の殺し屋
jp_grezzo: "盗賊団の殺し屋"
en: rogue archer
en_grezzo: "rogue archer"
it: il sicario della banda

jp: 行商人を襲撃するならずもの集団の術士。火の魔法をうっかり使ってしまい、略奪品を燃やして怒られる事が多い。変な儀式をやっており、肌を白く染めている。
jp_grezzo: "行商人を襲撃するならずもの集団の術士。火の魔法をうっかり使ってしまい、略奪品を燃やして怒られる事が多い。変な儀式をやっており、肌を白く染めている。"
en: A sorcerer in a group of ruffians who raid peddlers. He often gets angry when he inadvertently uses fire magic and burns looted goods. She performs strange rituals and dyes his skin white.
en_grezzo: "A sorcerer in a group of ruffians who raid peddlers. He often gets angry when he inadvertently uses fire magic and burns looted goods. She performs strange rituals and dyes his skin white."
it: Lo stregone di un gruppo di malviventi che assale i mercanti ambulanti. Gli capita spesso di usare per sbaglio la magia del fuoco, di bruciare il bottino e di prendersi una lavata di capo. Fa riti strani, e si tinge la pelle di bianco.

jp: 盗賊団の術士
jp_grezzo: "盗賊団の術士"
en: rogue wizard
en_grezzo: "rogue wizard"
it: lo stregone della banda

jp: イェルスに所属する兵士。機械の装備が支給されており、銃器などの兵器を重視して戦闘を行う。銃器に頼り過ぎたのか近接戦闘は苦手で、すぐに衛生兵を呼ぶ事になる。
jp_grezzo: "イェルスに所属する兵士。機械の装備が支給されており、銃器などの兵器を重視して戦闘を行う。銃器に頼り過ぎたのか近接戦闘は苦手で、すぐに衛生兵を呼ぶ事になる。"
en: Soldiers belonging to the Yerles Military. They are supplied with mechanical equipment and focus on firearms and other weapons in combat. They are not good at close combat, perhaps because they rely too much on firearms, and soon end up calling in air supports.
en_grezzo: "Soldiers belonging to the Yerles Military. They are supplied with mechanical equipment and focus on firearms and other weapons in combat. They are not good at close combat, perhaps because they rely too much on firearms, and soon end up calling in air supports."
it: Un soldato che appartiene a Yerles. Gli danno in dotazione un equipaggiamento meccanico, e combatte puntando sulle armi da fuoco e simili. Alle armi da fuoco si affida forse troppo, perché nel corpo a corpo se la cava male e finisce subito per chiamare il medico da campo.

jp: イェルス機械兵
jp_grezzo: "イェルス機械兵"
en: Yerles machine infantry
en_grezzo: "Yerles machine infantry"
it: la fanteria meccanica Yerles

jp: イェルスに所属する兵士の中でも、特に銃器の扱いに優れている者達。赤い色をした装備を身にまとっているが、速度が三倍という訳ではない。
jp_grezzo: "イェルスに所属する兵士の中でも、特に銃器の扱いに優れている者達。赤い色をした装備を身にまとっているが、速度が三倍という訳ではない。"
en: Soldiers belonging to the Yerles Military, who are particularly good with firearms. They wear red-coloured equipment, but it does not mean that they are three times faster.
en_grezzo: "Soldiers belonging to the Yerles Military, who are particularly good with firearms. They wear red-coloured equipment, but it does not mean that they are three times faster."
it: Fra i soldati che appartengono a Yerles, quelli particolarmente bravi a maneggiare le armi da fuoco. Portano un equipaggiamento di colore rosso, ma questo non vuol dire che vadano tre volte più veloci.

jp: イェルスエリート機械兵
jp_grezzo: "イェルスエリート機械兵"
en: Yerles elite machine infantry
en_grezzo: "Yerles elite machine infantry"
it: la fanteria meccanica scelta Yerles

jp: ジューア解放軍を率いてイェルス兵の進行を阻んでいる。その豪快な笑いは地のオパートスの真似。機械自体は嫌いではなく、イェルス兵から奪い取った銃を使っている。
jp_grezzo: "ジューア解放軍を率いてイェルス兵の進行を阻んでいる。その豪快な笑いは地のオパートスの真似。機械自体は嫌いではなく、イェルス兵から奪い取った銃を使っている。"
en: He leads the Juere Liberation Army blockading the progress of the Yerles soldiers. His bold laugh is an imitation of a local opus. He is not averse to machines per se, and uses the guns he has taken from the Yerles soldiers.
en_grezzo: "He leads the Juere Liberation Army blockading the progress of the Yerles soldiers. His bold laugh is an imitation of a local opus. He is not averse to machines per se, and uses the guns he has taken from the Yerles soldiers."
it: Guida l'esercito di liberazione di Juere e blocca l'avanzata dei soldati di Yerles. Quella sua risata fragorosa è un'imitazione di Opatos della terra. Le macchine in sé non gli dispiacciono, e usa i fucili strappati ai soldati di Yerles.

jp: 辺境の勇士『ギルバート大佐』
jp_grezzo: "辺境の勇士『ギルバート大佐』"
en: <Colonel Gilbert> the frontier warrior
en_grezzo: "<Colonel Gilbert> the frontier warrior"
it: <Colonnello Gilbert> l'eroe di frontiera

jp: 自走砲として開発されたのだが低コストを重視しすぎた結果、出力不足で自走砲としての機動力を実現できなかった。それでも実戦配備され固定砲台として使われている。
jp_grezzo: "自走砲として開発されたのだが低コストを重視しすぎた結果、出力不足で自走砲としての機動力を実現できなかった。それでも実戦配備され固定砲台として使われている。"
en: It was developed as a self-propelled artillery gun, but as a result of too much emphasis on low cost, it could not achieve the mobility of a self-propelled artillery gun due to insufficient power output. Nevertheless, it was deployed in actual combat and used as a fixed battery.
en_grezzo: "It was developed as a self-propelled artillery gun, but as a result of too much emphasis on low cost, it could not achieve the mobility of a self-propelled artillery gun due to insufficient power output. Nevertheless, it was deployed in actual combat and used as a fixed battery."
it: Lo avevano progettato come cannone semovente, ma a furia di badare al costo basso la potenza non è bastata, e la mobilità di un semovente non l'ha mai avuta. Lo hanno schierato lo stesso, e lo usano come batteria fissa.

jp: イェルス自走砲
jp_grezzo: "イェルス自走砲"
en: yerles self-propelled gun
en_grezzo: "yerles self-propelled gun"
it: il cannone semovente di Yerles

jp: ジューアの一般的な兵士。元が盗賊や悪人の集まりから始まった国であるため、協調性が無く、兵士としての統率された動きは苦手。
jp_grezzo: "ジューアの一般的な兵士。元が盗賊や悪人の集まりから始まった国であるため、協調性が無く、兵士としての統率された動きは苦手。"
en: A common soldier in Juere. As a country that originally started as a group of bandits and bad guys, they are uncoordinated and not good at controlled movements as soldiers.
en_grezzo: "A common soldier in Juere. As a country that originally started as a group of bandits and bad guys, they are uncoordinated and not good at controlled movements as soldiers."
it: Il soldato comune di Juere. Il paese è nato in origine da un'accozzaglia di ladri e malfattori, e quindi non sanno stare insieme: i movimenti ordinati del soldato non sono il loro forte.

jp: ジューア歩兵
jp_grezzo: "ジューア歩兵"
en: juere infantry
en_grezzo: "juere infantry"
it: il fante juere

jp: 元はアリーナで命を懸けて怪物と闘っていたが、そんな自らの境遇から脱却するために戦場に出てきたジューアの剣闘士。その瞳は悲壮なまでの決意を湛えている。
jp_grezzo: "元はアリーナで命を懸けて怪物と闘っていたが、そんな自らの境遇から脱却するために戦場に出てきたジューアの剣闘士。その瞳は悲壮なまでの決意を湛えている。"
en: A gladiator from Juere who used to fight monsters for his life in the arena, but came to the battlefield to break free from such a situation of his own. His eyes are filled with tragic determination.
en_grezzo: "A gladiator from Juere who used to fight monsters for his life in the arena, but came to the battlefield to break free from such a situation of his own. His eyes are filled with tragic determination."
it: Un gladiatore di Juere che prima si giocava la vita nell'arena contro i mostri e che, per uscire da quella condizione, è sceso sul campo di battaglia. In quegli occhi c'è una determinazione che fa male a guardarla.

jp: ジューア剣闘士
jp_grezzo: "ジューア剣闘士"
en: juere swordman
en_grezzo: "juere swordman"
it: lo spadaccino juere

jp: かつては吟遊詩人をやっていた時期もあったが、才能が欠片もなくいつも石を投げつけられていた。その恨みを晴らすべく石を投げる側に回った。
jp_grezzo: "かつては吟遊詩人をやっていた時期もあったが、才能が欠片もなくいつも石を投げつけられていた。その恨みを晴らすべく石を投げる側に回った。"
en: He used to be a bard for a time, but he lacked any talent and was always stoned. He turned to stone-throwing man to avenge that grudge.
en_grezzo: "He used to be a bard for a time, but he lacked any talent and was always stoned. He turned to stone-throwing man to avenge that grudge."
it: C'è stato un periodo in cui faceva il menestrello, ma di talento non ne aveva un briciolo e si prendeva sempre delle sassate. Per vendicarsi di quel rancore è passato dalla parte di chi le pietre le tira.

jp: ロックスロアー
jp_grezzo: "ロックスロアー"
en: rock thrower
en_grezzo: "rock thrower"
it: il lanciapietre

jp: イルヴァで広く飼われている愛玩動物。何故これほどまでに可愛いのかは謎だが、俊敏な捕食者としての顔も併せ持つ。その肉を食した者は強烈な罪悪感に襲われる。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァで広く飼われている愛玩動物。何故これほどまでに可愛いのかは謎だが、俊敏な捕食者としての顔も併せ持つ。その肉を食した者は強烈な罪悪感に襲われる。"
en: A pet animal widely kept in Irva. Why they are so cute is a mystery, but they are also agile predators. Anyone who eats its flesh is struck with a strong sense of guilt.
en_grezzo: "A pet animal widely kept in Irva. Why they are so cute is a mystery, but they are also agile predators. Anyone who eats its flesh is struck with a strong sense of guilt."
it: L'animale da compagnia più diffuso in Irva. Perché sia così tremendamente carino resta un mistero, ma ha anche l'altra faccia del predatore agile. Chi ne mangia la carne viene assalito da un senso di colpa fortissimo.

jp: 猫
en: cat
en_grezzo: "cat"
it: il gatto

jp: 大人しい性格と白く流れるような毛並みで、家飼いに大人気の猫。小柄で大人になっても大きさは子猫とそう変わらないが、これは相当無茶な交雑を繰り返しての品種「改良」の成果である。
jp_grezzo: "大人しい性格と白く流れるような毛並みで、家飼いに大人気の猫。小柄で大人になっても大きさは子猫とそう変わらないが、これは相当無茶な交雑を繰り返しての品種「改良」の成果である。"
en: With its docile character and white, flowing coat, it is a very popular cat among house-owners. They are small in stature, and as adults they are not so different in size from kittens, but this is the result of breed 'improvement' through repeated and quite reckless crossbreeding.
en_grezzo: "With its docile character and white, flowing coat, it is a very popular cat among house-owners. They are small in stature, and as adults they are not so different in size from kittens, but this is the result of breed 'improvement' through repeated and quite reckless crossbreeding."
it: Con il carattere mite e il pelo bianco che scorre come acqua, è un gatto amatissimo da chi lo tiene in casa. È piccolo, e da adulto non è tanto più grande di un gattino, ma questo è il frutto di un miglioramento della razza fatto incrociando e reincrociando in modo davvero sconsiderato.

jp: シルバーキャット
jp_grezzo: "シルバーキャット"
en: silver cat
en_grezzo: "silver cat"
it: il gatto d'argento

jp: 非常にやんちゃで好奇心が強く、親猫が目を離すとすぐにどこかへ行ってしまう。ネフィアなどの危険な場所に迷い込んでしまこともしばしば。
jp_grezzo: "非常にやんちゃで好奇心が強く、親猫が目を離すとすぐにどこかへ行ってしまう。ネフィアなどの危険な場所に迷い込んでしまこともしばしば。"
en: They are very mischievous and curious and will go away as soon as the parent cat takes its eyes off them. They often wander into dangerous places such as Nefia.
en_grezzo: "They are very mischievous and curious and will go away as soon as the parent cat takes its eyes off them. They often wander into dangerous places such as Nefia."
it: È di una vivacità e di una curiosità enormi, e appena la gatta lo perde di vista sparisce chissà dove. Spesso finisce per smarrirsi in posti pericolosi come le Nefia.

jp: 迷子の子猫
jp_grezzo: "迷子の子猫"
en: stray cat
en_grezzo: "stray cat"
it: il gatto randagio

jp: 猫族の猛獣。古い文献によると、かつては雄にのみたてがみが存在したらしいが、いつから雌にもたてがみが生えるようになったのかは不明である。
jp_grezzo: "猫族の猛獣。古い文献によると、かつては雄にのみたてがみが存在したらしいが、いつから雌にもたてがみが生えるようになったのかは不明である。"
en: A fierce animal of the cat tribe. According to old documents, only males once had manes, but it is not known when females started to grow manes as well.
en_grezzo: "A fierce animal of the cat tribe. According to old documents, only males once had manes, but it is not known when females started to grow manes as well."
it: Una belva del popolo dei gatti. Secondo i testi antichi un tempo la criniera ce l'avevano soltanto i maschi, ma da quando abbia cominciato a crescere anche alle femmine non si sa.

jp: いたずら好きの猫の神。猫嫌いな人間の家を探しては猫で埋め尽くす行為を繰り返している。なお、普通の猫もライオンもケシーにとっては平等に猫なのだ。
jp_grezzo: "いたずら好きの猫の神。猫嫌いな人間の家を探しては猫で埋め尽くす行為を繰り返している。なお、普通の猫もライオンもケシーにとっては平等に猫なのだ。"
en: Mischievous cat god. He repeatedly seeks out the homes of cat-hating humans and fills them with cats. Note that both ordinary cats and lions are equally cats to Cacy.
en_grezzo: "Mischievous cat god. He repeatedly seeks out the homes of cat-hating humans and fills them with cats. Note that both ordinary cats and lions are equally cats to Cacy."
it: Il dio dei gatti, e gli piace fare dispetti. Cerca le case degli uomini che i gatti non li sopportano e le riempie di gatti, e lo rifà di continuo. Da notare che, per Cacy, il gatto comune e il leone sono gatti allo stesso modo.

jp: 猫使い『ケシー』
jp_grezzo: "猫使い『ケシー』"
en: <Cacy> the cat tamer
en_grezzo: "<Cacy> the cat tamer"
it: <Cacy> il domatore di gatti

jp: 燃えるような紅い宝玉を額に持つ猫。奇妙な鳴き声で獲物を惑わす。宝玉の力なのか、視線を媒体とした魔術を使うことができる。
jp_grezzo: "燃えるような紅い宝玉を額に持つ猫。奇妙な鳴き声で獲物を惑わす。宝玉の力なのか、視線を媒体とした魔術を使うことができる。"
en: Cat with a flaming red treasure ball on its forehead. It uses a strange mewing sound to deceive its prey.It is able to use magic using its gaze as a medium, perhaps due to the power of the jewel.
en_grezzo: "Cat with a flaming red treasure ball on its forehead. It uses a strange mewing sound to deceive its prey.It is able to use magic using its gaze as a medium, perhaps due to the power of the jewel."
it: Un gatto che porta in fronte una gemma rossa come il fuoco. Con un miagolio strano confonde la preda. Sarà il potere della gemma, ma sa usare una magia che passa per lo sguardo.

jp: カーバンクル
jp_grezzo: "カーバンクル"
en: carbuncle
en_grezzo: "carbuncle"
it: il carbonchio

jp: 人の生活圏で暮らす犬。犬と人類の歴史は古く、太古に滅んだ全ての文明において人類と共にいたという研究結果が出ている。狼より尻尾の筋肉が弱いらしい。
jp_grezzo: "人の生活圏で暮らす犬。犬と人類の歴史は古く、太古に滅んだ全ての文明において人類と共にいたという研究結果が出ている。狼より尻尾の筋肉が弱いらしい。"
en: Dogs live in the habitat of humans. Dogs and humans have a long history, and studies have shown that they were with humans in all civilisations that died out in prehistoric times.They are said to have weaker tail muscles than wolves.
en_grezzo: "Dogs live in the habitat of humans. Dogs and humans have a long history, and studies have shown that they were with humans in all civilisations that died out in prehistoric times.They are said to have weaker tail muscles than wolves."
it: Il cane che vive dove vive l'uomo. La storia dei cani e degli uomini è antica, e le ricerche dicono che i cani stavano con gli uomini in tutte le civiltà estinte nei tempi remoti. Pare che abbiano i muscoli della coda più deboli di quelli del lupo.

jp: 犬
en: dog
en_grezzo: "dog"
it: il cane

jp: ポピーは怖いもの知らずでネフィアの奥に進み続ける、愚かな子犬である。しかし己の力を見誤った冒険者もこの子犬と同じなのだ。
jp_grezzo: "ポピーは怖いもの知らずでネフィアの奥に進み続ける、愚かな子犬である。しかし己の力を見誤った冒険者もこの子犬と同じなのだ。"
en: Poppy is a foolish puppy who is not afraid and keeps going deeper into Nefia. Adventurers who misjudge their own strength are just like this puppy.
en_grezzo: "Poppy is a foolish puppy who is not afraid and keeps going deeper into Nefia. Adventurers who misjudge their own strength are just like this puppy."
it: Poppy è un cucciolo sciocco, che non conosce la paura e continua a spingersi in fondo alle Nefia. Però anche l'avventuriero che sbaglia a misurare le proprie forze è uguale a questo cucciolo.

jp: 子犬の『ポピー』
jp_grezzo: "子犬の『ポピー』"
en: <Poppy> the little dog
en_grezzo: "<Poppy> the little dog"
it: <Poppy> il cagnolino

jp: ご近所で評判の犬好き少女。愛犬のポピーを溺愛しているが、当の本犬にはやや鬱陶しがられている様子で、時々目を離した隙に脱走されてしまうことも。
jp_grezzo: "ご近所で評判の犬好き少女。愛犬のポピーを溺愛しているが、当の本犬にはやや鬱陶しがられている様子で、時々目を離した隙に脱走されてしまうことも。"
en: A dog-loving girl with a reputation in the neighbourhood. She loves her dog Poppy very much, but the dog seems a little depressed and sometimes escapes when she is out of sight.
en_grezzo: "A dog-loving girl with a reputation in the neighbourhood. She loves her dog Poppy very much, but the dog seems a little depressed and sometimes escapes when she is out of sight."
it: Una bambina che ama i cani, e nel vicinato lo sanno tutti. Stravede per Poppy, il suo cane, ma il diretto interessato pare la trovi un po' soffocante, e ogni tanto, appena lei distoglie lo sguardo, scappa via.

jp: 犬好きの少女『リリアン』
jp_grezzo: "犬好きの少女『リリアン』"
en: <Rilian> the dog lover
en_grezzo: "<Rilian> the dog lover"
it: <Rilian> la bambina che adora i cani

jp: 猫嫌いな青年。イルヴァでは猫は非常に人気の高い生き物であるため、肩身が狭い。元はパルミア暮らしだったがミーアとの近所トラブルの末にヨウィンに引っ越した。
jp_grezzo: "猫嫌いな青年。イルヴァでは猫は非常に人気の高い生き物であるため、肩身が狭い。元はパルミア暮らしだったがミーアとの近所トラブルの末にヨウィンに引っ越した。"
en: A young man who hates cats. Cats are very popular creatures in Irva, so he has a narrow shoulder to lean on. He used to live in Palmia but moved to Yowyn after neighbourhood problems with Mia.
en_grezzo: "A young man who hates cats. Cats are very popular creatures in Irva, so he has a narrow shoulder to lean on. He used to live in Palmia but moved to Yowyn after neighbourhood problems with Mia."
it: Un giovane che non sopporta i gatti. In Irva i gatti sono creature amatissime, e per questo lui se ne sta con la coda fra le gambe. Prima viveva a Palmia, ma dopo i guai di vicinato con Mia si è trasferito a Yowyn.

jp: 猫嫌いの『タム』
jp_grezzo: "猫嫌いの『タム』"
en: <Tam> the cat hater
en_grezzo: "<Tam> the cat hater"
it: <Tam> il nemico dei gatti

jp: 大人になりきれてない女性全般を指す。イルヴァではペットとしても一般的で、奴隷として買うこともできるし、脱走して野生化した個体を捕まえることもできる。
jp_grezzo: "大人になりきれてない女性全般を指す。イルヴァではペットとしても一般的で、奴隷として買うこともできるし、脱走して野生化した個体を捕まえることもできる。"
en: Usually the term 'little girl' refers to all women who have not fully grown up. They are also common as pets in Irva, and can be bought as slaves. Escaped individuals can be captured in the wild.
en_grezzo: "Usually the term 'little girl' refers to all women who have not fully grown up. They are also common as pets in Irva, and can be bought as slaves. Escaped individuals can be captured in the wild."
it: Il nome indica in generale le donne che non sono ancora diventate adulte. In Irva sono comuni anche come animali da compagnia, si possono comprare come schiave, e chi scappa e torna allo stato brado lo si può catturare.

jp: 少女
jp_grezzo: "少女"
en: little girl
en_grezzo: "little girl"
it: la bambina

jp: 雑食性の小動物。高い繁殖力と何でも食べてしまうその性質によって、大繁殖を起こし農作物を喰いつくす事もある。身体が割と大きく、猫に挑むこともある。
jp_grezzo: "雑食性の小動物。高い繁殖力と何でも食べてしまうその性質によって、大繁殖を起こし農作物を喰いつくす事もある。身体が割と大きく、猫に挑むこともある。"
en: Small omnivorous animals. Due to their high fertility and their propensity to eat anything, they can breed in large numbers and devour crops.They are rather large and can challenge cats.
en_grezzo: "Small omnivorous animals. Due to their high fertility and their propensity to eat anything, they can breed in large numbers and devour crops.They are rather large and can challenge cats."
it: Un animaletto onnivoro. Con la sua grande capacità di riprodursi e con il vizio di mangiare qualunque cosa, ogni tanto si moltiplica a dismisura e divora i raccolti. Ha un corpo piuttosto grande, e capita che sfidi anche un gatto.

jp: 貝殻などを仮の住まいとする甲殻類。見た目は蟹のようだが実際は海老の仲間。何処から拾ってきたのか、とても美しい貝を背負っているものも居る。
jp_grezzo: "貝殻などを仮の住まいとする甲殻類。見た目は蟹のようだが実際は海老の仲間。何処から拾ってきたのか、とても美しい貝を背負っているものも居る。"
en: A crustacean that makes shells and other objects its temporary home. They look like crabs but are actually prawns. Some of them carry very beautiful shells on their backs, which they may have picked up from somewhere.
en_grezzo: "A crustacean that makes shells and other objects its temporary home. They look like crabs but are actually prawns. Some of them carry very beautiful shells on their backs, which they may have picked up from somewhere."
it: Un crostaceo che si fa una casa provvisoria di una conchiglia o di quel che trova. All'aspetto sembra un granchio, ma in realtà è parente del gambero. Qualcuno se ne porta in spalla una bellissima, chissà dove raccolta.

jp: やどかり
jp_grezzo: "やどかり"
en: hermit crab
en_grezzo: "hermit crab"
it: il paguro

jp: ジャグリングを披露しようとする流浪のピエロ。街でやらないのは市民のダメ出しを恐れているためらしい。迫力を重視するあまり、客に向けて様々なものを投げつけてくる。
jp_grezzo: "ジャグリングを披露しようとする流浪のピエロ。街でやらないのは市民のダメ出しを恐れているためらしい。迫力を重視するあまり、客に向けて様々なものを投げつけてくる。"
en: A wandering clown tries to perform juggling. The reason he doesn't do it in the city is apparently because he fears that the citizens will ruin it. He is so focused on power that he throws all sorts of things at the audience.
en_grezzo: "A wandering clown tries to perform juggling. The reason he doesn't do it in the city is apparently because he fears that the citizens will ruin it. He is so focused on power that he throws all sorts of things at the audience."
it: Un pagliaccio errante che vuole esibirsi con la giocoleria. Non lo fa in città, pare, per paura delle critiche dei cittadini. E siccome tiene troppo all'effetto, finisce per tirare addosso al pubblico ogni sorta di cosa.

jp: 大道芸人
jp_grezzo: "大道芸人"
en: public performer
en_grezzo: "public performer"
it: l'artista di strada

jp: 女王でありながら、動きづらいという理由で高貴な服装を嫌う。家臣の猫たちも勝手気ままに生活しており、王家という感じがしない。何か嫌な思い出でもあるのか、尻尾に触ろうとすると慌てて逃げていく。
jp_grezzo: "女王でありながら、動きづらいという理由で高貴な服装を嫌う。家臣の猫たちも勝手気ままに生活しており、王家という感じがしない。何か嫌な思い出でもあるのか、尻尾に触ろうとすると慌てて逃げていく。"
en: Although she is a queen, she dislikes wearing noble clothes because they make it difficult to move around. The cats in her household also live a carefree life and do not feel like royalty. Perhaps because they have bad memories, they run away in a hurry when you try to touch their tails.
en_grezzo: "Although she is a queen, she dislikes wearing noble clothes because they make it difficult to move around. The cats in her household also live a carefree life and do not feel like royalty. Perhaps because they have bad memories, they run away in a hurry when you try to touch their tails."
it: È una regina, ma i vestiti nobili non li sopporta perché le impediscono di muoversi. Anche i gatti del suo seguito vivono come gli pare, e di casa reale non hanno proprio l'aria. Sarà per qualche brutto ricordo, ma appena provi a toccarle la coda scappa via di corsa.

jp: 猫の女王『フリージア』
jp_grezzo: "猫の女王『フリージア』"
en: <Frisia> the cat queen
en_grezzo: "<Frisia> the cat queen"
it: <Frisia> la regina dei gatti

jp: あなたと血の繋がっていない妹。妹は妹であるが故に妹なのであり、それ以上でもそれ以下でもない。よってこの子は間違いなくあなたの妹なのだ。
jp_grezzo: "あなたと血の繋がっていない妹。妹は妹であるが故に妹なのであり、それ以上でもそれ以下でもない。よってこの子は間違いなくあなたの妹なのだ。"
en: A younger sister who is not blood-related to you. A younger sister is a younger sister because she is a younger sister, nothing more, nothing less. Therefore, she is definitely your younger sister.
en_grezzo: "A younger sister who is not blood-related to you. A younger sister is a younger sister because she is a younger sister, nothing more, nothing less. Therefore, she is definitely your younger sister."
it: La tua sorella minore, che non ha il tuo sangue. Una sorella minore è una sorella minore perché è una sorella minore, né più né meno. E quindi questa qui è senza ombra di dubbio la tua sorella minore.

jp: 妹
en: younger sister
en_grezzo: "younger sister"
it: la sorella minore

jp: 妹の館で愛情弁当を売っている、あなたと血の繋がっていない妹。この世の全てのお兄ちゃん・お姉ちゃんの妹とでもいうべき存在である。館、本人ともに、いつから存在しているのか不明。
jp_grezzo: "妹の館で愛情弁当を売っている、あなたと血の繋がっていない妹。この世の全てのお兄ちゃん・お姉ちゃんの妹とでもいうべき存在である。館、本人ともに、いつから存在しているのか不明。"
en: Your younger sister, who is not blood-related to you, sells affectionate lunches in her sister's pavilion. She is the younger sister of all the older brothers and sisters in this world. It is unclear how long both the pavilion and the person in question have existed.
en_grezzo: "Your younger sister, who is not blood-related to you, sells affectionate lunches in her sister's pavilion. She is the younger sister of all the older brothers and sisters in this world. It is unclear how long both the pavilion and the person in question have existed."
it: La tua sorella minore, che non ha il tuo sangue, e che al padiglione delle sorelle vende pranzi al sacco pieni d'affetto. È, si potrebbe dire, la sorella minore di tutti i fratelli e le sorelle maggiori di questo mondo. Da quando esistano lei e il padiglione, non si sa.

jp: 気まぐれな猫科の血の繋がらない義理の妹。好奇心が非常に旺盛だが、それ故に怪我をすることも多い。ブレザーを脱ぐときの静電気が嫌い。
jp_grezzo: "気まぐれな猫科の血の繋がらない義理の妹。好奇心が非常に旺盛だが、それ故に怪我をすることも多い。ブレザーを脱ぐときの静電気が嫌い。"
en: A non-blood related younger sister-in-law of a capricious cat family. Very curious, but therefore often injured. Dislikes static electricity when she takes off her blazer.
en_grezzo: "A non-blood related younger sister-in-law of a capricious cat family. Very curious, but therefore often injured. Dislikes static electricity when she takes off her blazer."
it: Una sorella acquisita, di stirpe felina e capricciosa, che non ha il tuo sangue. È curiosissima, e proprio per questo si fa spesso male. Non sopporta la scossa di statica quando si toglie il blazer.

jp: 妹猫
jp_grezzo: "妹猫"
en: younger cat sister
en_grezzo: "younger cat sister"
it: la sorella gatta minore

jp: 世間知らずのお嬢様。由緒正しい家柄に育ったので、たとえ戦闘があったとしてもエレガントな仕草を忘れないよう心がけている。怪しい薬の調合が趣味。
jp_grezzo: "世間知らずのお嬢様。由緒正しい家柄に育ったので、たとえ戦闘があったとしてもエレガントな仕草を忘れないよう心がけている。怪しい薬の調合が趣味。"
en: A naive young lady. Having grown up in a venerable family, she tries to remember elegant gestures even if there is fighting. She enjoys concocting weird medicines.
en_grezzo: "A naive young lady. Having grown up in a venerable family, she tries to remember elegant gestures even if there is fighting. She enjoys concocting weird medicines."
it: Una signorina che non sa niente del mondo. È cresciuta in una famiglia di antico lignaggio, e perciò bada a non dimenticare i gesti eleganti nemmeno se si combatte. Il suo passatempo è mescolare medicine sospette.

jp: 嬢
en: young lady
en_grezzo: "young lady"
it: la giovane dama

jp: パルミア南にある混沌の城を延々と守り続けている、古代機械文明の遺産。長年起動し続けていたため各部が経年劣化しているが、それでも驚異的な戦闘力を誇る。
jp_grezzo: "パルミア南にある混沌の城を延々と守り続けている、古代機械文明の遺産。長年起動し続けていたため各部が経年劣化しているが、それでも驚異的な戦闘力を誇る。"
en: A legacy of an ancient mechanical civilisation that has endlessly defended the Castle of Chaos south of Palmia. Although every part of the machine has deteriorated over the years as it has been running for many years, it still boasts an astonishing fighting power.
en_grezzo: "A legacy of an ancient mechanical civilisation that has endlessly defended the Castle of Chaos south of Palmia. Although every part of the machine has deteriorated over the years as it has been running for many years, it still boasts an astonishing fighting power."
it: Un lascito dell'antica civiltà meccanica, che senza sosta continua a difendere il castello del caos a sud di Palmia. Sta in funzione da tanti anni e ogni sua parte è logorata dal tempo, eppure vanta ancora una potenza di combattimento prodigiosa.

jp: ゼイレン究極破壊兵器『ウティマ』
jp_grezzo: "ゼイレン究極破壊兵器『ウティマ』"
en: <Utima> the destroyer of Xeren
en_grezzo: "<Utima> the destroyer of Xeren"
it: <Utima> l'arma distruttrice di Xeren

jp: 古き邪神に仕える。彼の神の名の下、不浄なる外法でもって人の枠から逸脱した忌むべき存在。今は混沌の城に引きこもり、延々と魔法の研究をしている。
jp_grezzo: "古き邪神に仕える。彼の神の名の下、不浄なる外法でもって人の枠から逸脱した忌むべき存在。今は混沌の城に引きこもり、延々と魔法の研究をしている。"
en: He serves an old evil god. Under the name of his god, he is an abomination who has deviated from the boundaries of humanity with his impure external laws. He is now shut up in the Castle of Chaos, endlessly researching magic.
en_grezzo: "He serves an old evil god. Under the name of his god, he is an abomination who has deviated from the boundaries of humanity with his impure external laws. He is now shut up in the Castle of Chaos, endlessly researching magic."
it: Serve un antico dio malvagio. Nel nome di quel dio, con arti immonde e proibite, è uscito dal recinto dell'uomo ed è diventato una presenza da aborrire. Adesso se ne sta chiuso nel castello del caos, a studiare magia senza fine.

jp: 不浄なる者『アズラシズル』
jp_grezzo: "不浄なる者『アズラシズル』"
en: <Azzrssil> the impure
en_grezzo: "<Azzrssil> the impure"
it: <Azzrssil> l'impuro

jp: 貴族が自尊心を満足させるため各々のペットを私闘させる様をヒントにして、ペット用のアリーナを設けた。獣人のような姿だが、実はマスコットキャラの着ぐるみである。
jp_grezzo: "貴族が自尊心を満足させるため各々のペットを私闘させる様をヒントにして、ペット用のアリーナを設けた。獣人のような姿だが、実はマスコットキャラの着ぐるみである。"
en: The arena was set up for pets, inspired by the way aristocrats let their pets fight private battles to satisfy their self-esteem. Although they look like beastmen, they are actually stuffed mascot characters.
en_grezzo: "The arena was set up for pets, inspired by the way aristocrats let their pets fight private battles to satisfy their self-esteem. Although they look like beastmen, they are actually stuffed mascot characters."
it: Ha aperto un'arena per gli animali da compagnia, prendendo spunto dai nobili che, per soddisfare il proprio orgoglio, fanno duellare i rispettivi animali. Ha l'aspetto di un uomo bestia, ma in verità è un costume da mascotte.

jp: ペットアリーナの主催者
jp_grezzo: "ペットアリーナの主催者"
en: master of pet arena
en_grezzo: "master of pet arena"
it: l'organizzatore dell'arena delle bestie

jp: 伝説級の腕を持つ寡黙な鍛冶師。作る物は形こそ無骨で均一的だが、どれも実用性が高い装備品やアイテムである。ミラルとは幼少の頃からの腐れ縁。
jp_grezzo: "伝説級の腕を持つ寡黙な鍛冶師。作る物は形こそ無骨で均一的だが、どれも実用性が高い装備品やアイテムである。ミラルとは幼少の頃からの腐れ縁。"
en: A taciturn blacksmith with legendary skills. The objects he makes are rugged and uniform in form, but they are all highly practical equipment and items. He and Miral have been friends since childhood.
en_grezzo: "A taciturn blacksmith with legendary skills. The objects he makes are rugged and uniform in form, but they are all highly practical equipment and items. He and Miral have been friends since childhood."
it: Un fabbro taciturno, con un'abilità da leggenda. Quel che fabbrica ha forme rozze e tutte uguali, ma sono equipaggiamenti e oggetti di grande utilità. Con Miral si trascina dietro un'amicizia scomoda fin da bambini.

jp: 伝説の職人『ガロク』
jp_grezzo: "伝説の職人『ガロク』"
en: <Garok> the legendary smith
en_grezzo: "<Garok> the legendary smith"
it: <Garok> il fabbro leggendario

jp: 伝説級の腕を持つ陽気な鍛冶師。気まぐれで自分の気に入った仕事しかしないのだが、その遊び心あふれる彼の作品にはファンも多い。猫大好き。
jp_grezzo: "伝説級の腕を持つ陽気な鍛冶師。気まぐれで自分の気に入った仕事しかしないのだが、その遊び心あふれる彼の作品にはファンも多い。猫大好き。"
en: A cheerful blacksmith with legendary skills. He is capricious and only does work he likes, but his playful creations have many fans. Loves cats.
en_grezzo: "A cheerful blacksmith with legendary skills. He is capricious and only does work he likes, but his playful creations have many fans. Loves cats."
it: Un fabbro allegro, con un'abilità da leggenda. È lunatico e lavora solo a quel che gli piace, ma i suoi pezzi, pieni di estro, hanno molti ammiratori. Va matto per i gatti.

jp: 伝説の職人『ミラル』
jp_grezzo: "伝説の職人『ミラル』"
en: <Miral> the legendary smith
en_grezzo: "<Miral> the legendary smith"
it: <Miral> il fabbro leggendario

jp: 二本の尻尾が特徴的な猫。高い知能をもち、人間以外の生物で初めて、神を祀っているのが確認された生物でもある。食べてもエビみたいな味はしない。
jp_grezzo: "二本の尻尾が特徴的な猫。高い知能をもち、人間以外の生物で初めて、神を祀っているのが確認された生物でもある。食べてもエビみたいな味はしない。"
en: A cat with two tails. It is highly intelligent and was the first non-human creature confirmed to worship a deity. They do not taste like prawns when eaten.
en_grezzo: "A cat with two tails. It is highly intelligent and was the first non-human creature confirmed to worship a deity. They do not taste like prawns when eaten."
it: Un gatto che si riconosce per le due code. Ha un'intelligenza alta, ed è il primo essere vivente non umano di cui si sia accertato che venera una divinità. A mangiarlo, comunque, non sa di gambero.

jp: ツインテール
jp_grezzo: "ツインテール"
en: twintail
